title: From Source Code to Network Profile: Automated and Traceable MUD Profile Generation for IoT Devices
abstract: The Manufacturer Usage Description (MUD) standard allows IoT manufacturers to define expected network behaviors in a MUD file. This file can be translated into enforceable access-control policies, restricting compromised devices to operate solely through manufacturer-defined communication patterns. However, practical adoption of MUD depends on profiles that are accurate, complete, and maintainable. Existing approaches use traffic-based automation but require device deployment and prolonged monitoring, capturing only behavior exercised during observation. Rare, failure-triggered, or configuration-dependent communications may remain absent, producing incomplete policies that disrupt legitimate operation and offer limited insight into the software components responsible for each rule. We present AutoMUD, a source-code-driven tool that generates traceable MUD profiles for IoT devices from their firmware and software source code. AutoMUD combines static and syntactic extraction, retrieval-grounded language-model reasoning, and deterministic validation and compilation to recover the communication behavior characterizing an IoT device and translate eligible endpoints into policy rules. By analyzing code-level evidence, AutoMUD exposes rarely exercised and conditional communication paths, links every generated rule to its source-level provenance, and preserves excluded findings with explicit reasons for review. Our evaluation on a Linux-based repository demonstrates that AutoMUD recovers complete communication behavior, consolidates validated behavior into semantic endpoint groups, and generates structurally valid MUD profiles. Through a controlled semantic fault-injection campaign, we demonstrate that AutoMUD enables analysts to detect, localize, explain, and correct propagated errors, recovering policies semantically identical to their clean counterparts.
title_cn: 从源代码到网络画像：面向 IoT 设备的自动化、可追溯 MUD 配置文件生成
abstract_cn: 制造商使用描述（MUD）标准允许 IoT 制造商在 MUD 文件中定义设备预期的网络行为。该文件可以被转换为可执行的访问控制策略，将被攻陷的设备限制为只能按照制造商定义的通信模式运行。然而，MUD 的实际采用依赖于准确、完整且可维护的配置文件。现有方法采用基于流量的自动化，但需要部署设备并进行长时间监测，只能捕获观测期间被触发的行为。罕见的、由故障触发的或依赖配置的通信可能缺失，从而产生不完整的策略，干扰合法运行，并且难以说明每条规则由哪些软件组件负责。我们提出 AutoMUD，一个源代码驱动的工具，从 IoT 设备的固件与软件源代码生成可追溯的 MUD 配置文件。AutoMUD 结合静态与语法抽取、检索支撑的语言模型推理，以及确定性的验证与编译，以恢复刻画 IoT 设备的通信行为，并将符合条件的端点转换为策略规则。通过分析代码级证据，AutoMUD 揭示很少被执行的和条件性的通信路径，将每条生成的规则关联到其源码级来源，并保留被排除的发现及其明确理由以供审查。在一个基于 Linux 的代码仓库上的评估表明，AutoMUD 恢复了完整的通信行为，将经过验证的行为整合为语义端点组，并生成结构有效的 MUD 配置文件。通过一次受控的语义故障注入实验，我们证明 AutoMUD 使分析人员能够检测、定位、解释并纠正传播的错误，恢复出与干净版本语义相同的策略。
summary_cn: AutoMUD 结合静态抽取、检索支撑的语言模型推理与确定性验证，从 IoT 源码生成可追溯的 MUD 配置文件，在一个 Linux 仓库上恢复完整通信行为并经故障注入检验。
objective_summary: 构建从源代码生成可追溯 MUD 配置文件的工具 AutoMUD，在一个基于 Linux 的仓库上评估通信行为恢复与配置文件有效性，并以受控语义故障注入检验错误的可追溯与可纠正性。
evidence_note: 仅在单个基于 Linux 的仓库上评估，未与基于流量的方法做量化对比；另有受控故障注入实验。
novelty_note: 从源码而非流量生成 MUD 配置文件，并为每条规则保留源码来源，可覆盖罕见与条件通信路径。
scope: 适用于可获取固件与软件源代码的 IoT 设备，验证限于单个基于 Linux 的仓库。
limitations: 依赖源代码可得性；评估对象单一，完整性结论缺少真实流量对照验证。

title: Configuration, Not Conscience: A Large-Scale Empirical Study of LLM System Prompts
abstract: Leaked system prompts are often treated as windows into the hidden values of commercial language models, yet their composition is rarely studied at scale. We analyze a merged corpus of 407 leaked, reconstructed, or officially published system prompts from 62 vendors across four community collections, identifying 29 near-duplicate clusters covering 66 files. Operational content rather than ethical statements dominates the corpus; a deliberately simple block-level classifier assigns roughly 58\% of classified words to tool/protocol and roughly 5\% to safety policy, while the strictest rule-lines guard tool use and file safety over harmful content by an 11:1 margin. Literal text transfer concentrates in a small set of cross-vendor pairs. Prompts also carry measurable maintenance debt, with version chains turning over thousands of words per release. The evidence supports treating leaked prompts as operational specifications, closer to configuration files than value statements, and treats reuse and prompt rot as engineering and supply-chain concerns. Because most documents are adversarial in origin and the detectors are deliberately simple, all magnitudes are directional; we audit the main classifier's error modes.
comment: To appear at ICTAI 2026
title_cn: 是配置而非良知：LLM 系统提示的大规模实证研究
abstract_cn: 泄露的系统提示常被视为窥探商业语言模型隐藏价值观的窗口，但其构成很少得到大规模研究。我们分析了一个合并语料库，其中包含来自四个社区合集、62 家厂商的 407 份泄露、重建或官方发布的系统提示，并识别出覆盖 66 个文件的 29 个近重复簇。语料库中占主导的是操作性内容而非伦理声明：一个刻意简化的块级分类器将约 58% 的已分类词归为工具/协议、约 5% 归为安全策略；而在最严格的规则行中，约束工具使用与文件安全的与约束有害内容的比例为 11:1。字面文本迁移集中在少数跨厂商配对中。提示还背负着可测量的维护债务，其版本链每次发布都会更替数千词。这些证据支持将泄露的提示视为操作规范——更接近配置文件而非价值声明——并将复用与提示腐化（prompt rot）视为工程与供应链问题。由于大多数文档来源具有对抗性，且检测器刻意保持简单，所有量级都只具有方向性意义；我们审计了主分类器的错误模式。
summary_cn: 分析 62 家厂商的 407 份系统提示：约 58% 词量属工具/协议、约 5% 属安全策略，最严格规则中工具与文件安全对有害内容为 11:1，主张将其视为配置文件（ICTAI'26）。
objective_summary: 对 407 份系统提示语料做近重复聚类、块级内容分类、跨厂商文本迁移与版本演化分析，并审计主分类器的错误模式。
evidence_note: 407 份提示、62 家厂商的语料；分类器刻意简化，作者声明量级仅具方向性，并做了错误模式审计。
novelty_note: 对此前少有大规模研究的系统提示做内容构成与维护债务刻画，提出配置文件视角。
scope: 结论限于四个社区合集中泄露、重建或官方发布的系统提示，数值仅具方向性。
limitations: 多数文档来源具对抗性，真实性难以核实；块级分类器简单，数值精度有限。

title: Region-Level Black-Box Defense Against Stealthy Embedding-Space Backdoors in CLIP
abstract: Contrastive Language--Image Pretraining (CLIP) has emerged as a dominant vision backbone due to its strong transferability and zero-shot capabilities. However, recent studies reveal a critical vulnerability: embedding-space backdoor attacks. By poisoning only a tiny fraction of image--text pairs, adversaries can implant stealthy triggers that induce targeted shifts in CLIP's joint embedding space. Unlike conventional backdoors that manipulate classifier logits, these attacks corrupt representations directly, making them highly effective under extremely low poisoning ratios and difficult to detect. Existing defenses require access to model parameters, gradients, logits, or clean validation data---assumptions that rarely hold in realistic black-box deployments. Moreover, current black-box methods struggle to accurately localize small or out-of-distribution triggers. We propose CLIPGuard, a lightweight and fully black-box defense specifically designed to mitigate embedding-space backdoors in CLIP encoders. CLIPGuard identifies malicious regions by measuring segment-wise embedding perturbations and selectively purifies only suspicious segments via semantic inpainting, preserving benign visual content and alignment quality. Extensive experiments on STL-10, ImageNet, and diverse trigger families---including BadCLIP, BadNets, blended, patch-based, and typographic attacks---demonstrate that CLIPGuard reduces attack success rates to as low as 1.05% while maintaining clean accuracy up to 86.34%, consistently outperforming existing black-box defenses, including CleanCLIP and CleanerCLIP. Our code is available https://github.com/wsu-cyber-security-lab-ai/CLIPGuard.git
title_cn: 针对 CLIP 中隐蔽嵌入空间后门的区域级黑盒防御
abstract_cn: 对比语言-图像预训练（CLIP）凭借强大的可迁移性和零样本能力，已成为主导性的视觉骨干网络。然而，近期研究揭示了一个关键漏洞：嵌入空间后门攻击。攻击者只需对极小比例的图像-文本对投毒，即可植入隐蔽触发器，在 CLIP 的联合嵌入空间中诱导定向偏移。与操纵分类器 logits 的传统后门不同，这类攻击直接破坏表示，因而在极低投毒比例下依然高效且难以检测。现有防御需要访问模型参数、梯度、logits 或干净验证数据，而这些假设在现实的黑盒部署中很少成立。此外，现有黑盒方法难以准确定位小尺寸或分布外的触发器。我们提出 CLIPGuard，一种专为缓解 CLIP 编码器中嵌入空间后门而设计的轻量级、完全黑盒防御。CLIPGuard 通过测量分段级嵌入扰动识别恶意区域，并通过语义修复（inpainting）只对可疑分段进行选择性净化，从而保留良性视觉内容与对齐质量。在 STL-10、ImageNet 以及多种触发器家族（包括 BadCLIP、BadNets、混合（blended）、基于补丁和排版（typographic）攻击）上的大量实验表明，CLIPGuard 可将攻击成功率降至低至 1.05%，同时保持最高 86.34% 的干净准确率，并始终优于现有黑盒防御，包括 CleanCLIP 和 CleanerCLIP。代码已公开：https://github.com/wsu-cyber-security-lab-ai/CLIPGuard.git
summary_cn: 黑盒防御 CLIPGuard 以分段嵌入扰动定位 CLIP 嵌入空间后门触发区域并语义修复净化，攻击成功率低至 1.05%、干净准确率最高 86.34%，优于 CleanCLIP 等。
objective_summary: 提出基于分段嵌入扰动定位与语义修复净化的黑盒 CLIP 后门防御 CLIPGuard，在两个数据集与多类触发器上与 CleanCLIP、CleanerCLIP 等防御对比验证。
evidence_note: 两个数据集、含 BadCLIP 等五类在内的多种触发器、对比 CleanCLIP 与 CleanerCLIP；未提及自适应攻击评估。
novelty_note: 在黑盒设定下以区域级嵌入扰动定位小型或分布外触发器，属输入净化思路的改进。
scope: 适用于 CLIP 图像编码器、所测数据集与触发器家族，限于只能查询嵌入的黑盒部署。
limitations: 未见针对该防御的自适应攻击评估；需额外调用修复模型，其开销摘要中未量化。

title: FragToken: Amplifying LLM Inference Costs through Noncanonical Token Generation
abstract: As large language model (LLM) inference becomes increasingly expensive, resource-consumption attacks pose a growing threat to model providers. Existing attacks typically amplify cost by inducing abnormally long or repetitive outputs on attacker-controlled or triggered requests, making them easier to detect and limiting their deployment-wide impact when benign traffic dominates. In this work, we uncover a previously overlooked token-level attack surface arising from the many-to-one mapping from token sequences to decoded text. Although standard LLMs predominantly generate the canonical token sequences induced by their tokenizers, the same text can also be represented by substantially longer non-canonical sequences. This representational flexibility exposes a new avenue for resource-consumption attacks: an attacker can train the model to favor such sequences, systematically increasing the number of autoregressive decoding steps without a proportional increase in visible response length. However, we empirically find that directly maximizing token fragmentation substantially degrades model utility, producing conspicuous answer-quality failures that undermine attack stealthiness. To address this challenge, we propose FragToken, a training-time framework that combines source-model self-distillation, capacity-aware filtering and budgeting, and BPE-Aligned Merging to induce fragmented generation under ordinary prompts while largely preserving model utility. We evaluate FragToken on four LLMs across three benchmarks. Across the four models, FragToken achieves a three-benchmark average token inflation ratio (TIR) ranging from 1.99 to 2.46, while causing only minor degradation in model utility. Our work reveals a covert LLM supply-chain threat that increases inference cost without requiring large volumes of attack requests while largely preserving utility.
title_cn: FragToken：通过非规范 token 生成放大 LLM 推理成本
abstract_cn: 随着大语言模型（LLM）推理日益昂贵，资源消耗攻击对模型提供方构成日益增长的威胁。现有攻击通常在攻击者控制或触发的请求上诱导异常冗长或重复的输出以放大成本，这使其更易被检测，并且在良性流量占主导时限制了其在整个部署范围内的影响。在本工作中，我们揭示了一个此前被忽视的 token 级攻击面，它源于从 token 序列到解码文本的多对一映射。尽管标准 LLM 主要生成由其分词器诱导的规范 token 序列，但同一文本也可以由长得多的非规范序列表示。这种表示上的灵活性为资源消耗攻击打开了新途径：攻击者可以训练模型偏好此类序列，从而系统性地增加自回归解码步数，而可见回复长度并不成比例地增加。然而，我们通过实验发现，直接最大化 token 碎片化会显著降低模型效用，产生明显的回答质量失败，从而破坏攻击的隐蔽性。为应对这一挑战，我们提出 FragToken，一个训练阶段框架，它结合源模型自蒸馏、容量感知的过滤与预算分配，以及 BPE 对齐合并（BPE-Aligned Merging），在普通提示下诱导碎片化生成，同时基本保持模型效用。我们在三个基准上对四个 LLM 评估 FragToken。在这四个模型上，FragToken 的三基准平均 token 膨胀率（TIR）介于 1.99 到 2.46 之间，而模型效用仅有轻微下降。我们的工作揭示了一种隐蔽的 LLM 供应链威胁：它无需大量攻击请求即可增加推理成本，同时基本保持效用。
summary_cn: 揭示 token 序列到文本的多对一映射带来的资源消耗攻击面，训练期框架 FragToken 让模型偏好非规范 token，四模型三基准平均 token 膨胀率 1.99–2.46，效用仅轻微下降。
objective_summary: 提出以源模型自蒸馏、容量感知过滤与 BPE 对齐合并诱导非规范 token 生成的训练期攻击框架，在四个 LLM 与三个基准上测量 token 膨胀率与效用变化。
evidence_note: 四模型 × 三基准报告 TIR 与效用；对照仅见直接最大化碎片化的做法，未提及对检测防御的评估。
novelty_note: 利用非规范 token 序列放大解码步数而不增加可见输出长度，是此前未被关注的攻击面。
scope: 适用于攻击者能在训练阶段篡改并分发模型的供应链场景及 BPE 类分词器。
limitations: 需在训练阶段篡改模型，威胁模型较强；对基于 token 数与文本长度比值的检测未见评估。
institution: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China

title: Fast and Secure Simultaneous Authentication of Equals for WPA3
abstract: The Simultaneous Authentication of Equals (SAE) protocol, introduced in WPA3, provides robust protection against offline dictionary attacks against a network Pre-Shared Key (PSK) and also protection of session keys from other people knowing that PSK. However, its high computational cost for the Password Element (PE) derivation makes Access Points (APs) vulnerable to CPU exhaustion Denial-of-Service (DoS) attacks. This paper proposes a resilient architectural modification to SAE. First, we introduce an asymmetric resource cost model that offloads the iterative discovery of cryptographic elements to the client, allowing the AP to maintain a fixed computational load during the handshake. To further mitigate brute-force attempts, we implement a mechanism based on a slow-path key derivation (with variable cost key derivation functions, such as PBKDF2 or Argon2), incorporating a deliberate processing delay on the supplicant. Finally, we introduce a ticket-based mechanism to facilitate efficient re-authentication for known devices, bypassing expensive exchanges while preserving system availability under adversarial conditions. Experimental results demonstrate that this architecture significantly mitigates DoS risks without compromising legitimate network access.
comment: Submitted to the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Cyber Security and Resilience (IEEE CSR), August 2026, Lisbon, Portugal
title_cn: 面向 WPA3 的快速且安全的对等实体同时认证（SAE）
abstract_cn: WPA3 中引入的对等实体同时认证（SAE）协议能有效抵御针对网络预共享密钥（PSK）的离线字典攻击，并且即使他人知道该 PSK 也能保护会话密钥。然而，其口令元素（PE）推导的高计算成本使接入点（AP）易遭受 CPU 耗尽型拒绝服务（DoS）攻击。本文提出一种对 SAE 的弹性架构修改。首先，我们引入一种非对称资源成本模型，将密码学元素的迭代搜索卸载到客户端，使 AP 在握手期间保持固定的计算负载。为进一步缓解暴力破解尝试，我们实现了一种基于慢路径密钥推导的机制（采用可变成本的密钥推导函数，如 PBKDF2 或 Argon2），在请求方（supplicant）上引入刻意的处理延迟。最后，我们引入一种基于票据的机制，为已知设备提供高效的重新认证，绕过昂贵的交换过程，同时在对抗条件下保持系统可用性。实验结果表明，该架构在不影响合法网络接入的前提下显著缓解了 DoS 风险。
summary_cn: 针对 WPA3 SAE 口令元素推导导致的 AP CPU 耗尽型 DoS，提出迭代计算卸载至客户端、慢速 KDF 延迟与票据式快速重认证三项修改，实验称显著降低 DoS 风险。
objective_summary: 对 WPA3 SAE 握手提出非对称成本模型、慢路径密钥推导与票据重认证三项架构修改，以实验评估其对 DoS 的缓解效果及对合法接入的影响。
evidence_note: 摘要仅称实验显示显著缓解 DoS，未给出实验规模、具体数值、对照基线或形式化安全分析。
novelty_note: 计算卸载至客户端、慢速 KDF 与票据重认证均为已知 DoS 缓解思路，此处组合用于 SAE。
scope: 结论限于 WPA3 SAE 握手与 CPU 耗尽型 DoS 威胁模型下的实验环境。
limitations: 修改后协议与现有 WPA3 标准的兼容性及对 SAE 原有安全性质的影响，摘要未作论证。

title: Toward verifiably private learning from federated data
abstract: Federated Learning (FL) allows devices with private data to collaborate in training a shared model. We present a next-generation FL system based on Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs) that addresses operational challenges associated with earlier systems and provides externally verifiable central Differential Privacy (DP) guarantees for the first time while offering a better privacy-utility tradeoff. In our system, devices upload data encrypted with keys managed by a TEE-hosted Key Management Service (KMS). The uploaded data is cryptographically tied to a policy limiting the set of Python programs that may later process the data in server-side TEEs. External parties may inspect public transparency logs to observe the set of workloads allowed by these policies. Our experimental results show that the new system improves device coverage and favorably shifts privacy-utility curves by enabling collected data to be integrated into the server-side workload at a schedule that optimizes DP guarantees and is unaffected by device availability. Our new system has been productionized, enabling models for the Android Keyboard (Gboard) to be trained faster and achieve better accuracy under smaller, now externally verifiable privacy budgets in comparison to models trained using the prior system.
title_cn: 迈向基于联邦数据的可验证隐私学习
abstract_cn: 联邦学习（FL）允许持有私有数据的设备协作训练一个共享模型。我们提出一个基于可信执行环境（TEE）的新一代 FL 系统，它解决了早期系统相关的运营挑战，首次提供可外部验证的中心化差分隐私（DP）保证，同时提供更好的隐私-效用权衡。在我们的系统中，设备上传的数据以由 TEE 托管的密钥管理服务（KMS）所管理的密钥加密。上传的数据在密码学上与一项策略绑定，该策略限定了之后可在服务器端 TEE 中处理这些数据的 Python 程序集合。外部各方可以检查公开的透明日志，以观察这些策略所允许的工作负载集合。实验结果表明，新系统提高了设备覆盖率，并使隐私-效用曲线向有利方向移动，这是因为收集到的数据可以按照优化 DP 保证、且不受设备可用性影响的时间表整合进服务器端工作负载。新系统已投入生产，使 Android 键盘（Gboard）的模型与用旧系统训练的模型相比训练更快，并在更小且现已可外部验证的隐私预算下取得更高的准确率。
summary_cn: 以 TEE 托管的 KMS 加密数据并绑定可处理程序策略、配合公开透明日志，首次让联邦学习的中心化 DP 保证可被外部验证；已用于 Gboard，训练更快且在更小隐私预算下更准。
objective_summary: 设计并落地一个以 TEE 托管 KMS、策略绑定加密数据与透明日志实现可外部验证中心化 DP 的联邦学习系统，以实验及 Gboard 生产部署与旧系统对比验证。
evidence_note: 有生产部署，并与旧系统对比设备覆盖与隐私-效用曲线；摘要未给出具体数值与统计检验。
novelty_note: 把 TEE 中的策略绑定与公开透明日志结合，使联邦学习的中心化 DP 保证首次可被外部验证。

title: Verifiable Randomness for Blockchain-Based Lottery Systems
abstract: As lotteries and other high-stakes decentralized applications increasingly depend on unpredictable randomness for their operations, the lack of a secure and transparent on-chain random number generator that is verifiable by all participants remains a critical open problem. Various approaches to blockchain-based random number generation have emerged over the years, each with their own strengths and limitations, and have consistently been superseded as blockchain technology evolved. This paper surveys existing approaches to on-chain randomness and proposes a new platform that builds upon the well-known commit-and-reveal scheme while directly addressing its principal vulnerability, the last revealer attack, in which the final participant can withhold their reveal in order to bias or abort the output upon seeing an unfavorable result. We further compare this solution with prior approaches and evaluate its entropy properties. The proposed architecture combines a web-based front-end with a Solidity smart contract deployed on the Polygon 2.0 blockchain. Implemented and tested on the Amoy testnet, the prototype is low-cost and simple to deploy, providing a practical, accessible proof-of-concept for verifiable on-chain randomness.
comment: Submitted to BLOCKCHAIN'26 (8th International Congress on Blockchain and Applications, Naples, Italy, October 2026)
title_cn: 面向基于区块链的彩票系统的可验证随机性
abstract_cn: 随着彩票及其他高风险去中心化应用越来越依赖不可预测的随机性来运作，缺少一种安全、透明且可被所有参与者验证的链上随机数生成器仍是一个关键的开放问题。多年来出现了多种基于区块链的随机数生成方法，各有优势与局限，并随着区块链技术的演进不断被取代。本文综述了现有的链上随机性方法，并提出一个新平台：它建立在广为人知的提交-揭示（commit-and-reveal）方案之上，同时直接应对该方案的主要漏洞——最后揭示者攻击，即最后一个参与者在看到不利结果时可以扣留其揭示值，从而使输出产生偏差或中止。我们进一步将该方案与已有方法进行比较，并评估其熵特性。所提架构结合了基于 Web 的前端与部署在 Polygon 2.0 区块链上的 Solidity 智能合约。该原型在 Amoy 测试网上实现并测试，成本低、易于部署，为可验证的链上随机性提供了一个实用、易用的概念验证。
summary_cn: 综述链上随机数方案，并在提交-揭示方案基础上构建针对最后揭示者攻击的彩票随机性平台，以 Solidity 合约在 Polygon Amoy 测试网上做概念验证并评估熵特性。
objective_summary: 在综述已有链上随机性方案的基础上，提出针对最后揭示者攻击的提交-揭示平台，以测试网原型实现、与已有方法的比较及熵特性评估加以验证。
evidence_note: 仅有 Amoy 测试网原型与熵特性评估；摘要未给出与已有方法比较的量化结果，也未提及形式化安全分析。
novelty_note: 提交-揭示方案及最后揭示者攻击的缓解均为已知方向，主要是工程整合与原型实现。
scope: 结论限于 Polygon 2.0 测试网上的 Solidity 原型与彩票类应用场景。
limitations: 仅在 Amoy 测试网上做概念验证，未见主网部署或较大参与者规模下的评估。

title: Context-Aware Functional Modeling for Android Third-Party Library Detection
abstract: Third-party libraries (TPLs) are widely used in Android apps, but their reuse can introduce security risks and interfere with downstream program analyses. Existing Android TPL detection approaches face two key limitations: their hand-crafted features are fragile under aggressive code transformations, and their whole-library matching strategies are ineffective when apps retain only part of a TPL. In this paper, we propose LibFan, a learning-based Android TPL detection approach based on context-aware functional modeling. It realizes this modeling through two complementary components: context-aware contrastive learning at the method level and functional partitioning at the library level. At the method level, it learns semantic representations through contrastive training while incorporating outgoing call relationships and class-level context, improving robustness to obfuscation, shrinking, and optimization. At the library level, it partitions each TPL into functionally coherent units and determines library presence using the best-matching partition, thereby accommodating partial library reuse. To evaluate LibFan, we construct a new benchmark comprising 200 apps and 46 vulnerable TPLs, with each app compiled under four transformation configurations. Under the most challenging R8 full mode, LibFan achieves F1 scores of 81.3% at the library level and 47.6% at the version level, representing relative improvements of 64.9% and 35.6% over the state of the art, respectively.
title_cn: 面向 Android 第三方库检测的上下文感知功能建模
abstract_cn: 第三方库（TPL）在 Android 应用中被广泛使用，但对它们的复用可能引入安全风险并干扰下游程序分析。现有 Android TPL 检测方法面临两个关键局限：其人工设计的特征在激进的代码变换下很脆弱，而其整库匹配策略在应用只保留 TPL 的一部分时失效。本文提出 LibFan，一种基于上下文感知功能建模、基于学习的 Android TPL 检测方法。它通过两个互补组件实现这种建模：方法级的上下文感知对比学习，以及库级的功能划分。在方法级，它通过对比训练学习语义表示，同时融入出向调用关系和类级上下文，提高对混淆、缩减（shrinking）和优化的鲁棒性。在库级，它把每个 TPL 划分为功能内聚的单元，并依据最佳匹配的划分单元判定库是否存在，从而适应部分库复用的情形。为评估 LibFan，我们构建了一个新基准，包含 200 个应用和 46 个存在漏洞的 TPL，每个应用在四种变换配置下编译。在最具挑战性的 R8 完全模式下，LibFan 在库级和版本级分别取得 81.3% 和 47.6% 的 F1 分数，相对现有最优方法分别提升 64.9% 和 35.6%。
summary_cn: LibFan 以上下文感知对比学习与库级功能划分检测 Android 第三方库，R8 完全模式下库级/版本级 F1 为 81.3%/47.6%，较 SOTA 相对提升 64.9%/35.6%。
objective_summary: 提出基于上下文感知对比学习与功能划分的 Android TPL 检测方法 LibFan，在自建的 200 应用、46 个漏洞 TPL、4 种编译变换配置的基准上与现有最优方法对比验证。
evidence_note: 自建 200 应用、46 个 TPL、4 种变换配置并对比现有最优方法；仅单一自建基准，未报告统计检验。
novelty_note: 以功能划分的最佳匹配应对部分库复用，并结合调用与类上下文的对比学习提升抗混淆性。
scope: 适用于 Android 应用、所测 46 个漏洞 TPL 以及 R8 等四种编译变换配置。
limitations: 版本级 F1 仅 47.6%，版本区分仍弱；评估基准为自建，外部代表性未经验证。

title: Short Paper: Prefix Count Limits Can Increase First-Hit Discovery in Card Reissuance
abstract: When a card number is compromised, an attacker may search for active numbers sharing its prefix. An issuer might respond by reissuing cards from heavily populated prefixes into less populated ones. We show that this intuitive count control can backfire. For fixed search regions, exposure weights, and total activity, we derive exactly when reducing the maximum prefix count increases the chance that a budgeted search finds an active number. In matched synthetic simulations over 50,000 candidates, targeted replacement meets the count limit in every run but raises supplied-12-digit-prefix discovery relative to equal-volume random replacement in three of twelve settings. Thus a lower prefix count does not by itself certify lower enumeration risk.

title_cn: 短文：前缀计数上限可能提高卡片重发中的首次命中发现率
abstract_cn: 当一个卡号被泄露时，攻击者可能会搜索与其共享前缀的活跃卡号。发卡机构的一种应对方式是把卡片从高密度前缀重发到低密度前缀中。我们表明，这种直觉上的计数控制可能适得其反。在固定的搜索区域、暴露权重和总活跃量下，我们精确推导出降低最大前缀计数何时会提高有预算的搜索找到活跃卡号的概率。在覆盖 50,000 个候选号码的匹配合成模拟中，定向替换在每次运行中都满足计数上限，但在十二种设置中的三种里，其已知 12 位前缀条件下的发现率相对于等量随机替换有所上升。因此，更低的前缀计数本身并不能证明枚举风险更低。
summary_cn: 推导降低最大前缀计数何时反而提高有预算枚举搜索命中活跃卡号的概率；50,000 候选的合成模拟中，定向替换在 12 种设置里有 3 种的发现率高于等量随机替换。
objective_summary: 为卡片重发中的前缀计数上限策略建立搜索模型，推导其提高枚举命中概率的精确条件，并以 50,000 候选的匹配合成模拟、以等量随机替换为对照加以验证。
evidence_note: 给出精确条件推导，并有 50,000 候选、12 种设置、以等量随机替换为对照的匹配合成模拟；无真实发卡数据。
novelty_note: 指出直觉上的前缀计数控制可能反而提高枚举风险，是对一种现有缓解做法的反例刻画。
scope: 在固定搜索区域、暴露权重与总活跃量的模型假设及合成候选空间下成立。
limitations: 仅用合成数据模拟，未在真实发卡分布与实际攻击者搜索策略下验证。

title: How Much Must a Private Mempool Hide? Exact Leakage Thresholds for Sandwich Attacks
abstract: Private and encrypted mempools hide pending transactions to stop sandwich attacks and other forms of maximal extractable value (MEV), but what they hide is rarely everything: a transaction's pair, direction, and a coarse range for its size can still leak. How much leakage makes sandwiching pay? We answer exactly for a fee-free constant-product automated market maker, the pricing rule behind Uniswap v2. Traders observe an interval containing the victim's size and bid in a first-price auction for the right to sandwich it, and the winning front-run must keep the victim's trade executable at every size in the interval. The answer turns on the smallest size consistent with the leak. It alone determines the feasible front-runs, the largest feasible front-run is optimal for pointwise, expected, and worst-case profit alike, and the guaranteed profit has a closed form. When execution is costly, a privacy layer that wants to rule out sandwiches profitable at every consistent size may therefore reveal anything about the size except a lower bound above an explicit threshold; the upper end of the range is irrelevant. With two or more symmetric traders, every pure-strategy perfect Bayesian equilibrium of the auction hands the entire expected net rent to the auctioneer. If the direction is hidden too, no non-contingent first leg front-runs both possible directions, while post-trade arbitrage can survive even perfect pre-trade hiding.
comment: 23 pages, 1 figure, 1 table. Accepted to NeurIPS 2026
title_cn: 私有内存池必须隐藏多少？三明治攻击的精确泄露阈值
abstract_cn: 私有与加密内存池通过隐藏待处理交易来阻止三明治攻击及其他形式的最大可提取价值（MEV），但它们隐藏的内容很少是全部：交易的交易对、方向以及其规模的粗略范围仍可能泄露。多少泄露会让三明治攻击有利可图？我们针对无手续费的恒定乘积自动做市商（即 Uniswap v2 背后的定价规则）给出精确答案。交易者观察到一个包含受害者交易规模的区间，并在第一价格拍卖中竞价以获得对其实施三明治攻击的权利，且获胜的抢跑交易必须保证受害者交易在该区间内的每一种规模下都可执行。答案取决于与泄露信息相容的最小规模。仅这一最小规模就决定了可行的抢跑交易；最大的可行抢跑交易在逐点利润、期望利润与最坏情形利润意义下同样最优，且保证利润有闭式表达。因此，当执行有成本时，一个希望排除在所有相容规模下都有利可图的三明治攻击的隐私层，可以透露关于规模的任何信息，唯独不能透露高于某一显式阈值的下界；区间的上端无关紧要。当存在两个或更多对称交易者时，该拍卖的每个纯策略完美贝叶斯均衡都会把全部期望净租金交给拍卖者。如果方向也被隐藏，则不存在能同时对两种可能方向实施抢跑的非条件性第一笔交易，而即使交易前完全隐藏，交易后的套利仍可能存在。
summary_cn: 在无手续费恒定乘积 AMM 模型下证明三明治攻击可行性只由泄露区间下界决定，给出保证利润闭式解与泄露阈值，多个对称交易者时期望净租金全归拍卖者（NeurIPS'26）。
objective_summary: 在无手续费恒定乘积 AMM 与第一价格拍卖模型下，理论刻画私有内存池泄露规模区间及方向时三明治攻击的可行性、最优抢跑、保证利润与拍卖均衡。
evidence_note: 纯理论结果，给出最优抢跑与保证利润的闭式刻画及均衡分析；摘要未含链上数据实证。
novelty_note: 把「私有内存池需隐藏多少」形式化为精确泄露阈值问题，得出只有规模下界起作用的结论。
scope: 仅适用于无手续费恒定乘积 AMM（Uniswap v2 式）、区间泄露与第一价格拍卖的模型。
limitations: 模型假设无手续费恒定乘积 AMM 与对称交易者，摘要未涉及用真实链上数据检验结论。

title: Towards Understanding LLM-Based Log Anomaly Detection: An Empirical Study of Performance, Efficiency, and Robustness
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated promising performance in log anomaly detection, yet how their adaptation strategies, architectures, and deployment configurations affect detection effectiveness remains insufficiently understood. To investigate these factors, we conduct a systematic empirical analysis across three public log datasets, examining different adaptation strategies, model architectures, parameter scales, and quantization settings. Our results reveal substantial performance differences across adaptation strategies, while model scaling yields varying detection gains across datasets. We further observe that models with comparable detection accuracy can exhibit markedly different computational costs, and that low-bit quantization largely preserves detection performance in the evaluated configurations. Finally, we examine detection robustness under structural, semantic, and label noise at different perturbation levels. These findings provide empirical insights into the performance, efficiency, and robustness of LLM-based log anomaly detection, highlighting practical considerations beyond conventional accuracy-oriented evaluation.

title_cn: 理解基于 LLM 的日志异常检测：关于性能、效率与鲁棒性的实证研究
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLM）已在日志异常检测中展现出有前景的性能，但其适配策略、架构与部署配置如何影响检测效果仍未得到充分理解。为考察这些因素，我们在三个公开日志数据集上开展系统的实证分析，考察不同的适配策略、模型架构、参数规模与量化设置。结果显示，不同适配策略之间存在较大的性能差异，而模型扩展在不同数据集上带来的检测增益各不相同。我们还观察到，检测准确率相当的模型可能表现出明显不同的计算开销，并且在所评估的配置中，低比特量化在很大程度上保持了检测性能。最后，我们考察了在不同扰动水平下，结构噪声、语义噪声与标签噪声对检测鲁棒性的影响。这些发现为基于 LLM 的日志异常检测在性能、效率与鲁棒性方面提供了实证见解，突出了传统以准确率为导向的评估之外的实际考量。
summary_cn: 在三个公开日志数据集上系统比较 LLM 日志异常检测的适配策略、架构、参数规模与量化设置，并测试结构/语义/标签噪声下的鲁棒性；发现适配策略间差异大、低比特量化基本不损检测性能。
objective_summary: 在三个公开日志数据集上比较 LLM 日志异常检测的适配策略、架构、参数规模与量化设置，并在不同强度的结构、语义与标签噪声下测试鲁棒性。
evidence_note: 三个公开数据集上的多因素系统对比与多级扰动实验；6 页篇幅，摘要未给出具体模型、数值与统计检验。
novelty_note: 把效率、量化与噪声鲁棒性纳入 LLM 日志异常检测评估，结论多为可预期的趋势。
scope: 结论限于三个公开日志数据集与所评估的模型、适配策略及量化配置。
limitations: 数据集与模型覆盖有限，作者自陈量化结论只在所评估的配置中成立。

title: AgentXploit: Autonomous Repository-to-Runtime Red-Teaming for AI Agents
abstract: AI agents combine language models with external data and tools that can modify files, call APIs, or execute code. Security failures can arise when adversarial content changes an agent's tool use or when the surrounding software contains vulnerabilities such as path traversal or command injection. We study authorized white-box pre-deployment auditing, where the auditor has access to the target repository and a controlled runtime, but successful attacks must still act through the task-defined attacker interface and be confirmed by an external verifier. We present AgentXploit, a two-role auditing system that separates repository-level attack-path discovery from runtime exploitation. The Analyzer Agent traces attacker-controlled inputs to sensitive operations and records code-supported candidate attack paths; the Exploiter Agent turns these paths into concrete attacks and revises them using runtime feedback. We also introduce AgentXploit-Bench, containing 72 reproducible vulnerabilities across 12 open-source AI-agent systems and frameworks. Across three runs, AgentXploit reaches 59.3% end-to-end success, compared with 38.4% for Codex. Under a token-budget-matched comparison, Codex reaches 46.3%. On AgentDojo, where injection points are provided, the Exploiter Agent reaches 79.2% attack success versus 52.7% for AgentVigil. These results highlight repository discovery and runtime exploitation as distinct challenges in end-to-end agent security auditing.
comment: 20 pages, 2 figures
title_cn: AgentXploit：面向 AI 智能体的从仓库到运行时的自主红队测试
abstract_cn: AI 智能体将语言模型与外部数据和工具相结合，这些工具可以修改文件、调用 API 或执行代码。当对抗性内容改变智能体的工具使用，或周边软件存在路径遍历、命令注入等漏洞时，就可能产生安全失效。我们研究经授权的白盒部署前审计：审计者可以访问目标代码仓库和受控运行时，但成功的攻击仍必须通过任务定义的攻击者接口实施，并由外部验证器确认。我们提出 AgentXploit，一个将仓库级攻击路径发现与运行时利用分离开来的双角色审计系统。Analyzer Agent 追踪攻击者可控输入到敏感操作的路径，并记录有代码支撑的候选攻击路径；Exploiter Agent 将这些路径转化为具体攻击，并利用运行时反馈对其进行修正。我们还提出 AgentXploit-Bench，包含 12 个开源 AI 智能体系统与框架中的 72 个可复现漏洞。在三次运行中，AgentXploit 达到 59.3% 的端到端成功率，而 Codex 为 38.4%。在 token 预算匹配的比较下，Codex 达到 46.3%。在已给定注入点的 AgentDojo 上，Exploiter Agent 达到 79.2% 的攻击成功率，而 AgentVigil 为 52.7%。这些结果表明，仓库发现与运行时利用是端到端智能体安全审计中两个不同的挑战。
summary_cn: 双角色审计系统 AgentXploit 在 72 个漏洞的基准上端到端成功率 59.3%（Codex 38.4%，等预算 46.3%），AgentDojo 上 79.2%（AgentVigil 52.7%）。
objective_summary: 构建含 12 个系统 72 个可复现漏洞的 AgentXploit-Bench，以三次运行、token 预算匹配的 Codex 对照及 AgentDojo 上的 AgentVigil 对比评估双角色审计系统 AgentXploit。
evidence_note: 72 个漏洞、12 个系统、三次运行，含预算匹配的 Codex 对照与 AgentDojo 基准；未报告统计检验。
novelty_note: 把仓库级攻击路径发现与运行时利用拆成两个角色，并提供面向智能体系统的可复现漏洞基准。
scope: 适用于可访问源码与受控运行时的授权白盒部署前审计，以及所选 12 个开源智能体系统。
limitations: 依赖白盒仓库访问，不覆盖黑盒线上场景；基准规模为 72 个漏洞，端到端成功率仍约六成。

title: Revisiting Certified Defense with Differential Privacy on Vision Transformers
abstract: Certified defenses that incorporate differential privacy have proven effective on Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), furnishing rigorous robustness guarantees against norm-bounded adversaries. However, the certified robustness behavior of Pixel Differential Privacy (PixelDP) remains largely unexplored with the self-attention architecture now dominating the deep-learning landscape. Given that the Transformer has a profound impact on our daily applications from the digital world to the physical world, it is crucial to study certified robustness through differential-privacy-style stability. To fill this research gap, we revisit this construction in Vision Transformers and identify a failure mode that is largely hidden in the convolutional setting. When noise is injected after the patch embedding, the Laplace mechanism with the inherited grouped $\ell_1$ sensitivity bound collapses to chance-level accuracy across noise scales, whereas the Gaussian mechanism remains trainable. This contrast isolates the source of failure: not the injected noise itself, but the geometry of the sensitivity constraint. We show that the attenuation induced by the inherited $\Delta_{1,1}$ projection increases with layer width and kernel size according to a random-matrix scale $C/(\sqrt{M}+\sqrt{N})$. Replacing the $\ell_1$-type constraint with a spectral-norm constraint eliminates the collapse across datasets and architectures, but creates a fundamental obstacle: the repaired models no longer satisfy the sensitivity condition required by the standard Laplace certificate. We resolve this mismatch by deriving a dimension-free $(\varepsilon,\ \delta)$-privacy guarantee for the Laplace mechanism under $\ell_2$ sensitivity through concentration of the privacy loss.
title_cn: 重新审视视觉 Transformer 上基于差分隐私的认证防御
abstract_cn: 融合差分隐私的认证防御已在卷积神经网络（CNN）上被证明有效，能够针对范数有界的对手提供严格的鲁棒性保证。然而，在如今主导深度学习格局的自注意力架构上，像素差分隐私（PixelDP）的认证鲁棒性行为在很大程度上仍未被探索。鉴于 Transformer 对我们从数字世界到物理世界的日常应用都有深远影响，通过差分隐私式的稳定性来研究认证鲁棒性至关重要。为填补这一研究空白，我们在视觉 Transformer 中重新审视这一构造，并发现了一种在卷积设置中基本被掩盖的失效模式。当噪声在 patch 嵌入之后注入时，沿用分组 ℓ1 敏感度界的 Laplace 机制在各个噪声尺度上都坍缩到随机猜测水平的准确率，而 Gaussian 机制仍可训练。这一对比隔离出了失效的根源：不是注入的噪声本身，而是敏感度约束的几何形状。我们表明，沿用的 Δ_(1,1) 投影所引起的衰减随层宽与核大小增大，符合随机矩阵尺度 C/(√M+√N)。将 ℓ1 型约束替换为谱范数约束，可在各数据集与架构上消除坍缩，但带来一个根本障碍：修复后的模型不再满足标准 Laplace 证书所要求的敏感度条件。我们通过隐私损失的集中性，为 ℓ2 敏感度下的 Laplace 机制推导出一个与维度无关的 (ε, δ) 隐私保证，从而解决了这一不匹配。
summary_cn: 在 ViT 上重审 PixelDP：沿用 ℓ1 敏感度约束的 Laplace 机制准确率坍缩至随机水平，改用谱范数约束修复，并推导 ℓ2 敏感度下维度无关的 (ε, δ) 保证。
objective_summary: 在视觉 Transformer 上重审 PixelDP 认证防御，分析 Laplace 机制坍缩的原因，用谱范数约束加以修复，并推导 ℓ2 敏感度下 Laplace 机制的维度无关隐私保证。
evidence_note: 跨噪声尺度对比 Laplace 与 Gaussian，修复在多数据集与架构上验证并有理论推导；未给数据集名与准确率。
novelty_note: 揭示在 CNN 中被掩盖的敏感度几何失效模式，并补上 ℓ2 敏感度下的 Laplace 证书。
scope: 结论针对噪声注入在 patch 嵌入之后的 PixelDP 式 ViT 认证防御与范数有界对手。
limitations: 摘要未报告修复后模型的认证半径与准确率，也未提及与其他认证防御的比较。

title: Resource-Optimized and Energy-Aware Agentic AI Framework Anchored on Blockchain for Secure Software Supply Chains
abstract: This paper proposes a blockchain-backed agentic security framework designed to safeguard the complete software development lifecycle (SDLC) while also securing the agentic AI components responsible for monitoring it. The framework coordinates a set of specialised security agents, covering source integrity, dependency and SBOM analysis, CI configura tion auditing, artifact verification, and runtime policy evaluation, each supported by a large language model (LLM) that interprets artefacts, reasons over tool outputs, and produces structured security reports. To ensure agent trustworthiness, every agent generates a cryptographically signed attestation that is recorded in a permissioned blockchain via smart contracts, including an agent registry, an immutable attestation log, and an enforceable release-policy module. Communication among agents and with blockchain nodes is secured using a consortium-operated certificate authority, ensuring authenticated and tamper-resistant interactions. A detailed use-case and sequence flow demonstrate how a source code security agent performs analysis, anchors its attestation on-chain, and triggers a verifiable allow/block deployment decision. The proposed framework of fers decentralised integrity transparent provenance, uninterrupted security assurance and a generalisable architecture to incorporate the agentic AI into the modern software supply chain security.

title_cn: 面向安全软件供应链、以区块链为锚的资源优化与能耗感知智能体 AI 框架
abstract_cn: 本文提出一个由区块链支撑的智能体安全框架，旨在保护完整的软件开发生命周期（SDLC），同时保护负责监控它的智能体 AI 组件。该框架协调一组专门的安全智能体，涵盖源代码完整性、依赖与 SBOM 分析、CI 配置审计、制品验证以及运行时策略评估，每个智能体都由一个大语言模型（LLM）支持，由其解读制品、对工具输出进行推理并生成结构化安全报告。为确保智能体的可信性，每个智能体都会生成经过密码学签名的证明，并通过智能合约记录在许可链中，这些智能合约包括智能体注册表、不可篡改的证明日志以及可强制执行的发布策略模块。智能体之间以及智能体与区块链节点之间的通信通过联盟运营的证书颁发机构加以保护，确保交互经过认证且防篡改。一个详细的用例与时序流程演示了源代码安全智能体如何执行分析、将其证明锚定上链，并触发可验证的允许/阻止部署决策。所提框架提供了去中心化的完整性、透明的溯源、不间断的安全保证，以及将智能体 AI 纳入现代软件供应链安全的可推广架构。
summary_cn: 提出区块链锚定的多智能体供应链安全框架：LLM 智能体审计源码、依赖/SBOM、CI 与制品，签名证明上链并驱动放行决策，仅以用例演示。
objective_summary: 提出由 LLM 安全智能体、许可链上的签名证明与联盟 CA 组成的软件供应链安全架构，并以一个源代码安全智能体的用例与时序流程说明其运作。
evidence_note: 仅以单个用例与时序流程演示；摘要未给出定量实验、基线或数据，标题所称资源与能耗优化未见数据支撑。
novelty_note: 将 LLM 智能体、区块链证明与 PKI 组合用于 SDLC，属已有组件的常规组合。
scope: 设定为许可链与联盟 CA 可用的 SDLC 环境，结论停留在架构层面的设计主张。
limitations: 缺乏实验评估；签名证明只保证报告来源与完整性，不能保证 LLM 分析结论正确。

title: Deduplication-while-Training: A Resilient Paradigm for Privacy-Preserving Cross-Client Deduplication in Federated Learning
abstract: Cross-client duplicate data in large language model training corpora degrades the efficiency of federated learning (FL) while exacerbating model memorization and privacy risks. Privacy-preserving cross-client deduplication effectively mitigates this issue by eliminating duplicate training data. However, existing schemes all follow a "Deduplication-before-Training" paradigm. This serially coupled paradigm incurs high fault-tolerance costs and lacks support for dynamic client joining. To this end, we propose an unexplored paradigm called "Deduplication-while-Training (DwT)", which enables concurrent deduplication and training. DwT transforms cross-client deduplication from a one-time, globally synchronous preprocessing operation into a continuous online service with state management, concurrent claiming, and failure recovery. By enabling state synchronization and task takeover, it minimizes the impact of client disconnections on the overall training progress while supporting the dynamic joining of clients. We design DwT-FL, a privacy-preserving deduplication system, to support DwT. By designing a concurrent state-claim mechanism and a hot-cold dual-queue scheduling strategy, DwT-FL enables the parallel execution of secure deduplication and model training, while effectively handling client disconnections and dynamic joins. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that, compared to the state-of-the-art scheme, DwT-FL significantly reduces the time overhead of failure recovery and dynamic joining by up to 93.04% and 94.18%, respectively. This provides an efficient and elastic concurrent deduplication scheme for dynamic and unstable FL environments.
title_cn: 边训练边去重：联邦学习中隐私保护跨客户端去重的弹性范式
abstract_cn: 大语言模型训练语料中的跨客户端重复数据会降低联邦学习（FL）的效率，同时加剧模型记忆与隐私风险。隐私保护的跨客户端去重通过消除重复训练数据有效缓解了这一问题。然而，现有方案都遵循「先去重后训练」范式。这种串行耦合的范式带来很高的容错成本，且不支持客户端动态加入。为此，我们提出一种尚未被探索的范式，称为「边训练边去重（DwT）」，使去重与训练能够并发进行。DwT 将跨客户端去重从一次性、全局同步的预处理操作，转变为具备状态管理、并发认领与故障恢复的持续在线服务。通过支持状态同步与任务接管，它将客户端掉线对整体训练进度的影响降到最低，同时支持客户端动态加入。我们设计了隐私保护去重系统 DwT-FL 以支持 DwT。通过设计并发状态认领机制与冷热双队列调度策略，DwT-FL 使安全去重与模型训练能够并行执行，同时有效处理客户端掉线与动态加入。实验评估表明，与最先进方案相比，DwT-FL 将故障恢复与动态加入的时间开销显著降低，降幅分别最高达 93.04% 和 94.18%。这为动态且不稳定的 FL 环境提供了一种高效且有弹性的并发去重方案。
summary_cn: 提出「边训练边去重」范式与系统 DwT-FL，用并发状态认领与冷热双队列调度让隐私保护去重与 FL 训练并行，相比最先进方案故障恢复与动态加入时间开销最多降低 93.04% 与 94.18%。
objective_summary: 提出边训练边去重范式及系统 DwT-FL，以并发状态认领与冷热双队列调度并行执行安全去重与训练，并与最先进方案比较故障恢复与动态加入的时间开销。
evidence_note: 与一个最先进方案对比，报告最多 93.04% 与 94.18% 的时间降低；摘要未给出客户端数、数据规模与重复实验。
novelty_note: 把跨客户端去重从一次性预处理改为可容错的在线并发服务，属系统设计上的实质改进。
scope: 结论适用于存在客户端掉线与动态加入的 FL 场景中跨客户端去重的时间开销。
limitations: 评估聚焦时间开销，摘要未报告对模型记忆或隐私风险的实际缓解效果及隐私保证分析。

title: The planted tensor problem over finite fields: algorithms and cryptography
abstract: Inspired by the planted clique problem for random graphs, we introduce the planted totally-isotropic space problem for random tensors as follows. Let $U\cong \mathbb{F}_q^n$ and $W\cong \mathbb{F}_q^m$ be finite-dimensional vector spaces over a finite field $\mathbb{F}_q$. Given $d\in \mathbb{N}$, choose a random \(d\)-dimensional subspace \(V\leq U\), and construct a random alternating bilinear map $\phi:U\times U\to W$ subject to the constraint \(\phi(V,V)=0\). Such a $V$ is known as a totally-isotropic space of $\phi$, and the goal is to recover $V$. Building on the recent probabilistic analysis of random tensors (Pham--Qiao--Wigderson--Wigderson, \emph{in progress}), we initiate the study of the algorithmic hardness of this problem. Setting $m=\lceil n/\log n\rceil$, we show that this problem admits an average-case polynomial-time algorithm for $d\geq n/2$, by leveraging recent advances on the non-commutative rank problem. We also show that this problem admits a $q^{O(n\log n)}$-time algorithm. We carry out algorithmic experiments using polynomial-system solving. From these results, we conjecture that the planted totally-isotropic space problem for $d=\lceil n/C\rceil$ with some constant $C\geq 3$ is exponentially hard. Based on this evidence of computational hardness, we explore cryptographic applications of the planted totally-isotropic space problem and related planted tensor problems. We present private simultaneous messages and secret sharing protocols based on planted tensor problems, following the protocols based on planted subgraphs in (Abram--Beimel--Ishai--Kushilevitz--Narayanan, \emph{TCC}'23). At the same security level, the public information size of protocols based on planted subgraphs is (moderately) exponential in that of protocols based on planted tensors, while the communication costs of these protocols are polynomially related.

title_cn: 有限域上的种植张量问题：算法与密码学
abstract_cn: 受随机图中种植团问题的启发，我们为随机张量引入如下的种植全迷向子空间问题。设 U ≅ F_q^n 与 W ≅ F_q^m 是有限域 F_q 上的有限维向量空间。给定 d ∈ N，随机选取一个 d 维子空间 V ≤ U，并在约束 φ(V,V)=0 下构造一个随机交错双线性映射 φ: U×U→W。这样的 V 称为 φ 的全迷向子空间，目标是恢复 V。基于近期对随机张量的概率分析（Pham–Qiao–Wigderson–Wigderson，进行中），我们开启了对该问题算法难度的研究。令 m=⌈n/log n⌉，我们借助非交换秩问题的最新进展，证明该问题在 d ≥ n/2 时存在平均情形多项式时间算法。我们还证明该问题存在 q^(O(n log n)) 时间的算法。我们利用多项式系统求解开展了算法实验。根据这些结果，我们猜想：对某个常数 C ≥ 3，d=⌈n/C⌉ 时的种植全迷向子空间问题是指数困难的。基于这些计算困难性的证据，我们探索了种植全迷向子空间问题及相关种植张量问题的密码学应用。我们仿照（Abram–Beimel–Ishai–Kushilevitz–Narayanan，TCC'23）中基于种植子图的协议，提出了基于种植张量问题的私有同时消息协议与秘密共享协议。在相同安全级别下，基于种植子图的协议的公开信息规模是基于种植张量的协议的（适度）指数级，而这些协议的通信开销之间是多项式相关的。
summary_cn: 引入种植全迷向子空间问题，给出 d≥n/2 的平均情形多项式算法，猜想 d=⌈n/C⌉ 时指数困难，并据此构造公开信息更小的私有同时消息与秘密共享协议。
objective_summary: 定义有限域上的种植全迷向子空间问题，给出多项式时间与 q^(O(n log n)) 时间算法并做多项式系统求解实验，据此构造私有同时消息与秘密共享协议。
evidence_note: 40 页论文给出算法结果的证明并辅以多项式系统求解实验；核心的指数困难性仅为基于实验证据的猜想。
novelty_note: 新提出种植张量类问题，把种植团式困难性假设迁移到张量上并据此构建密码协议。
scope: 算法结论在 m=⌈n/log n⌉ 的参数设定下成立；协议安全性依赖 d=⌈n/C⌉ 的困难性猜想。
limitations: 协议安全性建立在未经证明的困难性猜想上，支撑该猜想的主要是算法实验证据。

title: Peregrino: A Full-Hardware Accelerator for the Complete Falcon Post-Quantum Digital Signature Scheme on Resource-Constrained Edge Devices
abstract: The arrival of quantum computers threatens the security guarantees of classical cryptography, since quantum algorithms can break schemes that remain secure against conventional attacks. The National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) has therefore standardized a set of post-quantum cryptographic algorithms, among them Falcon, a lattice-based digital signature scheme with the most compact signature and public-key sizes of the standardized candidates. Falcon's reliance on floating-point arithmetic makes it hard to implement in hardware, and prior work offers only partial accelerators for specific operations such as signature generation or verification, or a single full implementation generated through high-level synthesis (HLS). This work presents Peregrino, the first hardware accelerator of the complete Falcon digital signature scheme designed from scratch in HDL, targeting resource-constrained edge devices without a native floating-point unit through an emulated floating-point datapath. Implemented on a single Artix 7 XC7A200T FPGA, Peregrino uses 85261 LUTs, 41382 FFs, 44 BRAMs, and 142 DSPs for the Falcon-1024 variant. Against the only prior full implementation, the HLS-based FalconTakesOff, it uses 1,9$\times$ fewer LUTs, 3,4$\times$ fewer FFs, 2,7$\times$ fewer BRAMs, and 9,9$\times$ fewer DSPs, fitting the entire scheme on one FPGA where the HLS design requires at least two. Operating as a peripheral of an on-chip MicroBlaze soft-core, the accelerator additionally reduces key-pair generation, signature generation, and signature verification clock cycles by 92\%, 96\%, and 85\% over the emulated floating-point reference software.
title_cn: Peregrino：面向资源受限边缘设备的完整 Falcon 后量子数字签名方案全硬件加速器
abstract_cn: 量子计算机的到来威胁着经典密码学的安全保证，因为量子算法能够攻破那些对传统攻击仍然安全的方案。因此，美国国家标准与技术研究院（NIST）标准化了一组后量子密码算法，其中包括 Falcon——一种基于格的数字签名方案，在已标准化的候选方案中拥有最紧凑的签名与公钥尺寸。Falcon 对浮点运算的依赖使其难以用硬件实现，先前工作只提供了针对特定操作（如签名生成或验证）的部分加速器，或是一个通过高层次综合（HLS）生成的完整实现。本文提出 Peregrino，首个用 HDL 从零设计的完整 Falcon 数字签名方案硬件加速器，通过模拟浮点数据通路，面向没有原生浮点单元的资源受限边缘设备。Peregrino 在单片 Artix 7 XC7A200T FPGA 上实现，Falcon-1024 变体使用 85261 个 LUT、41382 个 FF、44 个 BRAM 和 142 个 DSP。与唯一已有的完整实现——基于 HLS 的 FalconTakesOff 相比，它使用的 LUT 少 1.9 倍、FF 少 3.4 倍、BRAM 少 2.7 倍、DSP 少 9.9 倍，可将整个方案放入一片 FPGA，而 HLS 设计至少需要两片。作为片上 MicroBlaze 软核的外设运行时，该加速器相比模拟浮点的参考软件，还将密钥对生成、签名生成与签名验证的时钟周期分别减少 92%、96% 和 85%。
summary_cn: 以 HDL 从零实现完整 Falcon 签名的 FPGA 加速器 Peregrino：较 HLS 方案 DSP 少 9.9 倍、单片即可容纳，三项操作时钟周期较参考软件降 85–96%。
objective_summary: 以 HDL 从零设计完整 Falcon 签名方案的硬件加速器 Peregrino，在 Artix 7 FPGA 上实现，并与 HLS 方案 FalconTakesOff 及模拟浮点参考软件比较资源占用与时钟周期。
evidence_note: 单片 Artix 7 上的资源占用，与唯一完整实现及参考软件对比；摘要仅给出 Falcon-1024 数据。
novelty_note: 首个以 HDL 手写的完整 Falcon 硬件实现，用模拟浮点替代 FPU，属工程上的实质改进。
scope: 结论限于 Artix 7 XC7A200T、Falcon-1024 与 MicroBlaze 外设架构下的资源和周期数。
limitations: 摘要未报告绝对时延、功耗或侧信道防护，完整实现的对比基线只有一个 HLS 设计。

title: Geometric Inconsistency Localization in Multi-View Image Sets
abstract: Novel view synthesis (NVS) models can produce realistic new views of the same scene from different viewpoints. However, these generated views are not always geometrically consistent with one another. Multi-view (MV) consistency has shown promise as a tool for evaluating these NVS models. Its potential for multimedia forensics, however, remains largely unexplored, particularly for localizing geometric inconsistencies across wide-baseline image pairs. To enable research in this direction, we introduce DeformView, a wide-baseline MV dataset with pixel-level annotations of geometric inconsistencies. Using DeformView, we evaluate state-of-the-art MV consistency-scoring methods and show that approaches developed for NVS evaluation transfer poorly to the forensic task of geometric inconsistency localization. To address this limitation, we propose DEFECt3R, a lightweight learning-based classifier that uses cross-view feature relationships to localize geometric inconsistencies at the pixel level. By learning from explicit supervision, including hard negatives from geometrically consistent yet deformed views, DEFECt3R improves localization performance and substantially reduces false positives compared to existing consistency-scoring methods. Ablation experiments further show that both feature representations and correspondence quality contribute to localization performance. Overall, our findings demonstrate that MV geometric consistency is a promising yet underexplored signal for multimedia forensics and establish a benchmark and baseline for geometric inconsistency localization in wide-baseline MV image pairs. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/IDLabMedia/DeformView-DEFECt3R

title_cn: 多视图图像集中的几何不一致定位
abstract_cn: 新视角合成（NVS）模型能够从不同视点生成同一场景的逼真新视图。然而，这些生成的视图之间并不总是几何一致的。多视图（MV）一致性已显示出作为评估 NVS 模型工具的潜力。然而，它在多媒体取证中的潜力在很大程度上仍未被探索，尤其是在宽基线图像对之间定位几何不一致方面。为推动这一方向的研究，我们提出 DeformView，一个带有像素级几何不一致标注的宽基线 MV 数据集。借助 DeformView，我们评估了最先进的 MV 一致性评分方法，并表明为 NVS 评估而开发的方法很难迁移到几何不一致定位这一取证任务上。为解决这一局限，我们提出 DEFECt3R，一个轻量级的基于学习的分类器，利用跨视图特征关系在像素级定位几何不一致。通过从显式监督中学习（包括来自几何一致但经过形变的视图的困难负样本），DEFECt3R 相比现有一致性评分方法提升了定位性能，并大幅减少了误报。消融实验进一步表明，特征表示与对应关系质量都对定位性能有贡献。总体而言，我们的发现表明 MV 几何一致性是多媒体取证中一个有前景但尚未被充分探索的信号，并为宽基线 MV 图像对中的几何不一致定位建立了基准与基线。代码与数据集见 https://github.com/IDLabMedia/DeformView-DEFECt3R
summary_cn: 构建像素级标注的宽基线多视图数据集 DeformView，发现 NVS 一致性评分方法难以迁移到取证定位，并提出轻量分类器 DEFECt3R 降低误报（ACM MM'26 DFF Workshop）。
objective_summary: 构建带像素级标注的宽基线多视图数据集 DeformView，评估现有 MV 一致性评分方法，并提出分类器 DEFECt3R，以对比实验与消融验证。
evidence_note: 有新数据集、与现有一致性评分方法的对比及消融实验；摘要未给出数据规模与具体指标数值。
novelty_note: 把多视图几何一致性引入宽基线图像对的取证定位这一较少探索的任务，并提供像素级标注数据。
scope: 结论限于 DeformView 中的宽基线多视图图像对及其所含的几何不一致类型。
limitations: 评估基本限于自建的 DeformView 数据集，摘要未体现跨数据集泛化。

title: HyperErase: Scale-Calibrated Hypernetwork for Multi-Concept Erasure in Text-to-Image Models
abstract: Recent advances in text-to-image (T2I) generation have substantially improved visual synthesis, but have also raised increasing safety concerns due to their potential to generate harmful or undesirable content. Existing concept erasure methods predominantly follow a static weight paradigm, producing a single frozen adapter that struggles to adapt to diverse prompt variations and suffers from parameter interference when scaling to multiple concepts. We propose \textbf{HyperErase}, a framework for concept erasure based on hypernetwork-driven prompt-conditioned parameter synthesis. Our approach first reframes concept erasure as prompt-conditioned parameter amortization and trains a hypernetwork to map textual descriptions to prompt-specific LoRA updates, eliminating the need for per-prompt gradient optimization or manual LoRA merging. To further improve the stability and precision of synthesized adapters, we develop a decoupled rectification strategy, which disentangles LoRA tokens into pattern and scale subspaces, applies a square-root transform to curb multiplicative over-scaling, and leverages teacher-derived canonical priors for inference-time correction. Extensive experiments across major concept categories demonstrate that HyperErase consistently improves the trade-off between erasure effectiveness, image quality, and semantic alignment, achieving performance comparable to gold-standard single-concept baselines. Furthermore, the resulting models can provide specialized LoRAs for each input prompt variation in a single forward pass without requiring gradient updates during inference. These principled and flexible framework offers a new paradigm for concept erasure in T2I models.
title_cn: HyperErase：面向文本到图像模型多概念擦除的尺度校准超网络
abstract_cn: 文本到图像（T2I）生成的最新进展大幅提升了视觉合成能力，但由于其可能生成有害或不良内容，也引发了日益增长的安全担忧。现有概念擦除方法主要遵循静态权重范式，产出单一的冻结适配器，难以适应多样的提示变化，并且在扩展到多个概念时会遭受参数干扰。我们提出 HyperErase，一个基于超网络驱动的提示条件化参数合成的概念擦除框架。我们的方法首先把概念擦除重构为提示条件化的参数摊销，并训练一个超网络把文本描述映射为针对特定提示的 LoRA 更新，从而无需逐提示的梯度优化或手工 LoRA 合并。为进一步提升合成适配器的稳定性与精度，我们设计了一种解耦校正策略：将 LoRA token 解耦为模式子空间与尺度子空间，施加平方根变换以抑制乘性过度缩放，并利用教师模型导出的规范先验进行推理时校正。在主要概念类别上的大量实验表明，HyperErase 一致地改善了擦除效果、图像质量与语义对齐之间的权衡，性能可与金标准的单概念基线相当。此外，所得模型可在单次前向传播中为每个输入提示变体提供专门的 LoRA，推理时无需梯度更新。这一有原则且灵活的框架为 T2I 模型的概念擦除提供了新范式。
summary_cn: 提出用超网络按提示直接合成 LoRA 更新的多概念擦除框架 HyperErase，配合模式/尺度解耦校正，在擦除效果、图像质量与语义对齐的权衡上可比肩单概念基线，推理无需梯度更新。
objective_summary: 提出以超网络按提示合成 LoRA 更新的多概念擦除框架 HyperErase 及解耦校正策略，在多个概念类别上以擦除效果、图像质量与语义对齐进行评估。
evidence_note: 摘要称在主要概念类别上做了大量实验并与单概念基线比较，但未给出具体数值、模型或数据规模。
novelty_note: 把概念擦除重构为提示条件化参数摊销，以超网络替代静态冻结适配器，属已有方向的实质改进。
scope: 适用于基于 LoRA 适配的 T2I 模型与所测概念类别下的擦除—质量权衡。
limitations: 摘要只称性能与单概念基线相当，未报告对越狱式提示或概念恢复攻击的鲁棒性。

title: JevAdvBench: A Benchmark and Black-Box Attacks for Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions Models
abstract: Models trained with reinforcement learning for calibrated decisions (RLCD), such as Jev, answer a typed question about an input, the state, with a probability, a choice, or a score, and software acts on the answer without a person reading it. Their robustness has not been measured: adversarial benchmarks score what a model generates or executes, whereas a typed model generates nothing and returns a well-formed answer even when manipulated. Measurement is also hard, because identical requests can return different answers, most available labels come from the model itself, and the API preprocesses each request out of view. Our key idea is to score each attacked decision against the model's own clean decision rather than against labels, and to read it against the change caused by an identical re-run. Building on this, we introduce JevAdvBench, to our knowledge the first adversarial benchmark for RLCD models, with 812 typed questions over 66 scenarios, and a black-box attack suite of 9,744 single-edit variants that each edit one part of a request, with billed input tokens confirming that the edit reached the model. On jev-1.13.0, rewording stays within 1.2 percentage points of the re-run baseline, and fields outside the schema never reach the model. In contrast, one unverified opinion appended to the state flips 12.1% of decisions, statistically tied with the strongest injected command (10.1%), and pushes 38% of confident answers below the 0.8 confidence threshold that routes them to human review. Applications built on RLCD models should therefore treat the state as untrusted, argued input. Project website: https://JevAdvBench.github.io/JevAdvBench/
comment: 33 pages, 13 figures, 19 tables. Project website: this https URL
title_cn: JevAdvBench：面向校准决策强化学习模型的基准与黑盒攻击
abstract_cn: 以面向校准决策的强化学习（RLCD）训练的模型（如 Jev）针对一个输入——即状态——回答一个类型化问题，给出概率、选项或分数，软件无需人阅读就依据该答案采取行动。它们的鲁棒性尚未被测量：对抗基准评分的是模型生成或执行的内容，而类型化模型不生成任何内容，即使被操纵也会返回格式良好的答案。测量本身也很困难，因为相同请求可能返回不同答案，大多数可用标签来自模型自身，且 API 在不可见处对每个请求做预处理。我们的核心思路是将每个受攻击的决策与模型自身的干净决策而非标签进行比对，并对照相同请求重跑所引起的变化来解读。在此基础上，我们提出 JevAdvBench——据我们所知首个针对 RLCD 模型的对抗基准，包含覆盖 66 个场景的 812 个类型化问题，以及由 9,744 个单点编辑变体组成的黑盒攻击套件，每个变体只编辑请求的一个部分，并以计费输入 token 确认编辑确实到达了模型。在 jev-1.13.0 上，改写措辞引起的变化与重跑基线相差在 1.2 个百分点以内，模式之外的字段从未到达模型。相比之下，在状态中附加一条未经核实的意见就会翻转 12.1% 的决策，与最强的注入指令（10.1%）在统计上持平，并使 38% 的高置信答案降到 0.8 置信度阈值以下，而该阈值会把答案转交人工审核。因此，基于 RLCD 模型的应用应将状态视为不可信的、带有论辩性内容的输入。项目网站：https://JevAdvBench.github.io/JevAdvBench/
summary_cn: 首个 RLCD 类型化决策模型对抗基准 JevAdvBench（812 题、9,744 个变体）；在 jev-1.13.0 上附加一条未核实意见即翻转 12.1% 决策。
objective_summary: 构建以模型自身干净决策为参照、以重跑变化为噪声基线的对抗基准 JevAdvBench，并在 jev-1.13.0 上用 9,744 个单点编辑黑盒变体测量决策翻转与置信度变化。
evidence_note: 812 题、9,744 个变体，以重跑为噪声对照并做统计比较，以计费 token 核实编辑到达；仅评估单一模型版本 jev-1.13.0。
novelty_note: 针对不生成内容的类型化决策模型，提出以自身干净决策和重跑变化为参照的评分方法，此前无同类基准。
scope: 适用于 jev-1.13.0 这类经 API 提供的类型化决策模型及所设 66 个场景下的单点编辑攻击。
limitations: 只测一个模型的一个版本；仅考察单点编辑，组合编辑或自适应攻击未覆盖。

title: SADRA: Sound Capability-based Access Control System for Resource-Disaggregated Architectures
abstract: Resource disaggregation separates memory and accelerators from compute nodes and makes them remotely accessible. This improves resource sharing, but also removes the local kernel from the resource-access path. Under an untrusted host, compromised host software may use stale authority, exceed delegated authority, or reuse authority provisioned for another process. Prior work identifies capability-based access control as well suited to these architectures. Our systematization of twenty-two prior capability systems finds that none combines host-independent validation of process authority, authoritative enforcement at the resource, and revocation that remains effective while remote authorization state is stale. We present SADRA, a distributed capability-based access-control system for resource-disaggregated architectures. SmartNIC hardware isolated from host software independently checks every inter-node request at two points, first at the compute node against the requesting process's authority and again at the resource against the current authoritative access state. Linked process, compute, and resource capabilities allow these checks to use local state without coordination on the access path. When distributed authority is revoked, SADRA denies subsequent dependent accesses at the resource without waiting for remote nodes to update, while stale capability state is reclaimed separately. We prove capability safety, authority safety, revocation soundness, and strong isolation for a formal architectural model, and model-check the formalization with SPIN. Our FPGA SmartNIC prototype sustains 89.5 Gbit/s aggregate throughput, within run-to-run variation of a non-enforcing baseline that peaks at 90--91 Gbit/s. Cleanup of a 128-capability subtree completes in 528 ns, while access denial does not depend on completion of that cleanup.
comment: 38 pages, 9 figures
title_cn: SADRA：面向资源解耦架构的可靠的基于能力的访问控制系统
abstract_cn: 资源解耦将内存与加速器从计算节点中分离出来，并使其可被远程访问。这改善了资源共享，但也把本地内核从资源访问路径中移除。在主机不可信的情况下，被攻陷的主机软件可能使用过期的权限、超出被委派的权限，或重用为另一进程分配的权限。先前工作指出基于能力（capability）的访问控制非常适合此类架构。我们对二十二个先前能力系统的系统化梳理发现，没有一个同时具备以下三点：独立于主机的进程权限验证、在资源端的权威执行，以及在远程授权状态过期时仍然有效的撤销。我们提出 SADRA，一种面向资源解耦架构的分布式、基于能力的访问控制系统。与主机软件隔离的 SmartNIC 硬件在两个位置独立检查每个节点间请求：先在计算节点依据请求进程的权限检查，再在资源端依据当前的权威访问状态检查。相互链接的进程、计算与资源能力使这些检查能使用本地状态，而无需在访问路径上进行协调。当分布式权限被撤销时，SADRA 在资源端拒绝后续的依赖访问，无需等待远程节点更新，而过期的能力状态则单独回收。我们针对一个形式化体系结构模型证明了能力安全、权限安全、撤销可靠性与强隔离，并用 SPIN 对该形式化进行模型检验。我们的 FPGA SmartNIC 原型维持 89.5 Gbit/s 的聚合吞吐量，处于不执行检查的基线（峰值 90–91 Gbit/s）的运行间波动范围内。清理一棵含 128 个能力的子树耗时 528 ns，而访问拒绝并不依赖于该清理的完成。
summary_cn: SADRA 用与主机隔离的 SmartNIC 在计算端与资源端双重校验能力并支持即时撤销，有形式化证明与 SPIN 检验，FPGA 原型吞吐 89.5 Gbit/s 与无检查基线相当。
objective_summary: 提出基于 SmartNIC 双点校验与链接能力的分布式访问控制系统 SADRA，以形式化证明、SPIN 模型检验及 FPGA 原型的吞吐与撤销清理延迟测量验证。
evidence_note: 22 个系统的系统化对比、形式化证明与 SPIN 模型检验、FPGA 原型对照无检查基线测吞吐；摘要未给真实应用负载下的评估。
novelty_note: 同时实现主机无关的权限验证、资源端权威执行与过期状态下有效撤销，填补所梳理 22 个系统的空白。
scope: 适用于主机不可信、SmartNIC 可信且与主机隔离的资源解耦架构及所建形式化模型。
limitations: 依赖 SmartNIC 硬件可信且与主机隔离；原型性能仅以吞吐与撤销清理延迟衡量。

title: AuthGuard-R: Safety-Compliant Mission Hijacking and Dual-Gate Defense for LLM-Controlled Robots
abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as high-level planners for mobile robots, robot manipulators, and autonomous vehicles. Recent studies show that these systems can be influenced through malicious text, speech, visual instructions, retrieved documents, and poisoned sensory context. Most defenses ask whether a proposed action is physically safe. This paper studies a different problem: an action may be physically safe and still violate the mission authorized by the user. An attacker may redirect a delivery robot, replace an approved object, extend a robot's operating region, activate an unnecessary sensor, or delay a mission without creating an immediate physical hazard. We call this attack \emph{safety-compliant mission hijacking}. We propose MissionPAIR, an adaptive attack framework that searches for executable plans that pass a safety gate while violating an authenticated mission. We also propose AuthGuard-R, a deterministic authorization layer that binds every executable action to a signed mission, robot identity, object and region scope, current state, time, and input provenance. AuthGuard-R operates with an independent safety gate, giving a dual-gate architecture. We formalize mission policies over robot traces, define security games, and prove authorization soundness, mission non-escalation, replay resistance, robot binding, provenance separation, threshold-approval security, audit-log tamper evidence, and trace-level composition. We report a preliminary cross-model evaluation with Claude Haiku~4.5 and the open-source Qwen2.5~7B planner. Across 240 live attack trials, the planners followed an injected mission deviation in 109 trials; AuthGuard-R rejected all 109 resulting unauthorized actions. A separate hand-constructed suite of eleven protocol- and policy-level attacks was also blocked completely.
title_cn: AuthGuard-R：LLM 控制机器人的安全合规任务劫持与双门防御
abstract_cn: 大语言模型日益被用作移动机器人、机械臂和自动驾驶车辆的高层规划器。近期研究表明，这些系统可能受到恶意文本、语音、视觉指令、检索文档以及被投毒的感知上下文的影响。多数防御关注的是拟执行动作在物理上是否安全。本文研究一个不同的问题：一个动作可能在物理上安全，却仍违反用户所授权的任务。攻击者可能改变配送机器人的去向、替换已批准的物体、扩大机器人的作业区域、激活不必要的传感器或延迟任务，而不造成直接的物理危险。我们称此类攻击为安全合规的任务劫持。我们提出 MissionPAIR，一种自适应攻击框架，搜索能通过安全门但违反已认证任务的可执行计划。我们还提出 AuthGuard-R，一个确定性授权层，将每个可执行动作绑定到已签名的任务、机器人身份、物体与区域范围、当前状态、时间及输入来源。AuthGuard-R 与一个独立的安全门协同工作，构成双门架构。我们在机器人轨迹上形式化任务策略，定义安全博弈，并证明授权可靠性、任务不越权、抗重放、机器人绑定、来源分离、门限审批安全性、审计日志篡改可证性以及轨迹级组合性。我们报告了使用 Claude Haiku 4.5 与开源 Qwen2.5 7B 规划器的初步跨模型评估。在 240 次实时攻击试验中，规划器在 109 次试验中遵循了注入的任务偏离；AuthGuard-R 拒绝了由此产生的全部 109 个未授权动作。另一套人工构造的十一种协议级与策略级攻击也被全部阻止。
summary_cn: 提出安全合规的任务劫持威胁、攻击 MissionPAIR 与授权层 AuthGuard-R 并给出证明；240 次攻击中规划器被劫持 109 次，均被 AuthGuard-R 拦截。
objective_summary: 定义物理安全但越权的任务劫持攻击，提出攻击框架 MissionPAIR 与绑定签名任务的授权层 AuthGuard-R，以安全博弈证明及两模型 240 次实时攻击试验验证。
evidence_note: 给出多项安全性质的证明；实证为作者自称初步的两模型 240 次试验与 11 种人工构造攻击，摘要未提与其他防御的对比。
novelty_note: 把威胁从物理不安全扩展到物理安全但违反授权任务的劫持，是既有安全门式防御未覆盖的问题。
scope: 适用于以 LLM 作高层规划器、任务范围可签名形式化的机器人系统与所测两个规划模型。
limitations: 评估为作者自称的初步规模，摘要未提与其他防御对比；需预先以签名固定任务范围，对开放式任务适用性未验证。

title: BenX: Resource-Sharing Permutations for Computational Integrity
abstract: Cryptographic hash functions over integers modulo a prime play a decisive role in the efficiency and security of proof systems for computational integrity. Early designs focused on compact arithmetic circuits and efficient software execution, primarily targeting general-purpose CPUs rather than hardware accelerators. This work focuses on enabling efficient resource sharing and hardware acceleration alongside efficient software execution. We propose BenX, a permutation-based hash function designed for hardware acceleration, fast CPU execution, and low circuit complexity in proof systems. To construct the underlying permutation, we turn the Benes network into an invertible function over $\mathbb{F}_p^2$ using a Dickson polynomial. Its structure yields a permutation particularly suited to hardware resource sharing and acceleration. Fully pipelined on FPGA, BenX matches the throughput of Poseidon2, with 1.36x and 2.15x lower latency for Goldilocks and BabyBear, respectively. Although larger as a standalone core, it makes more effective use of shared hardware: in our dual-mode architecture, where the NTT and hash share field multipliers, BenX keeps 100% of them busy, compared with 6.25-20.3% for the partial rounds of Poseidon and Poseidon2. In software, BenX outperforms Poseidon in all tested 31- and 64-bit configurations, but is slower than Poseidon2, except for the 16-element BabyBear instance. In zero-knowledge proofs, BenX proves Goldilocks permutations 6-10x faster than Monolith. Its compact arithmetization uses about 36% fewer trace cells than Poseidon and Poseidon2 over BabyBear, while its fast variant requires 1.3-2.6x the prover time of Poseidon2.
title_cn: BenX：面向计算完整性的资源共享置换
abstract_cn: 基于素数模整数的密码哈希函数对计算完整性证明系统的效率与安全性起着决定性作用。早期设计侧重紧凑的算术电路与高效的软件执行，主要面向通用 CPU 而非硬件加速器。本工作侧重在高效软件执行的同时实现高效的资源共享与硬件加速。我们提出 BenX，一种为硬件加速、快速 CPU 执行及证明系统中低电路复杂度而设计的基于置换的哈希函数。为构造底层置换，我们利用 Dickson 多项式把 Benes 网络变为 F_p^2 上的可逆函数。其结构产生了一种特别适合硬件资源共享与加速的置换。在 FPGA 上全流水实现时，BenX 的吞吐量与 Poseidon2 相当，在 Goldilocks 和 BabyBear 上的延迟分别降低 1.36 倍和 2.15 倍。尽管作为独立核心规模更大，它能更有效地利用共享硬件：在 NTT 与哈希共享域乘法器的双模式架构中，BenX 让 100% 的乘法器保持忙碌，而 Poseidon 和 Poseidon2 的部分轮仅为 6.25–20.3%。在软件中，BenX 在所有测试的 31 位与 64 位配置上均优于 Poseidon，但慢于 Poseidon2，16 元素 BabyBear 实例除外。在零知识证明中，BenX 证明 Goldilocks 置换的速度比 Monolith 快 6–10 倍。其紧凑的算术化在 BabyBear 上比 Poseidon 和 Poseidon2 少用约 36% 的迹单元，而其快速变体所需的证明者时间为 Poseidon2 的 1.3–2.6 倍。
summary_cn: 用 Dickson 多项式把 Benes 网络变为可逆置换，提出硬件友好的 ZK 哈希 BenX：FPGA 延迟比 Poseidon2 低 1.36–2.15 倍，证明比 Monolith 快 6–10 倍。
objective_summary: 提出基于 Benes 网络与 Dickson 多项式的置换型哈希 BenX，并在 FPGA、CPU 软件与零知识证明系统中与 Poseidon、Poseidon2、Monolith 比较性能。
evidence_note: FPGA、CPU、零知识证明三类平台上与 Poseidon 系列、Monolith 对比性能；摘要未交代密码分析与安全性评估。
novelty_note: 以 Benes 网络结构构造可逆置换并面向乘法器共享设计，是算术化友好哈希方向上的新构造。
scope: 适用于 Goldilocks、BabyBear 等素域上的证明系统及所测 FPGA 与 CPU 配置。
limitations: 摘要未体现安全性分析；软件速度与快速变体的证明者时间仍逊于 Poseidon2，独立核心规模更大。

title: MetaPermit: Scalable and Auditable Access Control for AI Agents via LLM-Inferred Meta-Attributes
abstract: The rise of autonomous AI agents equipped with tools has introduced significant security risks, ranging from unintended tool misuse to adversarial manipulation through Indirect Prompt Injection (IPI) attacks. In practice, deployed agent systems such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code protect tool invocations through a combination of coarse-grained permission rules and LLM-based judgments about individual proposed actions. Both components, however, have important limitations: static policies must anticipate possible user intents and therefore do not scale to open-ended tasks, while LLM-driven authorization supports dynamic decisions but produces inconsistent outcomes and remains vulnerable to targeted IPI attacks. To provide scalable and more consistent authorization, we propose MetaPermit, a policy-based tool access-control framework that decouples semantic inference from security enforcement. By analyzing agent-user interactions, we derive a compact, task-independent set of meta-attributes that capture the relationships among the user's intent, the execution context, and the proposed tool call. These meta-attributes allow MetaPermit to authorize tool use without enumerating user intents. At runtime, an LLM infers the meta-attribute values for each proposed tool call, while a fixed policy evaluates these values to allow or deny the call, making each decision auditable through the inferred values and the applied policy rule. We evaluate MetaPermit on the AgentDojo and AgentDyn benchmarks, across seven task suites and five attack methods, using two widely deployed open-weight LLMs. The results show that MetaPermit produces 31% more consistent authorization decisions than LLM-driven authorization and outperforms the state-of-the-art defenses CaMeL and IPIGuard in both task completion, with improvements of up to 109%, and robustness to IPI attacks, with no malicious tool calls executed.
title_cn: MetaPermit：基于 LLM 推断元属性的可扩展、可审计 AI 智能体访问控制
abstract_cn: 配备工具的自主 AI 智能体的兴起带来了显著的安全风险，从无意的工具误用到通过间接提示注入（IPI）攻击实施的对抗性操纵。实践中，OpenAI Codex、Claude Code 等已部署的智能体系统通过粗粒度权限规则与基于 LLM 对单个拟执行动作的判断相结合来保护工具调用。然而这两个组件都有重要局限：静态策略必须预判可能的用户意图，因而无法扩展到开放式任务；而 LLM 驱动的授权虽支持动态决策，却产生不一致的结果，并仍易受定向 IPI 攻击。为提供可扩展且更一致的授权，我们提出 MetaPermit，一个将语义推断与安全执行解耦、基于策略的工具访问控制框架。通过分析智能体与用户的交互，我们推导出一组紧凑、与任务无关的元属性，刻画用户意图、执行上下文与拟执行工具调用之间的关系。这些元属性使 MetaPermit 无需枚举用户意图即可对工具使用进行授权。运行时，由 LLM 推断每个拟执行工具调用的元属性取值，再由固定策略依据这些取值允许或拒绝该调用，使每个决策都可通过推断出的取值与所应用的策略规则进行审计。我们在 AgentDojo 与 AgentDyn 基准上，跨七个任务套件与五种攻击方法，使用两个广泛部署的开放权重 LLM 评估 MetaPermit。结果表明，MetaPermit 的授权决策一致性比 LLM 驱动的授权高 31%，并在任务完成度（提升最高达 109%）和对 IPI 攻击的鲁棒性（未执行任何恶意工具调用）两方面均优于最先进的防御 CaMeL 与 IPIGuard。
summary_cn: MetaPermit 让 LLM 只推断任务无关的元属性、由固定策略裁决工具调用；授权一致性比 LLM 授权高 31%，任务完成度较 CaMeL、IPIGuard 最高提升 109%。
objective_summary: 提出由 LLM 推断元属性、固定策略执行授权的智能体工具访问控制框架 MetaPermit，在 AgentDojo 与 AgentDyn 的七个任务套件、五种攻击和两个开放权重模型上与 CaMeL、IPIGuard 对比。
evidence_note: 两个基准、七个任务套件、五种攻击，与 CaMeL、IPIGuard 及 LLM 授权对比；仅两个开放权重模型，未报告统计检验。
novelty_note: 用一组与任务无关的元属性把语义推断与策略执行解耦，避免枚举用户意图，属已有方向上的实质改进。
scope: 适用于 AgentDojo、AgentDyn 覆盖的工具调用场景，所测两个开放权重 LLM 与五种 IPI 攻击。
limitations: 元属性取值仍由 LLM 推断，推断环节本身可能被针对；未在闭源模型或真实部署系统上评估。

title: TempQ-Jail: Query-Constrained Candidate Ranking for Text-to-Video Jailbreak Attacks
abstract: Existing text-to-video (T2V) jailbreak methods mainly seek more effective or stealthier attack candidates. In guarded T2V systems, however, video generation and security evaluation are costly, so an attacker often cannot test a large candidate pool. We therefore formulate T2V jailbreak as a query-constrained candidate allocation and ranking problem and propose TempQ-Jail. The method combines heterogeneous attack mechanisms to expand candidate coverage, estimates each candidate's end-to-end attack value from security-gate passage, dangerous visual generation, preservation of the original intent, and temporal validity, and ranks candidates so that high-value attacks appear early in a limited query trajectory. We evaluate TempQ-Jail on CogVideoX-5B using 70 common viable intents derived from T2VSafetyBench and compare it with six representative T2V jailbreak methods under a unified protocol. TempQ-Jail achieves TP-ASR@5 and TP-ASR@10 of 48.9% and 65.4%, improving over the strongest baselines by 4.6 and 4.0 percentage points, respectively. It also obtains the highest AUC-TP (0.469) and the lowest AvgQ (6.3). Analyses of query trajectories, candidate allocation, failure attribution, and ablations show that TempQ-Jail more effectively identifies and prioritises candidates with complete attack potential under limited query budgets.
comment: 17 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables
title_cn: TempQ-Jail：面向文本到视频越狱攻击的查询受限候选排序
abstract_cn: 现有文本到视频（T2V）越狱方法主要寻求更有效或更隐蔽的攻击候选。然而，在带防护的 T2V 系统中，视频生成与安全评估代价高昂，攻击者往往无法测试大规模的候选池。因此，我们将 T2V 越狱形式化为查询受限的候选分配与排序问题，并提出 TempQ-Jail。该方法结合异构攻击机制以扩大候选覆盖，从安全门通过、危险视觉内容生成、原始意图保持与时间有效性四个方面估计每个候选的端到端攻击价值，并对候选排序，使高价值攻击在有限的查询轨迹中尽早出现。我们在 CogVideoX-5B 上使用源自 T2VSafetyBench 的 70 个常见可行意图评估 TempQ-Jail，并在统一协议下与六种代表性 T2V 越狱方法比较。TempQ-Jail 的 TP-ASR@5 与 TP-ASR@10 分别达到 48.9% 和 65.4%，比最强基线分别高 4.6 和 4.0 个百分点。它还取得了最高的 AUC-TP（0.469）和最低的 AvgQ（6.3）。对查询轨迹、候选分配、失败归因的分析以及消融实验表明，在有限查询预算下，TempQ-Jail 能更有效地识别并优先处理具备完整攻击潜力的候选。
summary_cn: 将 T2V 越狱建模为查询受限的候选排序并提出 TempQ-Jail；在 CogVideoX-5B 上 TP-ASR@5/@10 达 48.9%/65.4%，比最强基线高约 4 个百分点。
objective_summary: 将 T2V 越狱形式化为查询受限的候选排序问题并提出 TempQ-Jail，在 CogVideoX-5B 上以 70 个意图与六种基线在统一协议下比较，并做轨迹分析与消融。
evidence_note: 统一协议下对比六种基线并有消融；仅单一目标模型 CogVideoX-5B、70 个意图，未报告统计检验。
novelty_note: 候选来自异构攻击机制的组合，新意在于把查询预算约束下的候选价值估计与排序作为优化目标。
scope: 适用于 CogVideoX-5B、T2VSafetyBench 派生意图与所设安全门下的查询受限攻击场景。
limitations: 仅在单一 T2V 模型上评估，相对最强基线提升约 4 个百分点，对其他模型与防护的泛化未验证。

title: Breaking the Black Box: Byte-Level Boundary Inference of Real-World Antivirus Systems
abstract: Existing approaches for understanding the detection logic of real-world antivirus (AV) software infer only binary malware/benign decisions from black-box queries, providing limited insight into the fine-grained decision-critical regions that govern AV detection. In this paper, we present \textbf{AVHunter}, the first framework for inferring byte-level decision-critical regions of real-world AV products under a black-box threat model. AVHunter constructs the first large-scale Byte-Level AV Boundary Dataset (BABD) by systematically probing 11 real-world AV products, revealing that modern AV detections are largely associated with a small number of compact decision-critical byte regions. Leveraging BABD, AVHunter trains AV-specific models that not only reproduce binary AV decisions, but also localize the decision-critical byte regions underlying these decisions, achieving an average boundary prediction recall of 85.07% while maintaining 97.43% detection agreement with the target AVs. We further validate that the predicted regions capture genuine AV decision knowledge through boundary-guided malware evasion, false-positive induction on benign executables, and a seven-month longitudinal study demonstrating that the inferred regions remain largely stable as AV products evolve. Overall, AVHunter moves beyond conventional binary-label AV modeling by enabling fine-grained boundary-region localization and revealing a new form of AV knowledge leakage with important implications for malware analysis, AV security, and boundary-aware defenses.
title_cn: 打破黑盒：真实世界杀毒系统的字节级边界推断
abstract_cn: 现有理解真实世界杀毒（AV）软件检测逻辑的方法仅能从黑盒查询中推断二元的恶意/良性判定，对支配 AV 检测的细粒度决策关键区域洞察有限。本文提出 AVHunter，首个在黑盒威胁模型下推断真实世界 AV 产品字节级决策关键区域的框架。AVHunter 通过系统性探测 11 款真实世界 AV 产品，构建了首个大规模字节级 AV 边界数据集（BABD），揭示现代 AV 检测主要与少量紧凑的决策关键字节区域相关。借助 BABD，AVHunter 训练针对特定 AV 的模型，这些模型不仅能复现二元 AV 判定，还能定位这些判定背后的决策关键字节区域，平均边界预测召回率达 85.07%，同时与目标 AV 保持 97.43% 的检测一致性。我们进一步通过边界引导的恶意软件规避、对良性可执行文件的误报诱导，以及一项为期七个月的纵向研究，验证了预测区域捕获了真实的 AV 决策知识；纵向研究表明，随着 AV 产品演进，推断出的区域基本保持稳定。总体而言，AVHunter 超越了传统的二元标签 AV 建模，实现了细粒度的边界区域定位，并揭示了一种新形式的 AV 知识泄露，对恶意软件分析、AV 安全与边界感知防御具有重要意义。
summary_cn: 提出 AVHunter，黑盒探测 11 款商用 AV 构建字节级边界数据集 BABD 并训练定位模型，边界召回率 85.07%、判定一致性 97.43%，经规避、误报诱导与七个月纵向研究验证。
objective_summary: 以黑盒查询探测 11 款真实 AV 产品构建字节级边界数据集并训练定位模型，通过规避、误报诱导与七个月纵向研究验证推断区域的有效性。
evidence_note: 11 款真实 AV 产品、召回率与一致性量化、三类下游验证及七个月纵向跟踪；摘要未提与既有 AV 建模方法的对比。
novelty_note: 从二元判定建模推进到字节级决策区域定位，并将其界定为一种新的 AV 知识泄露形式。
scope: 适用于黑盒查询威胁模型下所测 11 款 AV 产品对可执行文件的检测。
limitations: 结论限于所测 11 款产品对可执行文件的检测；摘要未给与既有二元 AV 建模方法的量化对比。

title: GitHub Engagement Signals for CVE Prioritization: The GitHub Popularity Metric (GPM)
abstract: Attackers can compromise multiple systems with a single vulnerability, while defenders need to fix all security weaknesses in their systems. This asymmetry puts defenders at a disadvantage. Security vulnerabilities are found at an alarming rate, and patching vulnerabilities is costly and time-consuming; thus, vulnerability prioritization is a must and a time-critical challenge. Many prioritization metrics, such as the CVSS, EPSS, KEV, and SSVC, are currently used, each with different pros and cons, such as openness, degree of automation, time-criticality, coverage, and need for expert input. In this work, we propose the GitHub Popularity Metric (GPM), a fully open, publicly computable prioritization metric based on the popularity of exploits in GitHub repositories. We use GitHub features such as the number of stars, forks, and related unique users to create a metric that indicates the popularity of CVEs across different time frames, both relative to the current time and historically. We compare the proposed metric with various existing vulnerability prioritization metrics and known exploited vulnerabilities and demonstrate that it provides tangible insights for defenders, identifying unique CVEs and inconsistencies in existing methods. The GPM was integrated into the EPSS version 5. \noindent\textbf{Note.} A demonstration based on this work has been accepted to the demo track of the ACM Conference on Computer and Communications Security (CCS) 2026.
title_cn: 面向 CVE 优先级排序的 GitHub 互动信号：GitHub 流行度指标（GPM）
abstract_cn: 攻击者利用单个漏洞即可攻陷多个系统，而防御者需要修复其系统中的所有安全弱点。这种不对称使防御者处于劣势。安全漏洞的发现速度惊人，而修补漏洞代价高昂且耗时；因此，漏洞优先级排序是必需的，也是一项时间紧迫的挑战。目前使用的优先级指标有很多，如 CVSS、EPSS、KEV 和 SSVC，它们在开放性、自动化程度、时效性、覆盖面以及对专家输入的需求等方面各有利弊。本工作提出 GitHub 流行度指标（GPM），这是一种基于 GitHub 仓库中漏洞利用代码流行度、完全开放且可公开计算的优先级指标。我们利用星标数、fork 数及相关独立用户数等 GitHub 特征构建指标，反映 CVE 在不同时间窗口内的流行度，既包括相对当前时间的，也包括历史的。我们将所提指标与多种现有漏洞优先级指标及已知被利用漏洞进行比较，表明它能为防御者提供切实的洞见，识别出独特的 CVE 以及现有方法中的不一致之处。GPM 已被集成进 EPSS 第 5 版。注：基于本工作的演示已被 ACM 计算机与通信安全会议（CCS）2026 的演示轨道录用。
summary_cn: 以 GitHub 利用代码仓库的星标、fork 与用户数构建公开 CVE 优先级指标 GPM，可识别独特 CVE 及现有指标间的不一致，已集成进 EPSS v5（CCS'26 Demo）。
objective_summary: 基于 GitHub 漏洞利用仓库的互动信号构建多时间窗口的 CVE 流行度指标 GPM，并与现有优先级指标及已知被利用漏洞清单做对比分析。
evidence_note: 与多种现有优先级指标及已知被利用漏洞对比，但摘要未给 CVE 规模、时间范围与量化结果。
novelty_note: 以利用代码仓库的星标、fork 与用户数构造公开、全自动的时序流行度信号，属优先级排序方向上的补充。
scope: 适用于在 GitHub 上存在公开利用代码仓库的 CVE；无公开利用仓库的漏洞不在覆盖范围内。
limitations: 依赖 GitHub 上的公开利用仓库，覆盖受限；流行度与实际被利用的关系在摘要中仅作定性对比。

title: Weaponizing Ground Truth: Data Poisoning Attacks by Exploiting Boundary Misalignment Between Antivirus Software and Learning-Based Detectors
abstract: Machine-learning (ML)-based malware detectors are commonly trained using labels obtained from antivirus (AV) engines and aggregation services (e.g., VirusTotal). This practice assumes AV-generated labels provide reliable supervision. However, small byte-level modifications can substantially alter AV verdicts while leaving the representations perceived by downstream ML detectors largely unchanged, producing label-feature inconsistencies that can contaminate training datasets and create poisoning opportunities for ML-based malware detection. We present Bi-Iocane, a black-box poisoning framework that exploits the reliance of malware-labeling pipelines on AV-generated labels. Bi-Iocane identifies AV-sensitive bytes and modifies them to induce label changes. It rewrites such bytes in malware to obtain benign labels (evasion-oriented poisoning) and injects malware-associated byte patterns into benign software to obtain malicious labels (defamation-oriented poisoning). These poisoned samples and their lightly modified variants corrupt training data and cause selected targets to be misclassified. We evaluate Bi-Iocane with 13 AV engines simulating AV aggregation services and eight ML detectors. For 30 malware and 30 benign clean targets, Bi-Iocane combines AV-specific manipulations to generate malware-to-benign and benign-to-malware poisoned samples whose all tested AV-based labels are flipped. After these poisoned samples and variants are used for downstream training, the resulting ML models misclassify 92.08% of the original clean targets on average with only a 0.06\% poisoning budget per target. Meanwhile, the poisoned models largely preserve clean-set performance, and six evaluated poisoning defenses show only limited mitigation. VirusTotal evaluation further confirms practical defamation risk and reveals potential evasion risk in real-world AV-to-ML labeling supply chains.
title_cn: 将真值武器化：利用杀毒软件与基于学习的检测器之间边界错位的数据投毒攻击
abstract_cn: 基于机器学习（ML）的恶意软件检测器通常使用从杀毒（AV）引擎及聚合服务（如 VirusTotal）获得的标签进行训练。这一做法假设 AV 生成的标签能提供可靠的监督。然而，微小的字节级修改就能显著改变 AV 判定，同时让下游 ML 检测器感知到的表示基本不变，由此产生标签—特征不一致，可污染训练数据集并为基于 ML 的恶意软件检测制造投毒机会。我们提出 Bi-Iocane，一个利用恶意软件打标流水线对 AV 生成标签之依赖的黑盒投毒框架。Bi-Iocane 识别对 AV 敏感的字节并修改它们以诱导标签变化。它改写恶意软件中的此类字节以获得良性标签（面向规避的投毒），并向良性软件注入与恶意软件相关的字节模式以获得恶意标签（面向诬陷的投毒）。这些投毒样本及其轻度修改的变体会污染训练数据，使选定目标被误分类。我们用模拟 AV 聚合服务的 13 个 AV 引擎和 8 个 ML 检测器评估 Bi-Iocane。针对 30 个恶意与 30 个良性的干净目标，Bi-Iocane 组合针对各 AV 的操作，生成恶意转良性与良性转恶意的投毒样本，其在所有受测 AV 上的标签均被翻转。这些投毒样本及变体用于下游训练后，所得 ML 模型平均误分类 92.08% 的原始干净目标，而每个目标的投毒预算仅为 0.06%。同时，被投毒模型基本保持了干净集上的性能，所评估的六种投毒防御仅带来有限缓解。VirusTotal 上的评估进一步证实了实际的诬陷风险，并揭示了真实世界 AV 到 ML 打标供应链中潜在的规避风险。
summary_cn: 黑盒投毒框架 Bi-Iocane 利用 AV 标签与 ML 特征的边界错位翻转打标；在 13 个 AV、8 个检测器上以每目标 0.06% 预算使 92.08% 干净目标被误分类。
objective_summary: 提出利用 AV 生成标签与 ML 检测器表示不一致的黑盒投毒框架 Bi-Iocane，在 13 个 AV 引擎、8 个 ML 检测器、60 个目标、六种防御及 VirusTotal 上验证。
evidence_note: 13 个 AV × 8 个检测器、30+30 个目标、六种防御与 VirusTotal 实测；目标数有限，未给统计检验与既有投毒攻击对比。
novelty_note: 把 AV 与 ML 检测器的判定边界错位识别为训练标签供应链上的投毒面，并兼顾规避与诬陷两个方向。
scope: 适用于以 AV 或聚合服务标签训练的 ML 恶意软件检测器，及所测 13 个引擎与 8 个检测器。
limitations: 干净目标仅 60 个；真实 VirusTotal 上的规避风险仅被称为潜在，端到端供应链攻击未完全证实。

title: Can Pixels Alone Reveal Image Origin? Minimax Limits and Learnable Interfaces for Passive Provenance
abstract: Passive image provenance asks whether pixels alone can reveal where an image came from: a human, an aggregate AI class, or a particular generator. This becomes a robustness problem once a source image can be edited before the verifier sees it. We study the problem as source--target verification under adversarial distribution shift. Our first result gives the exact best-case limit for any image-only verifier: the largest robust target-acceptance gap equals the minimum total-variation distance between the target distribution and the set of attacked source distributions. This quantity depends on the source, target, and edit class, not on the verifier architecture. Our second result explains why deployed public verifiers can fail before this statistical limit is reached. If the verifier can be emulated on the attack region to error $\varepsilon$, then a surrogate black-box attack reaches target acceptance within $2\varepsilon$ plus optimization error of the white-box optimum; score-revealing logistic and softmax heads over public features are identifiable, and approximate score access gives stable recovery bounds. A finite-state experiment checks the minimax identity where both sides are computable. On same-prompt real/diffusion benchmarks, the evaluated public CLIP verifiers fail under targeted pixel attacks, while a ResNet-18 victim exhibits partial fake-to-real transfer. Binary feedback with abstention reduces measured attack success, but positive empirical gap upper bounds do not establish robustness. These results motivate separate evaluation of the source--target statistical ceiling and the information released by a deployed verifier.

title_cn: 仅凭像素能揭示图像来源吗？被动溯源的极小极大极限与可学习接口
abstract_cn: 被动图像溯源要回答的是：仅凭像素能否揭示图像来自何处——人类、某个聚合的 AI 类别，还是某个特定生成器。一旦源图像可以在验证方看到之前被编辑，这就成为一个鲁棒性问题。我们把该问题作为对抗分布偏移下的源—目标验证来研究。第一个结果给出任何仅基于图像的验证器的精确最优极限：最大的鲁棒目标接受差距等于目标分布与受攻击源分布集合之间的最小总变差距离。该量取决于源、目标与编辑类别，而与验证器架构无关。第二个结果解释了为何已部署的公开验证器会在达到该统计极限之前就失效：若验证器能在攻击区域上以误差 ε 被模拟，则基于替代模型的黑盒攻击所达到的目标接受率与白盒最优值之差不超过 2ε 加上优化误差；基于公开特征、会暴露分数的 logistic 与 softmax 头是可辨识的，而近似的分数访问可给出稳定的恢复界。一项有限状态实验在等式两侧均可计算的情形下检验了该极小极大恒等式。在同提示词的真实/扩散图像基准上，所评估的公开 CLIP 验证器在定向像素攻击下失效，而 ResNet-18 受害模型表现出部分的伪造到真实迁移。带弃权的二值反馈降低了测得的攻击成功率，但为正的经验差距上界并不能确立鲁棒性。这些结果表明，应分别评估源—目标统计上限与已部署验证器所释放的信息。
summary_cn: 把被动图像溯源形式化为对抗编辑下的源—目标验证，证明鲁棒极限等于最小总变差距离、可被模拟的公开验证器会先被黑盒攻击攻破；公开 CLIP 验证器在定向像素攻击下失效（NeurIPS'26）。
objective_summary: 给出仅凭像素的溯源验证器在对抗编辑下的极小极大极限与替代模型攻击界，并以有限状态实验及真实/扩散图像基准上的 CLIP、ResNet-18 验证器实验检验。
evidence_note: 两项理论结果（附技术附录）；实证仅有限状态检验与同提示词基准上的公开 CLIP 验证器和一个 ResNet-18，未报告统计检验。
novelty_note: 给出与验证器架构无关的被动溯源鲁棒性精确极限，并区分统计上限与验证器信息泄露两类失效来源。
scope: 限于仅基于像素的被动验证器与给定编辑类；实证针对同提示词真实/扩散图像与所测公开验证器。
limitations: 极限依赖分布间总变差，实际中难以直接计算；实证规模较小，作者承认经验上界不能证明鲁棒性。

title: FARE: Forensic Acceptance Region Estimation for Catching Bait-and-Switch Image Generators
abstract: Modern AI image generators are increasingly deployed as opaque APIs, where customers can query the deployed service, but cannot inspect model weights or architecture. This creates a practical challenge: a provider may pass governance certification with one generator and later silently switch to a cheaper and lower-quality one for deployment, compromising public trust or even safety in high-stakes domains. We study integrity auditing at deployment time and propose FARE (Forensic Acceptance Region Estimation). A certified generator is enrolled by training FARE on images sampled from that generator. After deployment, FARE can determine whether a generated image is consistent with the enrolled generator---using only that image. FARE's features are based on image generator-specific artifacts that have been proposed for forensic applications. FARE amplifies these features during training by finding hard samples that tighten the acceptance region and increase sensitivity to subtle changes in the certified generator. Across generator swaps, including substitutions with similar model versions and model variants, FARE is effective at detecting swaps, consistently outperforming existing baselines at strict operating points, and remains effective under the exact-model and decision-only attacks evaluated in this work.
