title_cn: 来自主动语音智能体蜜罐的真实诈骗与骚扰电话对话语料库
abstract_cn: 诈骗者与其目标之间的真实对话是研究电话诈骗最有信息量的材料之一，却也是最稀缺的：被动蜜罐捕获的绝大多数是自动语音消息与挂断，大规模研究刻画的是通话元数据而非对话内容，而人工反诈诱骗（scam-baiting）无法规模化。我们提出一个由主动语音智能体蜜罐收集的真实诈骗通话对话数据集。专用号码被投放到诈骗团伙会收割的获客渠道中；呼入者由一个低延迟对话智能体接听，它扮演一个可信的目标人设并维持交互，同时每通电话都被录音、转写并自动标注。在最初 53 天的窗口内，我们捕获了 10,015 通呼入的诈骗与骚扰通话（其中 6,601 通有两轮及以上对话）：约 895 小时音频与 328,869 个转写轮次，来自 5,665 个不同的主叫号码。在一个整体分类器下，实质性通话以掠夺性但合法的获客推销（「spam」，约五分之三）为主，而约七分之一是明确的「scam」（本快照中 949 通）。每通电话都带有轮次级转写、三声道音频、逐轮延迟遥测以及多层自动标签，其中包括经独立人工复核佐证的整体 scam/spam/legitimate 判断（二分类决策一致率 75%）。我们描述了采集系统、记录结构，以及对语料真实性与标签质量的技术验证，包括该智能体仅在约 5% 的有实际交互的通话中被识别为非人类。我们还对已有的诈骗检测方法做了基准测试，发现在已发表的合成对话上训练的检测器在真实流量上精确率大幅崩塌。
summary_cn: 用主动语音智能体蜜罐 53 天采集 10,015 通诈骗/骚扰来电（约 895 小时音频、328,869 轮转写），附多层标签与人工复核；基于合成对话训练的诈骗检测器在真实流量上精确率崩塌。
objective_summary: 构建主动语音智能体蜜罐采集真实诈骗通话语料，以人工复核与智能体被识破率等技术验证语料真实性和标签质量，并对已有诈骗检测方法做基准测试。
evidence_note: 10,015 通真实来电、5,665 个号码、人工复核标签一致率 75%，并基准测试已有检测器；采集期 53 天。
novelty_note: 以主动对话智能体维持诈骗通话、规模化获取真实对话内容，区别于被动蜜罐与元数据研究。
scope: 基于所投放专用号码在初始 53 天窗口内的来电快照，类别比例依赖所用整体分类器。
limitations: 标签以自动分类为主，人工复核的二分类一致率仅 75%；采集窗口较短。

title: A Graph-Based Stackelberg Security Game for Trustworthy 6G Disaggregated Architecture
abstract: Open, cloud-native, and AI-enabled 6G architectures make network functions easier to deploy, observe, and replace, often implemented with separate software modules. However, each explicit interface can also create an entry point, trust transition, and lateral-movement route from a cybersecurity perspective. This paper formulates architectural disaggregation as a graph-based Stackelberg design game for 6G system security. A deployment graph specifies candidate 6G system seams, while an architecture-dependent directed attack graph specifies externally reachable functions and multistage paths. The defender commits to seams and allocates hardening and monitoring; an informed attacker then chooses a path and effort. Because edge traversal and evasion factors compose multiplicatively, the attacker's path response becomes a shortest-path problem after a logarithmic transformation. Convex effort costs admit a conjugate representation, and, for each fixed architecture, the defender's control problem is a convex exponential-epigraph program solvable by path generation. We derive an architecture-comparison criterion, a threshold for AI transducers within 6G systems that jointly add visibility and exposure, and comparative statics for attacker entry and bypass innovation. Experiments with stylized standards-anchored O-RAN/6G systems over RAN, RIC, core, cloud, and edge-AI functions show that neither full integration nor maximal disaggregation is generally best. Uncontrolled seams can increase risk, whereas selectively monitored and hardened seams can improve the Stackelberg objective. We find a boundary is worthwhile only when its detection and containment gains exceed its added attack opportunities and coordination cost.
title_cn: 面向可信 6G 解耦架构的基于图的 Stackelberg 安全博弈
abstract_cn: 开放、云原生且由 AI 赋能的 6G 架构使网络功能更易于部署、观测和替换，这些功能往往以独立的软件模块实现。然而从网络安全角度看，每个显式接口也可能构成一个入口点、一次信任转换以及一条横向移动路径。本文把架构解耦形式化为面向 6G 系统安全的基于图的 Stackelberg 设计博弈。部署图刻画候选的 6G 系统接缝（seam），而依赖于架构的有向攻击图刻画可从外部到达的功能与多阶段路径。防御方先承诺接缝的设置并分配加固与监控资源；随后知情的攻击者选择路径与投入力度。由于边穿越因子与规避因子以乘法方式组合，攻击者的路径响应在对数变换后变为最短路径问题。凸的投入成本允许共轭表示；并且对每个固定架构，防御方的控制问题是一个可用路径生成求解的凸指数上图规划。我们推导出一个架构比较准则、6G 系统中同时增加可见性与暴露面的 AI 转换器（AI transducer）的阈值，以及关于攻击者进入与绕过创新的比较静态分析。在覆盖 RAN、RIC、核心网、云与边缘 AI 功能、以标准为锚点的风格化 O-RAN/6G 系统上的实验表明，完全集成与最大化解耦一般都不是最优的。不受控的接缝可能增加风险，而有选择地加以监控和加固的接缝可以改善 Stackelberg 目标。我们发现，只有当一条边界带来的检测与遏制收益超过其新增的攻击机会与协调成本时，设置该边界才是值得的。
summary_cn: 把 6G 架构解耦建模为基于部署图与攻击图的 Stackelberg 设计博弈，攻击者响应经对数变换化为最短路、防御方问题为凸规划；风格化 O-RAN/6G 实验显示完全集成与最大解耦通常都非最优。
objective_summary: 以部署图与攻击图构建 Stackelberg 设计博弈，推导架构比较准则与 AI 转换器阈值，并用以标准为锚点的风格化 O-RAN/6G 系统实验检验。
evidence_note: 给出最短路归约、凸规划与比较静态等解析推导，并在风格化 O-RAN/6G 系统上对比不同解耦程度；无真实部署数据。
novelty_note: 把解耦架构的接缝选择与加固、监控分配统一到图上 Stackelberg 博弈中求解。
scope: 结论依赖穿越与规避因子乘法可组合、凸投入成本及知情攻击者等建模假设。
limitations: 实验参数为风格化设定，缺少真实攻击或运营数据支撑结论的量级。

title: Just Ask Jev: Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions as a Zero-Shot Detector of AI Alignment Failures
abstract: Detectors of alignment failures screen deployed language models and score alignment benchmarks. Most are generative judges that spend a decoding pass on every criterion, and classifiers that read token probabilities, such as Llama Guard, still score one fixed label per call. Jev, a model trained with reinforcement learning for calibrated decisions (RLCD), answers many typed questions about one input with calibrated probabilities in a single call. Whether it detects alignment failures has not been measured. We present RLCDAlignBench, which benchmarks Jev on ten alignment failures: sycophancy, jailbreaks, deception, prompt injection, hallucination, privacy violation, social bias, reward hacking, concealing uncertainty, and power seeking. It spans 44 benchmarks and five target models, labelled by each benchmark's scorer and, on two, by humans. Many of these failures are relational, defined against a reference, such as the user's belief or an injected instruction, that the response alone does not reveal. Our key idea is therefore to vary what Jev is asked separately from what it sees: the question's wording and answer type on one side, the fields of the input on the other. A single generic question reaches a median AUROC of 0.886 zero-shot and beats supervised baselines on most benchmarks. Question wording matters little, while context matters more, mostly through fields that encode the label. Jev matches the reference scorer's agreement with human labels, surfaces label defects in existing benchmarks, and costs 63x less than LLM-judge scorers. Code and data: https://github.com/sumleo/RLCDAlignBench.
title_cn: 直接问 Jev：以面向校准决策的强化学习模型作为 AI 对齐失败的零样本检测器
abstract_cn: 对齐失败检测器用于筛查已部署的语言模型，并为对齐基准打分。它们大多是生成式评审，对每一条准则都要花费一次解码过程；而读取 token 概率的分类器（如 Llama Guard）每次调用仍只对一个固定标签打分。Jev 是一个通过面向校准决策的强化学习（RLCD）训练的模型，能在一次调用中以校准后的概率回答关于同一输入的多个类型化问题。它能否检测对齐失败此前尚未被测量。我们提出 RLCDAlignBench，在十类对齐失败上对 Jev 进行基准评测：谄媚、越狱、欺骗、提示注入、幻觉、隐私侵犯、社会偏见、奖励投机（reward hacking）、隐瞒不确定性与权力寻求。它涵盖 44 个基准和五个目标模型，由各基准自身的评分器标注，其中两个基准还有人工标注。其中许多失败是关系性的，即相对于某个参照（例如用户的信念或被注入的指令）来定义，而仅凭响应本身无法揭示该参照。因此，我们的核心思路是把问 Jev 什么与 Jev 看到什么分开变化：一边是问题的措辞与答案类型，另一边是输入的字段。单个通用问题在零样本下达到 0.886 的 AUROC 中位数，并在多数基准上优于有监督基线。问题措辞影响不大，而上下文影响更大，主要来自编码了标签的字段。Jev 与人工标签的一致性与参考评分器相当，能暴露现有基准中的标签缺陷，且成本比 LLM 评审评分器低 63 倍。代码与数据：https://github.com/sumleo/RLCDAlignBench。
summary_cn: 构建 RLCDAlignBench（10 类对齐失败、44 个基准）评测 RLCD 训练的 Jev：通用问题零样本 AUROC 中位数 0.886，多数基准优于有监督基线，成本比 LLM 评审低 63 倍。
objective_summary: 构建 RLCDAlignBench 评估 Jev 在十类对齐失败上的零样本检测能力，分别变化问题措辞与输入字段，并与有监督基线、参考评分器及人工标注比较。
evidence_note: 44 个基准 × 5 个目标模型，含有监督基线与 LLM 评审成本对比，两个基准有人工标注；统计检验摘要未提。
novelty_note: 把问题措辞与输入上下文分开变化以处理关系性失败，并首次测量 Jev 的对齐失败检测能力。
scope: 结论针对 Jev 模型与所选 44 个基准、5 个目标模型，标签多来自各基准自带评分器。
limitations: 多数标签依赖基准评分器而非人工；上下文增益主要来自编码标签的字段，实际部署时未必可得。

title: Beyond Centralized Policy Decision Points: Decentralized Sticky Policy Authorization through Evidence Quorums
abstract: Sticky policies remain attached to protected data so that access restrictions can persist across systems, yet request-time authorization often still depends on a centralized Trusted Authority or Policy Decision Point (PDP). This paper presents SPEAR-Q, a decentralized framework in which independent Policy Authority Nodes (PANs) evaluate the active sticky policy using local context, consent, and risk information and generate signed authorization evidence. A strict-majority Evidence quorum determines the global Permit or Deny decision, while a committed policy becomes active only after the required PAN majority applies it. SPEAR-Q was deployed across physically separated hosts in the Airbus Cyber Security Simulation Platform and evaluated using a healthcare workload derived from MIMIC-IV. Across 9,000 performance requests, all requests completed without execution failure or timeout. Latency increased and throughput saturated as cluster size and concurrency grew, with PAN evidence waiting and PAN-local processing dominating under load and credential validation forming the main PAN-side cost. Policy-activation experiments confirmed majority-based activation. Quorum experiments showed that correctly signed false-Permit evidence from fewer compromised PANs than the required quorum could not produce a global Permit or resource release, while authorization remained fail-closed when reachable PANs fell below the required quorum. Compared with prior approaches that decentralize policy management, credential authority, or threshold-based release separately, SPEAR-Q integrates persistent sticky policy enforcement, independent request-time evidence, majority-based policy activation, and explicit quorum-bounded authorization within one decentralized framework. Under the evaluated conditions, SPEAR-Q supports decentralized sticky-policy authorization without relying on a centralized decision authority.
comment: 18 pages, 10 figures, 8 tables
title_cn: 超越集中式策略决策点：基于证据法定人数的去中心化粘性策略授权
abstract_cn: 粘性策略（sticky policy）始终附着于受保护数据，使访问限制能够跨系统持续生效，但请求时的授权往往仍依赖集中式的可信机构（Trusted Authority）或策略决策点（PDP）。本文提出 SPEAR-Q，一个去中心化框架：由相互独立的策略机构节点（PAN）利用本地上下文、同意与风险信息评估当前生效的粘性策略，并生成经签名的授权证据。严格多数的证据法定人数（quorum）决定全局的允许（Permit）或拒绝（Deny）决策，而已提交的策略只有在所需多数的 PAN 应用之后才会生效。SPEAR-Q 部署在 Airbus 网络安全仿真平台（Airbus Cyber Security Simulation Platform）中物理上相互分离的多台主机上，并使用源自 MIMIC-IV 的医疗工作负载进行评估。在 9,000 次性能请求中，所有请求均完成，没有执行失败或超时。随着集群规模和并发度增长，延迟上升、吞吐量趋于饱和；负载下以 PAN 证据等待和 PAN 本地处理为主导，而凭证验证是 PAN 侧的主要开销。策略激活实验证实了基于多数的激活。法定人数实验表明，当被攻陷的 PAN 数量少于所需法定人数时，即使它们给出正确签名的虚假允许证据，也无法产生全局允许或资源释放；而当可达的 PAN 数量低于所需法定人数时，授权保持失败即关闭（fail-closed）。与分别去中心化策略管理、凭证机构或基于阈值的释放的已有方法相比，SPEAR-Q 在一个去中心化框架内整合了持久的粘性策略执行、独立的请求时证据、基于多数的策略激活以及显式受法定人数约束的授权。在所评估的条件下，SPEAR-Q 支持不依赖集中式决策机构的去中心化粘性策略授权。
summary_cn: 提出 SPEAR-Q：独立 PAN 生成签名授权证据、严格多数法定人数决定允许或拒绝；以 MIMIC-IV 医疗负载跑 9,000 次请求无失败，少于法定人数的被攻陷节点无法促成虚假允许。
objective_summary: 设计去中心化粘性策略授权框架 SPEAR-Q，并在 Airbus 网络安全仿真平台的物理分离主机上，以 MIMIC-IV 派生医疗负载评估性能、策略激活与法定人数安全性。
evidence_note: 多主机实际部署、9,000 次请求及策略激活与法定人数实验；与已有方案仅做定性对比，摘要未报告量化基线。
novelty_note: 把粘性策略执行、请求时独立证据与法定人数授权整合进同一框架，各组成机制本身已有。
scope: 结论在所测集群规模、并发度与医疗负载下成立，并假设被攻陷 PAN 少于法定人数。
limitations: 延迟随规模与并发上升且吞吐饱和；摘要未报告与集中式 PDP 的量化性能对比。

title: AEGIS: Audio Endogenous Guarding via Internal Signals Against Large Audio-Language Model Jailbreaks
abstract: Large audio-language models (LALMs) expand language models to process and interpret audio, but also expose them to heterogeneous audio jailbreaks. We ask whether successful jailbreaks reflect failures to recognize harmful intent or failures occurring after such recognition. Layer-wise probing reveals the latter: risk-related information remains decodable from intermediate representations, yet the internal risk signal fails to translate into refusal in later-layer processing. We identify this discrepancy as the risk-to-refusal gap. Building on this finding, we propose AEGIS, a detect-then-intervene defense whose mid-layer risk gate selectively activates downstream safety adapters. Across six LALMs and three heterogeneous audio jailbreak benchmarks, AEGIS reduces the average unsafe rate from 17.9% to 0.4%, while causing only a marginal increase in over-refusal on benign inputs. These results establish selective internal intervention as an effective path toward more robust refusal in LALMs. The code is available at https://github.com/azzzzliao/aegis-audio-defense.
comment: Submitted to ICASSP 2027. 5 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables
title_cn: AEGIS：基于内部信号的音频内生防护，抵御大型音频-语言模型越狱
abstract_cn: 大型音频-语言模型（LALM）把语言模型扩展到处理和理解音频，但也使其暴露于异构的音频越狱攻击之下。我们提出这样一个问题：成功的越狱反映的是未能识别有害意图，还是在识别之后发生的失败？逐层探测揭示了后者：风险相关信息在中间层表征中仍可被解码，但这一内部风险信号未能在后续层的处理中转化为拒绝。我们把这种差异称为风险-拒绝落差（risk-to-refusal gap）。基于这一发现，我们提出 AEGIS，一种先检测后干预的防御，其中间层风险门控会选择性地激活下游的安全适配器。在六个 LALM 和三个异构音频越狱基准上，AEGIS 将平均不安全率从 17.9% 降至 0.4%，而对良性输入的过度拒绝仅略有增加。这些结果确立了选择性内部干预是让 LALM 实现更稳健拒绝的一条有效路径。代码见 https://github.com/azzzzliao/aegis-audio-defense。
summary_cn: 逐层探测发现 LALM 越狱源于「风险-拒绝落差」（中间层可解码风险而后层未拒绝），据此提出中间层风险门控加安全适配器的 AEGIS；六模型三基准上平均不安全率 17.9% 降至 0.4%。
objective_summary: 以逐层探测分析 LALM 越狱成因，提出先检测后干预的 AEGIS 防御，并在六个 LALM 与三个音频越狱基准上评估不安全率与过度拒绝。
evidence_note: 六个 LALM × 三个越狱基准，报告不安全率与过度拒绝；摘要未列与其他防御的对比，5 页短文。
novelty_note: 在音频模态刻画风险-拒绝落差，并以中间层门控选择性激活安全适配器，属表征级防御的延伸。
scope: 适用于所测六个 LALM 与三个音频越狱基准，要求防御方能访问并修改模型内部层。
limitations: 需白盒访问内部表征并加装适配器；摘要未涉及针对门控机制的自适应攻击评估。

title: TP-CRIV: A Framework for Third-Party Challenge-Response Identity Verification of AI Models
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) models are increasingly deployed through remote services, making model misappropriation a growing concern. Existing approaches, including watermarking, fingerprinting, and model similarity analysis, primarily rely on predefined evidence or direct behavioral comparison and do not explicitly evaluate whether the claimant currently possesses and can utilize model-dependent information relevant to the claimed model identity. In this paper, we propose Third-Party Challenge-Response Identity Verification (TP-CRIV) for AI models. TP-CRIV targets a third-party verification setting in which the verifier has neither white-box nor API access to the claimant's model, can interact with the suspicious deployed service only through its ordinary black-box inference interface, and does not require protocol-specific cooperation from the service provider. Under these constraints, the framework enables the verifier to obtain empirical evidence as to whether the claimant locally possesses a model satisfying a predeclared identity relative to the deployed model. Verification is conducted under fresh, previously undisclosed requirements and network isolation, so that the demonstrated capability cannot rely on online external assistance after challenge disclosure. The resulting evidence is interpreted relative to independently specified and calibrated matching and non-matching operating situations and is statistical rather than cryptographic. We instantiate TP-CRIV for CNN image classifiers using probability-control-based witness generation. Experiments on ten ImageNet-pretrained TorchVision models demonstrate clear same/cross-model separation and finite-challenge verification using independently calibrated thresholds.
title_cn: TP-CRIV：面向 AI 模型的第三方挑战-应答身份验证框架
abstract_cn: 人工智能（AI）模型越来越多地通过远程服务部署，使模型盗用日益成为一个受关注的问题。现有方法，包括水印、指纹与模型相似度分析，主要依赖预先定义的证据或直接的行为比较，并没有明确评估声明方当前是否持有、并能够利用与所声明模型身份相关的、依赖于模型的信息。本文提出面向 AI 模型的第三方挑战-应答身份验证（TP-CRIV）。TP-CRIV 面向这样一种第三方验证场景：验证方对声明方的模型既没有白盒访问也没有 API 访问，只能通过普通的黑盒推理接口与可疑的已部署服务交互，并且不需要服务提供方针对该协议的配合。在这些约束下，该框架使验证方能够获得经验证据，判断声明方是否在本地持有一个相对于已部署模型满足预先声明的身份关系的模型。验证在全新的、此前未公开的要求以及网络隔离条件下进行，使得所展示的能力无法在挑战公开后依赖在线的外部协助。所得证据相对于独立指定并经校准的匹配与不匹配工况来解释，其性质是统计性的而非密码学的。我们针对 CNN 图像分类器、采用基于概率控制的见证生成来实例化 TP-CRIV。在十个 ImageNet 预训练的 TorchVision 模型上的实验表明，同模型与跨模型之间区分清晰，并能使用独立校准的阈值完成有限挑战次数下的验证。
summary_cn: 提出第三方、仅经黑盒推理接口、无需服务方配合的模型身份挑战-应答验证框架 TP-CRIV，在网络隔离下检验声明方是否本地持有模型；十个 TorchVision CNN 上同/跨模型区分清晰。
objective_summary: 提出 TP-CRIV 框架，并以基于概率控制的见证生成在 CNN 图像分类器上实例化，用十个 ImageNet 预训练 TorchVision 模型检验同/跨模型区分与有限挑战验证。
evidence_note: 十个 ImageNet 预训练 CNN 上的同/跨模型区分与独立校准阈值；摘要未报告与水印、指纹等基线的对比。
novelty_note: 从「声明方当前是否持有并能利用模型」出发设计第三方挑战-应答验证，区别于水印与指纹。
scope: 限于 CNN 图像分类器与十个 TorchVision 模型；证据为统计性而非密码学保证。
limitations: 仅在 CNN 分类器上实例化；判定依赖匹配与不匹配工况的校准质量。

title: Security Limits of Mining Before Validation in Nakamoto Consensus
abstract: Mining before validation allows miners to extend a newly received block before completing its validity checks, giving them a head start in the race for the next block reward. This head start, however, comes with a security risk: rejecting one invalid block also discards the honest work built on it, an effect missed when validation is treated as instantaneous. We quantify this risk in a model of Nakamoto consensus with bounded network delay and a validation-time bound independent of processing load. We establish an explicit threshold on adversarial mining power below which honest miners' fully validated chains continue to grow and agree on a stable history with high probability over any fixed observation period. We also construct an attack that repeatedly draws honest mining onto invalid branches. When the adversary produces more than one block on average during the allowed validation time, the attack can eventually remove a target block at any fixed initial confirmation depth. Combined with ordinary private mining, this attack yields a matching asymptotic bound in the fully decentralized regime, where each honest miner has negligible mining power. The results show how validation latency limits the security of mining before validation, beyond the constraint imposed by network delay.
title_cn: 中本聪共识中先挖矿后验证的安全极限
abstract_cn: 先挖矿后验证允许矿工在完成新收到区块的有效性检查之前就在其上继续延伸，从而在争夺下一个区块奖励时抢得先机。然而，这一先机伴随着安全风险：拒绝一个无效区块也会丢弃建立在其上的诚实工作——当验证被视为瞬时完成时，这一效应就被忽略了。我们在一个具有有界网络延迟、且验证时间上界与处理负载无关的中本聪共识模型中量化这一风险。我们给出了关于敌手挖矿算力的显式阈值：低于该阈值时，在任意固定观测期内，诚实矿工经完整验证的链会以高概率持续增长，并就稳定的历史达成一致。我们还构造了一种反复把诚实挖矿引向无效分支的攻击。当敌手在允许的验证时间内平均产出多于一个区块时，该攻击最终可以移除位于任意固定初始确认深度的目标区块。结合普通的私有挖矿，该攻击在完全去中心化情形（每个诚实矿工的挖矿算力都可忽略）下给出了相匹配的渐近界。这些结果表明，验证延迟在网络延迟所施加的约束之外，进一步限制了先挖矿后验证的安全性。
summary_cn: 在有界网络延迟与验证时延模型下分析先挖矿后验证：给出敌手算力的安全阈值，并构造把诚实算力引向无效分支的攻击，在完全去中心化情形下得到相匹配的渐近界。
objective_summary: 在带有界网络延迟与验证时间上界的中本聪共识模型中，证明先挖矿后验证下的敌手算力安全阈值，并以构造性攻击给出匹配的渐近界。
evidence_note: 给出安全阈值结论与构造性攻击，并在完全去中心化情形得到匹配界；摘要未含仿真或实测数据。
novelty_note: 在中本聪共识安全分析中加入被「验证瞬时」假设忽略的验证延迟维度，并给出匹配界。
scope: 在有界网络延迟、验证时间上界与负载无关的模型下成立；匹配界限于完全去中心化情形。
limitations: 验证时间上界与负载无关的假设较理想化；匹配界仅为渐近结果，且要求诚实矿工算力可忽略。
institution: Huazhong University of Science and Technology

title: Poster: FedWM-Guard: Thwarting Imagination Poisoning in Federated World Model-based Autonomous Driving
abstract: Federated learning (FL) can improve world model (WM)-based autonomous driving (AD) without centralizing raw private vehicle data, but it also turns model aggregation into a safety-critical integrity boundary. We introduce a new threat in federated WM-AD, namely \emph{imagination poisoning}: compromised vehicles submit bounded WM updates that preserve benign short-horizon predictions yet corrupt long-horizon rollouts (e.g., trigger-conditioned) during training, thereby misleading a downstream planner. We present \emph{FedWM-Guard}, to the best of our knowledge, the first defense to characterize planner-facing rollouts in federated WM-AD, screen authenticated updates in hidden-canary scenarios, audit predicted futures against later observations, and invoke a WM-independent safety shield when persistent inconsistency is detected. Unlike parameter-space defenses, it scores what an update makes the model \emph{imagine}, not only how the update looks. We also outline how we plan to evaluate it under non-IID (not independent and identically distributed) data, adaptive attacks, and benign distribution shift. This work highlights an unexplored domain, federated WM-AD, and its threat surface and potential countermeasures.
comment: To appear in the 2026 ACM Conference on Computer and Communications Security (CCS)
title_cn: Poster：FedWM-Guard：抵御联邦世界模型自动驾驶中的想象投毒
abstract_cn: 联邦学习（FL）可以在不集中原始私有车辆数据的前提下改进基于世界模型（WM）的自动驾驶（AD），但它也把模型聚合变成了一道安全攸关的完整性边界。我们提出联邦 WM-AD 中的一种新威胁——想象投毒：被攻陷的车辆提交有界的 WM 更新，这些更新保持良性的短时域预测，却在训练中破坏长时域推演（例如以触发器为条件），从而误导下游规划器。我们提出 FedWM-Guard，据我们所知，这是首个如下的防御：刻画联邦 WM-AD 中面向规划器的推演，在隐藏金丝雀场景中筛查经认证的更新，用之后的观测审计预测出的未来，并在检测到持续不一致时调用独立于 WM 的安全护盾。不同于参数空间防御，它评估的是一个更新让模型「想象」出什么，而不仅是这个更新看起来如何。我们还概述了计划如何在非 IID（非独立同分布）数据、自适应攻击与良性分布漂移下对其进行评估。本工作揭示了一个尚未被探索的领域——联邦 WM-AD——及其威胁面与潜在对策。
summary_cn: 提出联邦世界模型自动驾驶中的「想象投毒」威胁及 FedWM-Guard 防御（金丝雀场景筛查、预测与后续观测对账、独立安全护盾），目前仅有设计与评估计划（CCS'26 Poster）。
objective_summary: 提出联邦世界模型自动驾驶的想象投毒威胁模型与 FedWM-Guard 防御设计，并列出在非 IID、自适应攻击与良性分布漂移下的评估计划，未报告实验结果。
evidence_note: 海报论文只给出威胁与防御设计，评估尚处计划阶段，摘要未报告任何实验数据。
novelty_note: 提出针对长时域推演的「想象投毒」新威胁，并按更新引发的推演行为而非参数形态打分。
scope: 面向联邦训练的世界模型自动驾驶，假设更新经认证且可构造隐藏金丝雀场景。
limitations: 尚无实证评估，防御在自适应攻击与非 IID 数据下的误报率和开销均未验证。

title: Through Human Eyes and Machine Eyes: Understanding View Mismatch in Video See-Through Extended Reality
abstract: Video see-through extended reality (VST XR) systems commonly use headset screenshots or captured frames as proxies for the user's first-person visual context. However, the system-captured view and the user's effective visible field do not necessarily coincide: a screenshot records a rectangular machine-readable frame, whereas the user's effective visible region can be more constrained and non-rectangular. This paper studies this human-system view mismatch in VST XR. We formalize the relationship between the system-captured region and the human-visible region by defining their co-visible, system-only, and human-only regions. \rev{We then conduct a pilot-level boundary measurement on Meta Quest 3, revealing a clear mismatch between the rectangular screenshot frame and the approximate human-visible boundary. Building on this model, we analyze how view mismatch can affect screenshot-based XR sensing and downstream vision-language model tasks. Through four representative case studies, we illustrate potential risks and failure modes including prompt injection, privacy leakage, human-invisible information bias, and missing human-visible information. Our results show that view mismatch is not only a geometric artifact, but can also introduce security, privacy, and reliability concerns for AI-integrated VST XR systems.
title_cn: 透过人眼与机器之眼：理解视频透视扩展现实中的视图错配
abstract_cn: 视频透视扩展现实（VST XR）系统通常把头显截图或采集的帧作为用户第一人称视觉上下文的代理。然而，系统采集的视图与用户的有效可见视野并不一定重合：截图记录的是矩形的机器可读帧，而用户的有效可见区域可能更受限且非矩形。本文研究 VST XR 中这种人-系统视图错配。我们通过定义共同可见区域、仅系统可见区域与仅人可见区域，形式化系统采集区域与人类可见区域之间的关系。随后我们在 Meta Quest 3 上开展了试点级的边界测量，揭示了矩形截图帧与近似的人类可见边界之间存在明显错配。基于该模型，我们分析了视图错配如何影响基于截图的 XR 感知以及下游视觉语言模型任务。通过四个代表性案例研究，我们展示了潜在的风险与失效模式，包括提示注入、隐私泄露、人不可见信息偏差以及人可见信息缺失。我们的结果表明，视图错配不仅是一种几何伪影，还可能给集成 AI 的 VST XR 系统带来安全、隐私与可靠性问题。
summary_cn: 形式化 VST XR 中截图帧与人眼可见区域的错配，在 Meta Quest 3 上做试点边界测量，并以四个案例说明其可引发提示注入、隐私泄露等 VLM 下游风险。
objective_summary: 以共同可见、仅系统可见、仅人可见三类区域形式化人-系统视图错配，并用 Meta Quest 3 试点测量和四个案例研究说明其安全、隐私与可靠性影响。
evidence_note: 仅单一设备（Meta Quest 3）的试点级边界测量与四个说明性案例；摘要未报告规模化实验或量化对照。
novelty_note: 把人眼可见区域与系统截图的视域错配作为 AI 集成 XR 的安全与隐私问题提出，属新的问题视角。
scope: 针对以截图作为 VLM 输入的视频透视 XR 系统；测量只在 Meta Quest 3 上进行。
limitations: 人眼可见边界为近似的试点测量；案例研究为示意性质，摘要未给出攻击成功率等量化结果。

title: ClaimMirage: When Self-Claims in Domain Names Change LLM Threat Judgments
abstract: Short claims such as not-phishing or official can change how a large language model (LLM) judges a domain name, without explicit prompt-injection commands. We study this manipulation as ClaimMirage: a name under inspection claims its own safety or approval. We analyze 622,080 judgments across 64 brands and five LLMs, comparing ten claims with length- and hyphen-matched controls in constructed brand-like names. Self-claims can substantially reduce or increase alerts, depending on the LLM and input setting. In one setting, risk-denial terms inside the registrable name reduce alerts by 45.3 percentage points even with a basic safeguard: the prompt supplies the potentially impersonated brand and its official domain for comparison. Without these references, endorsement terms at that position increase alerts by 65.6 points in the same LLM. References and component annotation remove some alert reductions but leave others or make them larger. These findings motivate testing resistance to self-claims and seeking independent evidence before treating a domain name under inspection as safe or authorized.
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures
title_cn: ClaimMirage：当域名中的自我声明改变 LLM 的威胁判断
abstract_cn: 诸如 not-phishing 或 official 这样的简短声明，无需显式的提示注入命令，就能改变大语言模型（LLM）对域名的判断。我们将这种操纵作为 ClaimMirage 加以研究：受检名称声称自身安全或已获认可。我们在构造的类品牌名称中，将十种声明与长度及连字符匹配的对照进行比较，分析了涉及 64 个品牌和五个 LLM 的 622,080 次判断。自我声明可能大幅降低或提高告警，取决于所用 LLM 与输入设置。在一种设置中，即使采用了一项基本防护措施（提示中提供可能被冒充的品牌及其官方域名以供比较），可注册名称内部的风险否认词仍使告警降低 45.3 个百分点。在没有这些参考信息时，同一位置的背书词在同一 LLM 中使告警增加 65.6 个百分点。参考信息与组件标注消除了部分告警降低，但另一些仍然存在或变得更大。这些发现提示，在将受检域名视为安全或已授权之前，应测试对自我声明的抵抗力并寻求独立证据。
summary_cn: 在 5 个 LLM、622,080 次判断上量化域名自称词对 LLM 威胁判断的操纵：特定设置下风险否认词使告警降 45.3 个百分点，背书词在同一 LLM 中使其升 65.6 个百分点。
objective_summary: 在构造的类品牌域名中嵌入十种自我声明，与长度、连字符匹配的对照比较，统计五个 LLM 在不同输入设置下的告警变化。
evidence_note: 622,080 次判断、64 个品牌、5 个 LLM，设长度与连字符匹配对照；摘要未提统计检验，域名均为构造样本。
novelty_note: 把域名中的自称安全或官方词作为对 LLM 判定的非指令式操纵加以系统量化。
scope: 适用于构造的类品牌域名、所测五个 LLM 及所用提示与参考信息设置。
limitations: 仅用构造名称而非在野钓鱼域名；所测参考信息与组件标注仅部分缓解，未给出有效防御。

title: The Fly That Stopped: Mushroom-Body-Inspired Habituation as a Reward-Free Scheduling Prior for Autonomous Penetration Testing
abstract: Autonomous security-testing agents can spend much of a fixed action budget repeating earlier tool selections. We evaluate a reward-free scheduler inspired by mushroom-body novelty processing in Drosophila. It combines sparse state encoding with decaying habituation counters over structural URL classes and tool families. The counters penalize repeated clean or error outcomes without updating weights from scalar reward. Four matched campaigns motivated this design by exposing reward-accounting errors and tool-failure loops; reward-driven components did not improve the tested primary outcomes over the reward-free MB condition. A pre-registered pilot and two confirmatory stages then evaluated repeated (tool, URL) selections. In the second confirmatory stage, 8 of 10 screened lab targets remained measurable after two error-heavy slow-XSS exclusions. The habituation-enabled scheduler lowered duplicate-action ratios in all 6 non-tied target pairs (exact one-sided p=0.015625), with two ties; the largest reduction was 51 to 18 duplicate steps within a 60-step budget. This is evidence for the complete scheduler on the measurable budget-hold population, not an isolated habituation ablation or a vulnerability-discovery gain. A complementary study on a 13,498-neuron MaleCNS-derived circuit (501,267 synaptic edges with weight at least 5) found no action selectivity from the five tested local-plasticity approaches under a fixed readout; readout plasticity produced qualified positive results in synthetic tasks without establishing a biological-topology advantage. We report the population bounds, remaining input-integrity dependencies, and an internal AI-assisted review protocol alongside the results.
comment: 12 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables
title_cn: 停下的果蝇：受蘑菇体启发的习惯化作为自主渗透测试的无奖励调度先验
abstract_cn: 自主安全测试智能体可能把固定动作预算的大部分花在重复先前的工具选择上。我们评估了一个受果蝇（Drosophila）蘑菇体新颖性处理启发的无奖励调度器。它将稀疏状态编码与作用于结构化 URL 类别和工具家族的衰减习惯化计数器相结合。计数器惩罚重复的无发现或出错结果，而不依据标量奖励更新权重。四个匹配的测试活动催生了这一设计：它们暴露了奖励记账错误与工具失败循环；在所测的主要结果上，奖励驱动组件并未优于无奖励的 MB 条件。随后，一个预注册的试点与两个确证阶段评估了重复的（工具，URL）选择。在第二确证阶段，排除两个错误密集的慢速 XSS 目标后，10 个经筛选的实验室目标中有 8 个仍可测量。启用习惯化的调度器在全部 6 个非平局目标对中降低了重复动作比例（精确单侧 p=0.015625），另有两个平局；最大降幅为在 60 步预算内从 51 个重复步降至 18 个。这是在可测量的预算保持总体上针对完整调度器的证据，而非孤立的习惯化消融或漏洞发现上的增益。一项补充研究在一个源自 MaleCNS、含 13,498 个神经元（501,267 条权重至少为 5 的突触边）的回路上发现，在固定读出下，所测五种局部可塑性方法均未产生动作选择性；读出可塑性在合成任务中产生了有保留的正面结果，但未确立生物拓扑的优势。我们随结果一并报告了总体边界、尚存的输入完整性依赖，以及一个内部 AI 辅助评审协议。
summary_cn: 受果蝇蘑菇体启发，用衰减习惯化计数器惩罚重复的（工具，URL）选择；预注册实验中 6 个非平局目标对全部降低重复动作（单侧 p=0.015625），最多从 51 步降到 18 步。
objective_summary: 设计无奖励的习惯化调度器，以预注册试点加两阶段确证实验在实验室目标上检验重复动作比例，并另在 MaleCNS 衍生回路上测试局部可塑性方法。
evidence_note: 预注册设计并报告精确单侧检验，但仅 8 个可测实验室目标、6 个非平局对，且无习惯化单独消融。
novelty_note: 把果蝇蘑菇体新颖性处理与习惯化机制迁移到渗透测试智能体的无奖励动作调度。
scope: 适用于 60 步预算、所筛实验室 Web 目标上的完整调度器，不涉及漏洞发现率。
limitations: 样本很小且排除了部分目标；效果不能单独归因于习惯化，也未显示漏洞发现增益。

title: TraceGuard: Adaptive Multimodal Poison Filtering through Cross-Feature Rank Agreement
abstract: Multimodal training relies on image-text corpora collected from external sources, creating opportunities for attackers to poison the data. Stealthy attacks can preserve plausible image-text pairs while concealing the differences used by detectors, so apparently clean data can still redirect the trained model. We therefore ask which properties a poison set must preserve for the attack to remain effective. A small poison set must still exert enough collective influence during training to induce the attacker's target behavior. We analyze this influence in terms of how often an attack pattern occurs and how strongly the examples carrying it jointly affect the model. This analysis motivates six corpus-level features that examine cross-modal neighborhoods, recurring text, and changes after text-span erasure without training the victim model. We introduce TraceGuard, an adaptive rank-based filtering method that uses agreement among complementary feature rankings to identify suspicious examples. It refines the selected set through shared patterns and adapts the removal threshold to each corpus without knowing the attack or poison rate. Across 19 attack configurations spanning image-text learning, generative vision-language model fine-tuning, and encoder-transfer tests, TraceGuard removes an average of 98.4% of poisoned examples and 5.4% of clean examples. After training on the filtered corpora, the residual attack metric is at most 1% in 13 configurations. Matched-removal controls and ablations support the contributions of sample selection and adaptive removal. Stress tests also identify detection failures under adaptive attacks and unnecessary removal on poison-free corpora.

title_cn: TraceGuard：基于跨特征排序一致性的自适应多模态投毒过滤
abstract_cn: 多模态训练依赖从外部来源收集的图文语料，这为攻击者投毒数据创造了机会。隐蔽攻击可以保留看似合理的图文对，同时隐藏检测器所依赖的差异，因此看似干净的数据仍可能使训练出的模型被引偏。为此我们追问：投毒集必须保留哪些性质，攻击才能保持有效？一个小规模投毒集在训练中仍须施加足够的集体影响，才能诱导出攻击者的目标行为。我们从攻击模式出现的频率，以及携带该模式的样本共同影响模型的强度两方面分析这种影响。该分析引出六个语料级特征，它们在不训练受害模型的前提下考察跨模态邻域、重复文本以及文本片段擦除后的变化。我们提出 TraceGuard，一种自适应的基于排序的过滤方法，利用互补特征排序之间的一致性识别可疑样本。它通过共享模式细化所选集合，并在不知道攻击类型或投毒率的情况下为每个语料自适应确定移除阈值。在涵盖图文学习、生成式视觉语言模型微调与编码器迁移测试的 19 种攻击配置上，TraceGuard 平均移除 98.4% 的投毒样本和 5.4% 的干净样本。在过滤后的语料上训练后，有 13 种配置的残余攻击指标至多为 1%。移除量匹配的对照与消融实验支持了样本选择与自适应移除各自的贡献。压力测试也揭示了自适应攻击下的检测失败，以及在无投毒语料上的不必要移除。
summary_cn: TraceGuard 以六个语料级特征的排序一致性过滤多模态投毒样本并自适应定阈值：19 种攻击配置下平均移除 98.4% 投毒与 5.4% 干净样本，13 种配置残余攻击指标不超过 1%。
objective_summary: 基于投毒集集体影响的分析设计六个语料级特征与排序一致性过滤方法，在 19 种攻击配置上评估移除率与训练后残余攻击，并做移除量匹配对照、消融与自适应攻击压力测试。
evidence_note: 19 种攻击配置、三类训练设置，含移除量匹配对照、消融与自适应攻击压力测试；摘要未提统计检验。
novelty_note: 从投毒集须保留的集体影响出发推导特征，以多特征排序一致性免训练、免知投毒率地过滤。

title: The Tokens Remember: When Tokenization Bypasses Knowledge Editing and Unlearning
abstract: Open-weight LLMs give downstream users control over the inference stack, but this flexibility can undermine post-release guarantees that sensitive knowledge has been modified or removed. Model editing and machine unlearning are used to modify or remove targeted knowledge without retraining models from scratch. However, existing security evaluations of these techniques face two critical limitations. First, they typically require access to either the original pre-edit/unlearning model or auxiliary classifiers to detect modifications or reconstruct pre-edit behavior. Second, they evaluate modifications under the canonical tokenization of an input, implicitly treating tokenization as a benign preprocessing step. We show that this assumption creates a security gap: the same input string can be represented by alternative valid tokenizations that induce different computational trajectories, allowing an adversary to bypass localized modifications and recover information intended to be suppressed. We introduce Toketive, a simple yet powerful reference-free attack that exploits the tokenization-based side channel to (i) detect modified knowledge and (ii) reconstruct the corresponding pre-edit response. It operates solely on the released model and requires neither the pre-edit model, training data, shadow models, nor auxiliary classifiers. Across five LLMs, six datasets, and six editing and unlearning techniques, we find that 38.6% of alternative tokenizations bypass the modification and recover the pre-edit response. Toketive detects modified facts with an F1 score of 84.2%, a 26.2% relative gain over the strongest baseline, and reconstructs pre-edit responses with 74.5% top-5 accuracy, 21.7% higher than the best baseline. Our results show that localized modifications should not be treated as robust knowledge-control boundaries without adversarial evaluation over alternative representations.
title_cn: Token 记得：当分词绕过知识编辑与遗忘
abstract_cn: 开放权重 LLM 让下游用户掌控推理栈，但这种灵活性可能破坏发布后「敏感知识已被修改或移除」的保证。模型编辑与机器遗忘被用来在不从头重训模型的情况下修改或移除目标知识。然而，现有针对这些技术的安全评估面临两个关键局限。第一，它们通常需要访问编辑或遗忘之前的原始模型或辅助分类器，才能检测修改或重建编辑前的行为。第二，它们在输入的规范分词下评估修改，隐含地把分词视为良性的预处理步骤。我们表明这一假设造成了安全缺口：同一输入字符串可由不同的合法分词表示，从而诱导出不同的计算轨迹，使攻击者能够绕过局部修改、恢复本应被抑制的信息。我们提出 Toketive，一种简单而强大的无参考攻击，利用基于分词的侧信道来（i）检测被修改的知识，（ii）重建相应的编辑前回答。它仅作用于已发布的模型，既不需要编辑前模型、训练数据、影子模型，也不需要辅助分类器。在五个 LLM、六个数据集和六种编辑与遗忘技术上，我们发现 38.6% 的替代分词能绕过修改并恢复编辑前回答。Toketive 检测被修改事实的 F1 分数为 84.2%，较最强基线相对提升 26.2%；重建编辑前回答的 top-5 准确率为 74.5%，比最佳基线高 21.7%。我们的结果表明，在未对替代表示进行对抗性评估之前，不应将局部修改视为稳健的知识控制边界。
summary_cn: 提出 Toketive：用同一字符串的替代合法分词绕过模型编辑与机器遗忘，38.6% 的替代分词可恢复编辑前回答；检测修改 F1 84.2%，重建 top-5 准确率 74.5%，均超最强基线。
objective_summary: 提出仅需已发布模型的无参考攻击 Toketive，通过替代分词检测并重建被编辑或遗忘的知识，在五个 LLM、六个数据集、六种技术上与基线比较。
evidence_note: 五个 LLM、六个数据集、六种编辑与遗忘技术的组合评估，并与多个基线对比；摘要未报统计检验。
novelty_note: 指出分词并非良性预处理，把替代分词用作无参考绕过编辑与遗忘的侧信道。
scope: 适用于可自定义输入分词的开放权重 LLM 及所测局部编辑与遗忘技术。
limitations: 攻击前提是能控制分词的开放权重访问，对仅 API 访问的模型未验证；未给出防御。

title: The Vulnerability of Neural Audio Watermarks under Speech Enhancement
abstract: Neural audio watermarks are increasingly deployed in commercial speech generation systems to make AI-generated speech traceable, yet their robustness has been studied mainly under conventional signal distortions. Since a watermark can be regarded as imperceptible noise added to the speech signal, a natural question is whether speech enhancement (SE), as a denoising model, can remove it. In this paper, we cascade Gaussian noise with SE models as a black-box watermark removal attack, covering both discriminative and generative SE paradigms, against six neural watermarks: AudioSeal, WavMark, SilentCipher, Timbre, Perth, and AlignMark. Experimental results show that the proposed attack significantly outperforms existing neural re-synthesis methods in watermark removal. In particular, we find that generative SE, which reconstructs the harmonic regions of speech while denoising, is highly destructive to watermarks. These findings show that SE poses a serious threat to current audio watermarking methods, and we call for SE-aware robustness evaluation in watermark design.
title_cn: 语音增强下神经音频水印的脆弱性
abstract_cn: 神经音频水印正越来越多地部署于商用语音生成系统中，以使 AI 生成的语音可追溯，但其鲁棒性主要是在常规信号失真下研究的。由于水印可被视为叠加在语音信号上的不可感知噪声，一个自然的问题是：作为去噪模型的语音增强（SE）能否将其去除。本文将高斯噪声与 SE 模型级联，作为一种黑盒水印去除攻击，覆盖判别式与生成式两类 SE 范式，针对六种神经水印：AudioSeal、WavMark、SilentCipher、Timbre、Perth 与 AlignMark。实验结果表明，所提攻击在水印去除上显著优于现有的神经重合成方法。特别地，我们发现生成式 SE 在去噪的同时会重建语音的谐波区域，对水印具有高度破坏性。这些发现表明 SE 对当前音频水印方法构成严重威胁，我们呼吁在水印设计中进行考虑 SE 的鲁棒性评估。
summary_cn: 把「加高斯噪声 + 语音增强模型」级联为黑盒去水印攻击，测试 AudioSeal、WavMark 等六种神经音频水印，去除效果显著优于神经重合成方法，生成式 SE 破坏性尤大。
objective_summary: 以高斯噪声级联判别式与生成式语音增强模型作为黑盒去除攻击，在六种神经音频水印上与现有神经重合成去除方法对比。
evidence_note: 覆盖六种水印与两类 SE 范式并与重合成方法对比；摘要未给具体检测率或语音质量数值。
novelty_note: 把常用去噪工具语音增强识别为音频水印的去除威胁，此前鲁棒性评估多限于常规失真。
scope: 适用于所测六种神经音频水印与所选 SE 模型的黑盒去除场景。
limitations: 未提出相应防御；去水印后语音质量与可用性的权衡摘要未量化说明。

title: DistillGuard: Malicious NPM Package Detection and API Attack Chain Analysis via Static Graph and LLM Distillation
abstract: The Node.js ecosystem heavily relies on NPM packages, and software supply chain attacks targeting malicious NPM packages are rampant. Malicious code primarily triggers during package installation, import, and runtime. Traditional static analysis fails to understand code semantics; machine learning-based methods rely on feature extraction, which suffers from concept drift; existing LLM solutions suffer from high invocation costs, high data security risks, and poor performance. To overcome these limitations, we propose DistillGuard, a lightweight malicious NPM package detection framework that combines static graph semantic analysis and LLM knowledge distillation. DistillGuard first acquires multi-granular features through three static analysis modules. Then, it leverages online LLM to distill high-quality security knowledge and structured labels. Finally, it uses LoRa to efficiently fine-tune the open-source Qwen3-8B model to support offline deployment. Experiments show that DistillGuard achieves an accuracy of 95.3\%, a precision of 99.4\%, and an F1 score of 93.8\%, outperforming state-of-the-art tools, improving the F1-score by 11.1 to 30.0 percentage points over the baselines. Our empirical research further reveals the stages of malicious attacks and the distribution of malicious behaviors. We also summarized eight typical API attack chains for malicious activities, providing practical insights for NPM supply chain security defense.
title_cn: DistillGuard：基于静态图与 LLM 蒸馏的恶意 NPM 包检测及 API 攻击链分析
abstract_cn: Node.js 生态高度依赖 NPM 包，针对恶意 NPM 包的软件供应链攻击十分猖獗。恶意代码主要在包的安装、导入与运行时触发。传统静态分析无法理解代码语义；基于机器学习的方法依赖特征提取，受概念漂移困扰；现有 LLM 方案则存在调用成本高、数据安全风险高且性能不佳的问题。为克服这些局限，我们提出 DistillGuard，一个结合静态图语义分析与 LLM 知识蒸馏的轻量级恶意 NPM 包检测框架。DistillGuard 首先通过三个静态分析模块获取多粒度特征；然后利用在线 LLM 蒸馏出高质量的安全知识与结构化标签；最后使用 LoRA 高效微调开源的 Qwen3-8B 模型，以支持离线部署。实验表明，DistillGuard 的准确率达 95.3%、精确率 99.4%、F1 分数 93.8%，优于最先进的工具，F1 分数比基线提高 11.1 至 30.0 个百分点。我们的实证研究进一步揭示了恶意攻击的阶段与恶意行为的分布。我们还总结了恶意活动的八种典型 API 攻击链，为 NPM 供应链安全防御提供了实践启示。
summary_cn: DistillGuard 结合静态图特征与 LLM 知识蒸馏微调 Qwen3-8B 检测恶意 NPM 包：F1 93.8%，比基线高 11.1–30.0 个百分点，另归纳 8 种 API 攻击链。
objective_summary: 提出以静态图特征与 LLM 蒸馏标签微调 Qwen3-8B 的恶意 NPM 包检测框架，与现有工具比较检测指标，并对恶意包的攻击阶段与 API 攻击链做实证归纳。
evidence_note: 报告准确率、精确率与 F1 并与多个现有工具对比；摘要未给数据集规模及应对概念漂移的时间切分评估。
novelty_note: 静态分析特征、LLM 知识蒸馏与 LoRA 微调均为已有技术，此处组合用于 NPM 恶意包检测。
scope: 适用于 NPM 生态中在安装、导入与运行时触发的恶意包。
limitations: 蒸馏标签质量依赖在线 LLM；对混淆或针对性规避的鲁棒性摘要未评估。

title: Calibrated Decision Models for Autonomous Penetration-Testing Harnesses: JEV and Laya as System One Decision Layers for LLM-Driven Pentest Agents
abstract: Autonomous penetration-testing harnesses use large language models (LLMs) for reconnaissance, exploitation, and reporting, but often rely on those same models to confirm findings, grade severity, and select agents. This can lead to false positives, inflated severity, and wasted compute. We examine how System One decision models, lightweight non-generative classifiers that return typed, calibrated verdicts, can support these decisions. We make five contributions. First, we define four decision points: finding adjudication, severity recalibration, agent pruning, and confirmation loops. Second, we present an exploratory NeuroSploit case study comparing one run with TypeSafe System One (Jev) and one without it against a web target containing 13 vulnerabilities. Differences in severity distribution, runtime, and grading by exposed data type motivate the architecture but do not establish statistical significance. Third, we review published specifications for Jev, Jev-Ultrafast, and the open-source Laya without assuming that results from other benchmarks transfer to penetration testing. Fourth, we discuss RLHF, RLAIF, RLCD, and RLHV as training approaches and their implications for trust in security decisions. Finally, we propose Rave, a domain-adapted System One model, and outline its training data, evaluation protocol, and potential effect on harness assurance.

title_cn: 面向自主渗透测试 Harness 的校准决策模型：JEV 与 Laya 作为 LLM 驱动渗透测试智能体的 System One 决策层
abstract_cn: 自主渗透测试 harness 使用大语言模型（LLM）进行侦察、利用与报告，但常常依赖同样的模型来确认发现、评定严重性并选择智能体。这可能导致误报、严重性虚高与计算浪费。我们考察 System One 决策模型——返回类型化、校准判定的轻量级非生成式分类器——如何支撑这些决策。我们做出五项贡献。第一，定义四个决策点：发现裁决、严重性重校准、智能体剪枝与确认循环。第二，给出一个探索性的 NeuroSploit 案例研究，在一个含 13 个漏洞的 Web 目标上，比较一次使用 TypeSafe System One（Jev）的运行与一次不使用的运行。严重性分布、运行时间以及按暴露数据类型评级方面的差异为该架构提供了动机，但并不构成统计显著性。第三，我们回顾 Jev、Jev-Ultrafast 与开源 Laya 的已发布规格，且不假定其他基准上的结果可迁移到渗透测试。第四，我们讨论 RLHF、RLAIF、RLCD 与 RLHV 作为训练方法及其对安全决策可信度的影响。最后，我们提出 Rave——一个领域适配的 System One 模型，并概述其训练数据、评估协议及对 harness 保障的潜在作用。
summary_cn: 主张用轻量校准分类器（Jev、Laya）承担渗透测试 harness 的四类决策，仅以一次有/无 Jev 的 NeuroSploit 对比运行作动机，并提出领域模型 Rave。
objective_summary: 定义渗透测试 harness 中的四个决策点，以单次对比运行的探索性案例、已发布模型规格回顾与训练方法讨论论证轻量校准分类器的作用，并提出 Rave 设计。
evidence_note: 实证仅为单一 Web 目标上各一次的有/无 Jev 运行，作者明言不具统计显著性；其余为规格回顾与讨论。
novelty_note: 把现成分类器用于渗透测试决策点属应用构想，Rave 仅停留在提案层面。
scope: 针对 LLM 驱动的自主渗透测试 harness；案例仅 NeuroSploit 单一 Web 目标。
limitations: 案例仅单次运行对比且无统计显著性；所提 Rave 模型尚未训练与评估。

title: Control the Harness, Control the Cost: Routing and Governing AI Coding Agents in the Enterprise
abstract: Harnesses, the products that run AI coding agents, are multiplying, and enterprises are rolling them out to their employees: what started as pilots with a few hundred seats is scaling to tens of thousands. Most enterprises do not build these harnesses but buy them from large vendors, such as Anthropic's Claude Code or OpenAI's Codex. A harness decides which model answers, what the model reads, how the prompt cache is used and which subagents run, so it picks the rate on the price sheet and sets the volume bought at it. Enterprises that keep a proprietary or untuned harness at its defaults inherit these choices and their bill. We build a fast, customisable router in which Jev, a classifier with calibrated probabilities, labels every prompt against a bring-your-own taxonomy of agentic requests. Because one user turn is many requests over a prompt cache that belongs to one model, the router moves work only where no running conversation has to rebuild its cache: at session start, in side lanes and at subagent launch. From the price sheet we derive when a mid-task switch pays back, and a crossover: on long tool-heavy sessions the highest-priced model costs less than the next tier, as repricing about 10,000 real sessions from public datasets confirms. In an emulated enterprise of 10,000 seats with user behaviour taken from these datasets, the router recovers 14 to 21% of model spend at Anthropic's list prices of 21 September 2026, \$3.3M to \$5.0M a year. The paper also maps the risks across twenty harnesses, prices the dependence on one vendor's models, and proposes a control plane that enterprises can run from within, starting now, with a ladder for deciding later whether to own the harness.
comment: 32 pages, 13 figures, 8 tables
title_cn: 掌控 Harness，掌控成本：企业中 AI 编程智能体的路由与治理
abstract_cn: Harness（运行 AI 编程智能体的产品）正在增多，企业正将其推广给员工：起初仅数百席位的试点正扩展到数万席位。多数企业并不自建这些 harness，而是向大型厂商购买，如 Anthropic 的 Claude Code 或 OpenAI 的 Codex。Harness 决定由哪个模型作答、模型读取什么、提示缓存如何使用以及运行哪些子智能体，因此它既选定了价目表上的费率，也决定了按该费率购买的用量。将专有或未调优的 harness 保持默认设置的企业，会继承这些选择及其账单。我们构建了一个快速、可定制的路由器，其中 Jev——一个输出校准概率的分类器——依据用户自带的智能体请求分类体系为每条提示打标签。由于一个用户回合是在归属于单一模型的提示缓存之上发出的多次请求，路由器只在无需任何进行中对话重建缓存的地方转移工作：会话开始时、旁路通道中以及子智能体启动时。我们从价目表推导出任务中途切换模型何时能够回本，并得到一个交叉点：在长时间、工具调用密集的会话中，最高价模型的花费低于次一档模型，对公开数据集中约 10,000 个真实会话重新计价证实了这一点。在一个用户行为取自这些数据集、模拟的 10,000 席位企业中，按 Anthropic 2026 年 9 月 21 日的标价，路由器可挽回 14% 至 21% 的模型支出，即每年 330 万至 500 万美元。本文还梳理了二十种 harness 的风险，为对单一厂商模型的依赖定价，并提出一个企业可从内部运行、现在即可启动的控制平面，以及一个用于日后决定是否自有 harness 的阶梯式决策框架。
summary_cn: 提出以 Jev 分类器标注提示、只在不需重建提示缓存处切换模型的路由器；模拟 10,000 席位企业中挽回 14%–21% 模型支出（每年 330 万至 500 万美元）。
objective_summary: 构建缓存感知的提示路由器并从价目表推导切换回本条件，用约 10,000 个公开真实会话重新计价与 10,000 席位企业模拟估算节省，另梳理二十种 harness 的风险。
evidence_note: 约 10,000 个公开会话重新计价加 10,000 席位模拟；节省为按标价的模拟估算，非真实部署测量。
novelty_note: 将提示缓存归属约束纳入智能体请求路由，并给出长会话中高价模型反而更省的交叉点。
scope: 适用于 Anthropic 2026-09-21 标价、所用公开会话数据集与模拟的用户行为。
limitations: 节省数字来自模拟而非真实企业部署，且与单一厂商的定价结构强绑定。

title: Fast Frame Rate Estimation in Electromagnetic Side-Channel Attacks on Public Systems
abstract: Frame refresh rate estimation is a fundamental step in identifying compromising harmonic frequencies in electromagnetic side-channel attacks. Methods based on discrete linear autocorrelation (DLA) are robust across different scenarios and require a computational complexity of $O(N\log N)$ for a signal containing $N$ samples. This work proposes reducing this complexity to $O(N)$ by exploiting prior knowledge of the target system's display resolution, as is available for certain models of the Brazilian electronic voting machine. Experiments using software-defined radios show that the proposed method preserves the accuracy of the conventional approach in the evaluated scenarios.
comment: English version of work originally published in Portuguese in the extended Proceedings of the XXVI Brazilian Symposium on Cybersecurity (SBSEG), 2026
title_cn: 面向公共系统电磁侧信道攻击的快速帧率估计
abstract_cn: 帧刷新率估计是电磁侧信道攻击中识别泄露性谐波频率的基础步骤。基于离散线性自相关（DLA）的方法在不同场景下都较鲁棒，对含 N 个采样点的信号需要 O(N log N) 的计算复杂度。本文提出利用目标系统显示分辨率的先验知识，将该复杂度降至 O(N)；这类先验对巴西电子投票机的某些型号是可获得的。使用软件定义无线电的实验表明，所提方法在所评估的场景中保持了传统方法的精度。
summary_cn: 利用目标显示分辨率先验，把电磁侧信道攻击中的帧刷新率估计从 O(N log N) 降到 O(N)，软件定义无线电实验中精度与传统 DLA 方法相当（SBSEG 2026 葡语论文英文版）。
objective_summary: 提出基于显示分辨率先验的 O(N) 帧刷新率估计方法，并以软件定义无线电采集实验与传统 DLA 方法比较估计精度。
evidence_note: 仅有软件定义无线电的场景实验，摘要未给场景数量、样本规模或定量误差数据。
novelty_note: 在既有 DLA 估计流程上引入分辨率先验以降低复杂度，属效率层面的改进。
scope: 适用于显示分辨率可事先获知的目标（如特定型号巴西电子投票机）及所测场景。
limitations: 依赖目标分辨率先验，分辨率未知时不适用；所评估场景的范围摘要未说明。

title: On the Effectiveness of Kernel-Level Evidence for Agent Security
abstract: LLM agents are deployed into infrastructure that grants them broad host authority, yet existing agent-security benchmarks and defenses operate almost exclusively at the application telemetry layer: the served tool manifest, the user prompt, and the model's messages. Some threats, however, smuggle malicious instructions and actions past the application boundary, leaving them invisible to that layer. In this work, we bridge that gap by pairing application-level agent telemetry with kernel-level syscall traces to present the first paired-evidence characterization of kernel-level versus application-layer signal for agent security. To quantify the value of the enhanced telemetry, we introduce Agent Cross-Layer Evidence (ACE), a paired-session corpus of 4,047 sessions and 17 threat models spanning six delivery-vector families and 14 of the 25 OWASP LLM and agentic threat categories, organized into 12 attack mechanics with per-mechanic characterization of where the most discriminative evidence lies. Across four distinct detector families, we find that kernel evidence is discriminative on its own and that composing it with application-layer evidence generally outperforms either single-layer view, revealing complementary signals that single-layer analyses can miss. We further demonstrate generalization to unseen attack families and transfer to an alternate agent runtime. Together, these findings establish the value of cross-layer evidence for agent security.
comment: 53 pages, 2 figures, 28 tables, including appendices
title_cn: 论内核级证据在智能体安全中的有效性
abstract_cn: LLM 智能体被部署到授予其广泛主机权限的基础设施中，但现有智能体安全基准与防御几乎只在应用遥测层运作：所提供的工具清单、用户提示与模型消息。然而，某些威胁会把恶意指令与动作夹带越过应用边界，使该层无从察觉。本文将应用级智能体遥测与内核级系统调用轨迹配对以弥合这一差距，首次给出内核级与应用层信号在智能体安全中的配对证据刻画。为量化增强遥测的价值，我们提出 Agent Cross-Layer Evidence（ACE）：一个含 4,047 个会话与 17 种威胁模型的配对会话语料，覆盖六类投递向量家族及 25 个 OWASP LLM 与智能体威胁类别中的 14 个，组织为 12 种攻击机理，并逐机理刻画最具判别力的证据所在位置。在四类不同的检测器家族上，我们发现内核证据本身即具判别力，且将其与应用层证据组合通常优于任一单层视图，揭示了单层分析可能遗漏的互补信号。我们进一步展示了对未见攻击家族的泛化，以及向另一种智能体运行时的迁移。这些发现共同确立了跨层证据对智能体安全的价值。
summary_cn: 构建 4,047 会话、17 种威胁模型的配对语料 ACE，对比内核系统调用与应用层遥测：内核证据单独即有判别力，两层组合通常优于单层，并能泛化到未见攻击家族与另一运行时。
objective_summary: 将应用层智能体遥测与内核系统调用轨迹配对采集构建 ACE 语料，用四类检测器比较单层与跨层证据的判别力，并测试对未见攻击家族的泛化与跨运行时迁移。
evidence_note: 4,047 会话、17 种威胁模型、四类检测器的单层/跨层对比，含未见攻击家族与跨运行时测试；摘要未报统计检验。
novelty_note: 首次在同一会话上配对内核与应用层证据，逐攻击机理刻画智能体威胁的可检测位置。
scope: 适用于 ACE 覆盖的 17 种威胁模型、12 种攻击机理与所测两种智能体运行时。
limitations: 仅覆盖 25 个 OWASP 威胁类别中的 14 个；内核级采集的运行开销与部署成本摘要未涉及。

title: Codetta: High-Capacity, Keyless, and Undetectable Multi-Agent Collusion
abstract: Multi-agent systems built on large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings such as finance, healthcare, and software engineering, where agents coordinate through natural-language messages. The same channels, however, let colluding agents exfiltrate confidential information or coordinate unauthorized actions, and steganography can hide such communication inside outputs that look ordinary to an auditor reading the transcript. Existing provably undetectable LLM steganography protocols are not suited to realistic deployments. High-capacity schemes assume a symmetric setting where the receiver can reproduce the sender's output distribution, the state-of-the-art protocol for asymmetric agents has very low capacity, and most approaches rely on a pre-shared secret key. We make the threat of undetectable agent collusion concrete with Codetta, a high-capacity steganographic protocol for independently deployed agents in realistic asymmetric settings. Codetta combines a shared public model that estimates the communication channel, a sampling mechanism that preserves the sender's output distribution, and an adaptive error-correcting code. It further removes the pre-shared key through a steganographic key exchange that lets independently deployed agents establish a shared key while keeping the transcript computationally indistinguishable from ordinary model outputs. Across three agent workloads and three sender models, Codetta achieves up to $94\times$ the capacity of the state-of-the-art asymmetric protocol, and its key exchange establishes a shared key with about 80k visible tokens at an empirically certified failure probability of at most $4.1\times 10^{-3}$. These results show that effectively undetectable collusion is becoming feasible between independently deployed agents, so auditing must go beyond inspecting communication transcripts.
title_cn: Codetta：高容量、无密钥且不可检测的多智能体合谋
abstract_cn: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统正越来越多地部署在金融、医疗和软件工程等高风险场景中，智能体之间通过自然语言消息进行协调。然而，同样的通道也让合谋的智能体得以外泄机密信息或协调未授权行为，而隐写术可以把此类通信隐藏在审计者阅读记录时看起来普通的输出之中。现有可证明不可检测的 LLM 隐写协议并不适用于现实部署：高容量方案假设对称设定，即接收方能复现发送方的输出分布；面向非对称智能体的最先进协议容量很低；且大多数方法依赖预共享密钥。我们用 Codetta 把不可检测的智能体合谋威胁具体化：它是一个面向现实非对称设定下独立部署智能体的高容量隐写协议。Codetta 结合了一个估计通信信道的共享公开模型、一个保持发送方输出分布的采样机制，以及一个自适应纠错码。它进一步通过隐写密钥交换去掉了预共享密钥：该交换让独立部署的智能体建立共享密钥，同时使通信记录与普通模型输出在计算上不可区分。在三种智能体工作负载与三个发送方模型上，Codetta 的容量最高达到最先进非对称协议的 94 倍，其密钥交换以约 80k 个可见 token 建立共享密钥，经验认证的失败概率至多为 4.1×10^(-3)。这些结果表明，独立部署智能体之间实际上不可检测的合谋正变得可行，因此审计必须超越对通信记录的检查。
summary_cn: 提出面向非对称独立部署智能体的隐写协议 Codetta 及隐写密钥交换：容量最高为最先进非对称协议的 94 倍，约 80k 可见 token 建立密钥，失败概率不超过 4.1×10^(-3)。
objective_summary: 结合共享公开模型、保分布采样与自适应纠错码构建非对称 LLM 隐写协议并加入隐写密钥交换，在三种工作负载、三个发送方模型上与最先进非对称协议比较容量与失败率。
evidence_note: 三工作负载 × 三发送方模型并与最先进非对称协议对比容量，密钥交换给出经验认证的失败概率上界。
novelty_note: 在非对称设定下同时实现高容量与无预共享密钥，并以隐写密钥交换让独立部署智能体建立密钥。
scope: 结论限于所测三种智能体工作负载、三个发送方模型及基于共享公开模型的信道估计。
limitations: 密钥交换需约 80k 可见 token，开销较大；不可检测性为计算意义，依赖公开模型对信道的估计质量。

title: When Do Differentially Private Inputs Protect Graph Shift Operators?
abstract: We study the differential privacy (DP) of a graph shift operator (GSO) when an analyst observes the output of a graph filter. In particular, we study the setting in which the input signals to the graph filter are drawn from a differentially private distribution. Unlike approaches that perturb the GSO or the filter output, we use the randomness already present in the inputs to protect the GSO. This yields an equivalent level of privacy protection to that of the perturbation methods without adding noise, and thus a better privacy-utility trade-off. We provide an explicit characterization of the privacy loss and its certificate in terms of the zeros of the graph filter. In doing so, we show that the log-likelihood ratio between the releases of two adjacent topologies is governed by the distances from each zero to the graph frequencies of the two GSOs. Then, by uniformly bounding the log-likelihood ratio over the adjacent topologies, we obtain an explicit $(\varepsilon,\delta)$-DP guarantee for Gaussian inputs. We further show, via a Cram\'er--Rao bound, that the zero placement that limits the privacy loss also raises the floor on the adversary's reconstruction error. Finally, empirical validation is performed on a synthetic network of financial exposures, where the largest position a pair can conceal and the accuracy with which it can be sized are collinear across pairs. Both are set by the graph-frequency content of the pair, and the full network becomes recoverable only as the certified budget grows.
title_cn: 差分隐私输入何时能保护图移位算子？
abstract_cn: 我们研究当分析者观测到图滤波器的输出时，图移位算子（GSO）的差分隐私（DP）。具体而言，我们研究图滤波器的输入信号取自一个差分隐私分布的设定。不同于扰动 GSO 或滤波器输出的方法，我们利用输入中已有的随机性来保护 GSO。这在不添加噪声的情况下获得与扰动方法同等水平的隐私保护，因而具有更好的隐私-效用权衡。我们以图滤波器零点的形式，给出隐私损失及其证书的显式刻画。由此我们表明，两个相邻拓扑的发布之间的对数似然比，由每个零点到两个 GSO 的图频率的距离所决定。随后，通过在相邻拓扑上一致地界定对数似然比，我们对高斯输入得到显式的 (ε, δ)-DP 保证。我们还通过 Cramér-Rao 界表明，限制隐私损失的零点配置同时也抬高了攻击者重构误差的下限。最后，我们在一个合成的金融敞口网络上进行实证验证：其中一对节点所能隐藏的最大头寸与该头寸可被估计的精度在各节点对之间呈共线关系。二者都由该节点对的图频率成分决定，且只有当认证的隐私预算增大时，完整网络才变得可恢复。
summary_cn: 利用图滤波器输入信号自身的随机性保护图拓扑（GSO），以滤波器零点刻画隐私损失，对高斯输入给出显式 (ε, δ)-DP 保证，并以 Cramér-Rao 界关联重构误差，在合成金融敞口网络上验证。
objective_summary: 推导图滤波器输出对 GSO 的隐私损失与 (ε, δ)-DP 保证、以 Cramér-Rao 界分析攻击者重构误差，并在合成金融敞口网络上做数值验证。
evidence_note: 给出隐私损失显式刻画、DP 保证与 Cramér-Rao 下界推导；实证仅在一个合成网络上进行，无真实数据。
novelty_note: 不另加噪、改用输入随机性保护图拓扑，并把隐私损失与滤波器零点位置联系起来。
scope: 结论限于图滤波器输出发布、高斯输入信号与相邻拓扑定义下的 GSO 隐私。
limitations: DP 保证只对高斯输入给出；验证仅用合成网络，对真实图数据与非高斯输入未评估。

title: Blockchain-Enabled Artificial Intelligence and AI Agents for Secure Data Sharing and Cybersecurity Applications
abstract: Blockchain and artificial intelligence (AI) are converging into a single infrastructural layer for securing data sharing, model integrity, and autonomous decision-making across distributed systems. This paper presents a meta-synthesis that draws together four constituent studies covering adversarial machine learning, AI-powered anomaly detection in cloud environments, automated vulnerability patching by multi-agent large language model (LLM) pipelines, and the broader landscape of securing AI systems across their lifecycle and situates their findings within the emerging literature on blockchain-enabled AI and autonomous AI agents. Each constituent study addresses a distinct point of failure in modern AI-driven security operations: the integrity of training data and model behavior, the reliability of real-time monitoring, and the trustworthiness of automated code remediation. We argue that blockchain's properties of immutability, decentralized consensus, and verifiable provenance directly address a gap common to all three: the difficulty of establishing trust in data, models, and autonomous agents that operate without a central authority. Building on real-world research on blockchain-secured data sharing, federated learning, and multi-agent coordination, we propose a layered reference architecture that couples adversarially hardened models, blockchain-anchored data provenance, AI-driven anomaly detection, and smart-contract-governed multi-agent remediation. We conclude by identifying open problems in scalability, privacy-transparency trade-offs, and the governance of autonomous agents that must be resolved before such integrated systems can be trusted in production-critical environments.
comment: published in International Journal of Scientific Research and Management (IJSRM) , published date : August 6, 2026, issue : Vol. 14, No. 08, (2026), pages : 2972-2978, doi : https://doi.org/10.18535/ijsrm/v14i08.ec03
title_cn: 面向安全数据共享与网络安全应用的区块链赋能人工智能与 AI 智能体
abstract_cn: 区块链与人工智能（AI）正融合为统一的基础设施层，用于在分布式系统中保障数据共享、模型完整性与自主决策的安全。本文提出一项元综合（meta-synthesis），汇集四项组成研究——分别涉及对抗性机器学习、云环境中 AI 驱动的异常检测、多智能体大语言模型（LLM）流水线的自动漏洞修补，以及 AI 系统全生命周期安全的更广泛图景——并将其发现置于区块链赋能 AI 与自主 AI 智能体的新兴文献之中。每项组成研究针对现代 AI 驱动安全运营中的一个不同失效点：训练数据与模型行为的完整性、实时监控的可靠性，以及自动代码修复的可信度。我们认为，区块链的不可篡改性、去中心化共识与可验证溯源等特性，直接回应了三者共有的一个缺口：在缺乏中心权威的情况下，难以对数据、模型与自主智能体建立信任。基于区块链保障的数据共享、联邦学习与多智能体协调方面的真实研究，我们提出一个分层参考架构，将对抗加固的模型、区块链锚定的数据溯源、AI 驱动的异常检测以及智能合约治理的多智能体修复结合起来。最后，我们指出了在可扩展性、隐私与透明性的权衡以及自主智能体治理方面的开放问题，这些问题必须在此类集成系统能在生产关键环境中获得信任之前得到解决。
summary_cn: 对四项涉及对抗 ML、云异常检测、多智能体 LLM 漏洞修补与 AI 生命周期安全的研究做元综合，提出结合区块链溯源与智能合约治理的分层参考架构并列出开放问题（IJSRM）。
objective_summary: 综合四项组成研究与区块链赋能 AI 的相关文献，论证区块链特性对 AI 安全信任缺口的作用，提出分层参考架构并列出开放问题。
evidence_note: 以四项组成研究的综合与论证为主；摘要未报告参考架构的实现、实验或案例验证，也未说明文献选取方法。
novelty_note: 区块链与 AI 安全结合的分层架构属常见思路组合，未给出新的机制或发现。
scope: 论述针对分布式环境中的 AI 驱动安全运营，未限定具体系统或威胁模型。
limitations: 架构停留在概念层面，可扩展性与隐私权衡等关键问题仅列为开放问题；综合范围只有四项研究。

title: Unmasking Shortcut Learning in IoT Intrusion Detection: A Forensic, Multi-Paradigm Evaluation of Feature Dependence and Data Leakage
abstract: Machine learning-based Network Intrusion Detection Systems often report near-perfect performance on IoT benchmarks. However, whether these models learn generalizable attack behavior or exploit spurious dataset shortcuts- such as static testbed IP/MAC addresses and chronological recording artifacts-remains an important question. We evaluate the CyberFlowIoT-GICAP benchmark, containing 3,617,388 flow records across 126 PCAP sessions with 849,395 benign flows. Four learning paradigms are evaluated across four feature configurations using PCAP-disjoint splits; LightGBM is additionally evaluated using conventional random-flow splitting. When only statistical flow behavior is used (Fbehav), LightGBM (92.58% +/- 8.18%), Random Forest (92.59% +/- 8.18%), and Deep MLP (92.55% +/- 8.18%) achieve nearly identical Macro-F1, indicating that performance is constrained by feature representation rather than model complexity. With raw timestamps (Ftstamp), tree-based models reach 99.28% Macro-F1, while the linear model remains at 90.62%, showing that nonlinear models can exploit dataset-specific temporal structure. Attack detectability is highly asymmetric: high-rate and active attacks maintain >99.8% recall from flow behavior alone in nonlinear models, whereas the DNS Beaconing drops from 27.78% to 0.00% recall when contextual features are removed. Conventional random-flow splitting increases attack recall by up to 14.00%, highlighting the effect of placing flows from the same sessions in both training and test sets. We conclude with a 4-point protocol checklist for realistic IoT NIDS evaluation.
comment: Currently under review
title_cn: 揭示 IoT 入侵检测中的捷径学习：特征依赖与数据泄漏的取证式多范式评估
abstract_cn: 基于机器学习的网络入侵检测系统在 IoT 基准上常报告近乎完美的性能。然而，这些模型究竟学到了可泛化的攻击行为，还是利用了虚假的数据集捷径——如静态测试床 IP/MAC 地址和按时间顺序录制带来的伪影——仍是一个重要问题。我们评估了 CyberFlowIoT-GICAP 基准，它包含 126 个 PCAP 会话中的 3,617,388 条流记录，其中良性流 849,395 条。我们采用 PCAP 不相交划分，在四种特征配置下评估四种学习范式；另外还用常规的随机流划分评估了 LightGBM。仅使用统计流行为（Fbehav）时，LightGBM（92.58% ± 8.18%）、随机森林（92.59% ± 8.18%）与深度 MLP（92.55% ± 8.18%）的 Macro-F1 几乎相同，表明性能受限于特征表示而非模型复杂度。使用原始时间戳（Ftstamp）时，树模型达到 99.28% 的 Macro-F1，而线性模型仍为 90.62%，说明非线性模型能够利用数据集特有的时间结构。攻击可检测性高度不对称：在非线性模型中，高速率与主动攻击仅凭流行为即可保持 >99.8% 的召回率，而移除上下文特征后，DNS Beaconing 的召回率从 27.78% 降至 0.00%。常规随机流划分使攻击召回率最多提升 14.00%，凸显了把同一会话的流同时放入训练集与测试集的影响。最后，我们给出一份面向真实 IoT NIDS 评估的 4 点协议清单。
summary_cn: 在 361 万条流的 IoT 基准上检验 NIDS 捷径学习：纯流行为特征下三类模型 Macro-F1 均约 92.6%，加时间戳后树模型达 99.28%，随机划分使召回率虚高最多 14.00%。
objective_summary: 在单一 IoT 流量基准上，以 PCAP 不相交划分评估四种学习范式 × 四种特征配置，并对 LightGBM 加做随机流划分，测量模型对时间戳与上下文特征的依赖及泄漏带来的性能虚高。
evidence_note: 约 361 万条流、126 个会话，多范式多特征配置并以随机划分作对照，报告均值与标准差；仅单一基准。
novelty_note: 把捷径与泄漏检验细化到特征配置与攻击类型层面，给出按攻击的可检测性差异与评估清单。
scope: 结论限于 CyberFlowIoT-GICAP 基准、所评估的四种学习范式与流级特征表示。
limitations: 只用一个测试床数据集，跨数据集泛化未验证；4 点清单未在其他基准上检验。

title: zkSAS: Practical Zero-Knowledge Proofs for Verifiable Spectrum Access Management
abstract: Dynamic Spectrum Access (DSA) through the Spectrum Access Systems (SAS) elevates spectral efficiency, yet existing centralized models face allocation logic opaqueness and a lack of independent verifiability. While blockchain-based SAS architectures offer transparency and verifiability by default, they introduce critical privacy risks and prohibitive on-chain computational overhead. We introduce zkSAS, a practical zero-knowledge proof (ZKP) system designed to address the verifiability and privacy gaps in SAS deployments, with direct applicability to both the existing CBRS SAS model and blockchain-based SAS models. The system features a suite of ZKP circuits, encompassing proofs of allocation constraint validity and proofs of move list validity to verify that channel assignments and move list-based incumbent protection measures, respectively, adhere to regulatory constraints without exposing sensitive user data. Comprehensive evaluation of our prototype in both centralized and blockchain-based settings indicates that while proof generation scales with spectrum user population, verification remains lightweight and constant-time. We envision that zkSAS offers a scalable and practical path to secure, verifiable dynamic spectrum sharing.
comment: Accepted for publication at the 2026 IEEE International Symposium on Spectrum Innovation (DySPAN), Washington, DC, USA, 2026
title_cn: zkSAS：面向可验证频谱接入管理的实用零知识证明
abstract_cn: 通过频谱接入系统（SAS）实现的动态频谱接入（DSA）提升了频谱效率，但现有集中式模式存在分配逻辑不透明、缺乏独立可验证性的问题。基于区块链的 SAS 架构虽然默认提供透明性与可验证性，却引入了严重的隐私风险和过高的链上计算开销。我们提出 zkSAS，一个实用的零知识证明（ZKP）系统，旨在弥补 SAS 部署中的可验证性与隐私缺口，可直接用于现有的 CBRS SAS 模式和基于区块链的 SAS 模式。该系统包含一组 ZKP 电路，涵盖分配约束有效性证明与移动列表有效性证明，分别用于验证信道分配和基于移动列表的在位用户保护措施符合监管约束，同时不暴露敏感用户数据。在集中式与基于区块链两种设置下对原型的全面评估表明，尽管证明生成开销随频谱用户数量增长，验证始终轻量且为常数时间。我们认为 zkSAS 为安全、可验证的动态频谱共享提供了一条可扩展且实用的路径。
summary_cn: 提出 zkSAS，用分配约束与移动列表有效性两类 ZKP 电路在不泄露用户数据的前提下验证 SAS 频谱分配合规；原型评估显示证明生成随用户数增长、验证为常数时间（DySPAN'26）。
objective_summary: 为 SAS 频谱分配设计 ZKP 电路以证明分配与在位用户保护符合监管约束，并在集中式和区块链两种部署下评估原型的证明与验证开销。
evidence_note: 在集中式与区块链两种设置下评估原型开销随用户规模的变化；摘要未给出具体数值与对照方案。
novelty_note: 将 ZKP 引入频谱接入系统以兼顾可验证性与隐私，是已有 ZKP 技术在新应用场景的系统化落地。
scope: 结论适用于 CBRS 式 SAS 与基于区块链的 SAS，以及所测试的频谱用户规模。
limitations: 证明生成开销随用户数量增长；摘要未说明对恶意 SAS 或真实监管数据的评估。

title: Progressive Skill Discovery as Access Control for Tool-Using LLM Agents: Structural Governance through Role-Scoped Capability Delivery
abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents struggle to scale safely when exposed to vast enterprise toolsets. Providing an agent with access to every internal tool leads to oversized context windows, degraded tool selection, and severe governance vulnerabilities - as system policies defined purely in prompts remain probabilistic advice rather than hard constraints. Existing mitigations, such as multi-agent domain delegation, decentralize audit logs and fail to guarantee policy compliance across sessions. We introduce skilder, a framework that packages capabilities into roles: bundles of skills, tools, and instructions, together with the limits that bound them. An agent begins with a minimal role catalog, learns the roles a task requires, and receives each role's skills, instructions, and tools through a single MCP server. Because tools reach the agent only inside learned skills, the same server enforces the scope of what was learned deterministically. We evaluate skilder against flat-context tool selection and multi-agent orchestration across 13 tasks using six models (10 runs each). Our results show that, when models completed discovery and issued a governed call, the skilder simulated authorization layer enforced governance boundaries: no unauthorized tool call or parameter violation (e.g., a spending-limit breach) executed. Aggregate task pass rates also reflect whether each model followed the discovery protocol and satisfied response-quality checks; those misses are not authorization failures. Furthermore, by allowing agents to dynamically acquire cross-role capabilities mid-task, skilder preserves problem-solving flexibility while providing hard system-level enforcement.
comment: White paper, 30 pages
title_cn: 渐进式技能发现作为工具使用型 LLM 智能体的访问控制：通过角色范围的能力交付实现结构化治理
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体在面对庞大的企业工具集时难以安全地扩展。让智能体访问每一个内部工具，会导致上下文窗口过大、工具选择能力下降以及严重的治理漏洞——因为纯粹在提示中定义的系统策略仍只是概率性的建议，而非硬约束。现有缓解措施（如多智能体领域委派）会使审计日志分散，且无法保证跨会话的策略合规。我们提出 skilder，一个将能力打包为角色的框架：角色是技能、工具与指令的集合，连同约束它们的限制。智能体从一个最小的角色目录开始，学习任务所需的角色，并通过单个 MCP 服务器接收每个角色的技能、指令与工具。由于工具只会随已学习的技能一并到达智能体，同一服务器可以确定性地强制执行已学内容的范围。我们在 13 个任务上使用六个模型（每个 10 次运行），将 skilder 与扁平上下文工具选择和多智能体编排进行对比评估。结果表明，当模型完成发现并发出受治理的调用时，skilder 的模拟授权层强制执行了治理边界：没有任何未授权工具调用或参数违规（如超出支出限额）被执行。总体任务通过率还反映了各模型是否遵循发现协议并满足回答质量检查；这些未通过并非授权失败。此外，通过允许智能体在任务中途动态获取跨角色能力，skilder 在提供硬性系统级强制的同时保留了解决问题的灵活性。
summary_cn: 提出 skilder，把技能、工具、指令与限额打包成角色并经单一 MCP 服务器按需下发；13 任务 × 6 模型 × 10 次运行中，完成发现的受治理调用未出现任何越权调用或参数违规（白皮书）。
objective_summary: 设计以角色为单位渐进交付能力的 MCP 框架 skilder，并在 13 个任务、六个模型上与扁平上下文工具选择和多智能体编排对比授权合规与任务通过率。
evidence_note: 13 任务 × 6 模型 × 10 次运行并有两类基线；授权层为模拟实现，任务规模小，未报告统计检验。
novelty_note: 把渐进式技能发现与确定性授权绑定在同一 MCP 服务器上，是对智能体最小权限思路的工程化组合。
scope: 结论限于所设计的 13 个企业工具任务、六个模型与模拟授权层的设置。
limitations: 授权层为模拟实现；零违规仅针对完成发现并发出受治理调用的情形，通过率受模型是否遵循协议影响。

title: "What I See is What I Hear": Deepfake Detection Across Diverse Hearing Abilities
abstract: The proliferation of audiovisual deepfakes has lowered the cost of fraud, impersonation, and misinformation, but their success ultimately depends on human perception. Detection requires integrating auditory and visual cues, yet security and privacy research has largely overlooked d/Deaf and hard-of-hearing (DHH) populations. We address this gap with an in-person, mixed-methods study of 80 participants: 31 hearing persons (HPs), 15 hard-of-hearing (HoH) participants, 17 d/Deaf participants, and 17 cochlear implant (CI) users. Each participant judged the authenticity of 30 clips, where manipulations spanned text-to-speech, voice conversion, lip-sync, or face-swap. DHH participants were less accurate than HPs overall (76.4% vs. 88.0%, p<.001), primarily because they more often classified authentic clips as manipulated (FPR: 29.7% vs. 11.2%). Differences depended strongly on the manipulated channel. For audio-only manipulations, HoH participants matched HPs (90.0% vs. 90.3%), followed by CI users (79.4%) and d/Deaf participants (41.2%). When clips contained an audiovisual manipulation, accuracy clustered between 84% and 87%, although performance still varied by manipulation method. Our work systematically characterizes how deepfakes affect DHH populations, highlighting the asymmetric risks audiovisual manipulations may pose to groups with different hearing abilities and the need for accessible, tailored defenses that support all users.
authors: Kevin R. B. Butler (1) ((1) University of Florida
comment: Proceedings of the Network and Distributed System Security (NDSS) Symposium 2027
title_cn: 「所见即所闻」：不同听力能力人群的深度伪造识别
abstract_cn: 视听深度伪造的泛滥降低了欺诈、冒充与虚假信息的成本，但其能否得逞最终取决于人的感知。识别需要整合听觉与视觉线索，然而安全与隐私研究在很大程度上忽视了聋人与重听（DHH）人群。我们通过一项有 80 名参与者的线下混合方法研究填补这一空白：31 名听力正常者（HP）、15 名重听（HoH）参与者、17 名聋人（d/Deaf）参与者和 17 名人工耳蜗（CI）使用者。每位参与者判断 30 个片段的真伪，操纵方式涵盖文本转语音、语音转换、唇形同步或换脸。DHH 参与者总体准确率低于 HP（76.4% 对 88.0%，p<.001），主要原因是他们更常把真实片段判为被操纵（假阳性率：29.7% 对 11.2%）。差异强烈依赖于被操纵的通道。对于仅音频的操纵，HoH 参与者与 HP 相当（90.0% 对 90.3%），其次是 CI 使用者（79.4%）和聋人参与者（41.2%）。当片段包含视听操纵时，准确率集中在 84% 到 87% 之间，但表现仍因操纵方法而异。我们的工作系统刻画了深度伪造如何影响 DHH 人群，凸显了视听操纵可能对不同听力能力群体造成的不对称风险，以及对支持所有用户的无障碍、定制化防御的需求。
summary_cn: 80 人线下研究比较不同听力人群识别深度伪造：DHH 总体准确率 76.4% 低于听力正常者 88.0%（p<.001），仅音频操纵下聋人参与者仅 41.2%（NDSS'27）。
objective_summary: 以 80 名分属四类听力群体的参与者、每人 30 个涵盖四种操纵方式的片段，结合统计检验比较各群体的深度伪造识别准确率与假阳性率。
evidence_note: n=80 且设听力正常对照组，四种操纵方式、每人 30 片段，报告显著性检验；各 DHH 子组仅 15-17 人。
novelty_note: 针对安全研究长期忽视的聋人、重听与人工耳蜗使用者，按操纵通道刻画深度伪造识别差异。
scope: 结论限于所招募的 80 名参与者、实验室线下判断任务与所选四类操纵方法的片段。
limitations: 各听障子组样本量小；实验中明确要求判断真伪，与真实场景下的无提示接触存在差距。

title: Decision Hijacking: Prompt Injection Attacks on Jev's Typed Probabilistic Decisions
abstract: Most studies of prompt injection focus on generative agents, leaving their effects on models with schema-defined outputs unclear. We examine these effects in Jev, a non-generative decision model, using 510 reconstructed InjecAgent cases. Malicious content shifts action probabilities but rarely causes Jev to select the attacker's target. Override markers reduce this influence, while claims of contextual relatedness have small effects. Adaptive attacks using score feedback double the mean highest attacker-target probability found during optimization, while success on fresh validation calls rises from 1.8% to 3.5%. Exploratory analysis links these successes to small initial decision margins or greater attacker control over the observation. Together, these findings show that schema-defined outputs change but do not eliminate prompt-injection risk, highlighting the need to evaluate how untrusted content influences choices within the allowed action set.
title_cn: 决策劫持：针对 Jev 类型化概率决策的提示注入攻击
abstract_cn: 大多数提示注入研究关注生成式智能体，其对具有模式（schema）定义输出的模型有何影响尚不清楚。我们使用 510 个重构的 InjecAgent 用例，在非生成式决策模型 Jev 中考察这些影响。恶意内容会改变动作概率，但很少使 Jev 选择攻击者的目标。覆盖标记会削弱这种影响，而声称上下文相关性的效果较小。利用分数反馈的自适应攻击使优化过程中找到的攻击者目标最高概率均值翻倍，而在新的验证调用上的成功率从 1.8% 升至 3.5%。探索性分析将这些成功与较小的初始决策间隔或攻击者对观测的更大控制力联系起来。综上，这些发现表明，模式定义的输出改变但并未消除提示注入风险，凸显了评估不可信内容如何影响允许动作集合内选择的必要性。
summary_cn: 用 510 个重构 InjecAgent 用例测试非生成式决策模型 Jev 的提示注入：恶意内容改变动作概率但很少选中攻击目标，自适应攻击将验证成功率从 1.8% 提到 3.5%。
objective_summary: 在单一非生成式决策模型 Jev 上，用 510 个重构 InjecAgent 用例及基于分数反馈的自适应攻击，测量提示注入对动作概率与选择结果的影响。
evidence_note: 510 个用例并区分注入话术与自适应攻击，报告验证集成功率；仅单一模型，归因分析为探索性，未见统计检验。
novelty_note: 把提示注入评估从生成式智能体转到模式约束的决策输出，关注允许动作集合内的选择偏移。
scope: 结论限于 Jev 这一非生成式决策模型与重构的 InjecAgent 用例集。
limitations: 只评估一个模型，结论能否推广到其他结构化输出模型未知；自适应攻击成功率绝对值低，差异幅度有限。

title: CONCURDEP: Event-Guided Analysis of Dependency Invalidation in CPython Concurrency
abstract: Removing CPython's Global Interpreter Lock (GIL) exposes native code to concurrency absent from ordinary C types. Mutation or re-entry can revoke a borrowed object, storage pointer, traversal state, or lease between acquisition and use while its owner remains alive, causing native memory errors and runtime-state corruption. Race analyses track conflicting accesses. Python/C lifecycle analyses track individual object states. These reporting units leave implicit owner-subject-storage relations disconnected from later uses under parallel and re-entrant events. We present CONCURDEP, a source-level static analysis of dependency invalidation. Its key insight is to represent the runtime property a native use requires and ask which target-matched event can revoke it within the dependency's live region. CONCURDEP recovers runtime-semantic dependencies, connects them to events through an event-aware native concurrency dependency graph, and applies property-specific state and protection transfers through a shared engine and six mechanism plugins. CONCURDEP correctly classifies all 180 matched semantic-conformance cases and analyzes each of three production CPython releases with five-run medians of 22.13-27.66 seconds and 670-784 MiB peak resident memory. Source auditing confirms 1,094 of 4,273 unique production fingerprints (25.60% confirmation yield). Removing derived relation recovery loses 25-44 represented roots per release; removing cross-entry events loses 73-94. The study identifies 144 distinct bugs across free-threaded and conventional-GIL builds, including 95 previously unreported in public sources. These results show that explicit dependency, event, and property semantics expose consequential runtime failures across API boundaries and execution modes at release scale.
title_cn: CONCURDEP：CPython 并发中依赖失效的事件引导分析
abstract_cn: 移除 CPython 的全局解释器锁（GIL），会让原生代码暴露在普通 C 类型所没有的并发之下。在获取与使用之间，变更或重入可能撤销一个借用对象、存储指针、遍历状态或租约，而其所有者仍然存活，从而导致原生内存错误与运行时状态损坏。竞争分析追踪冲突访问；Python/C 生命周期分析追踪单个对象的状态。这些报告单元使隐式的「所有者-主体-存储」关系与并行及重入事件下的后续使用相互脱节。我们提出 CONCURDEP，一种针对依赖失效的源码级静态分析。其关键洞察是：表示一次原生使用所需的运行时性质，并追问哪个与目标匹配的事件能在该依赖的存活区间内撤销它。CONCURDEP 恢复运行时语义依赖，通过事件感知的原生并发依赖图把它们与事件相连，并借助一个共享引擎与六个机制插件施加特定于性质的状态与保护传递。CONCURDEP 正确分类了全部 180 个匹配的语义一致性用例，并分析了三个生产版 CPython 发行版，五次运行的中位耗时为 22.13-27.66 秒，峰值常驻内存为 670-784 MiB。源码审计确认了 4,273 个唯一生产指纹中的 1,094 个（确认率 25.60%）。去掉派生关系恢复后，每个发行版丢失 25-44 个所表示的根；去掉跨入口事件则丢失 73-94 个。本研究在自由线程构建与常规 GIL 构建中共识别出 144 个不同的缺陷，其中 95 个此前未在公开来源中报告。这些结果表明，显式的依赖、事件与性质语义能够在发行版规模上揭示跨越 API 边界与执行模式的重要运行时故障。
summary_cn: 提出 CONCURDEP，对无 GIL 化 CPython 原生代码做依赖失效静态分析：180 个一致性用例全对，三个发行版上共发现 144 个缺陷，其中 95 个此前未公开报告。
objective_summary: 构建基于事件感知原生并发依赖图与六个机制插件的静态分析器，用语义一致性用例、三个生产版 CPython 的人工审计与消融实验评估其效果和开销。
evidence_note: 180 个一致性用例、三个真实发行版五次运行计时、人工审计确认率与两项消融；摘要未给出与现有竞争分析工具的对比。
novelty_note: 以「运行时性质可被哪个事件撤销」为报告单元，统一刻画无 GIL 场景下的依赖失效，问题定义较新。
scope: 结论限于三个生产版 CPython 发行版的原生代码，涵盖自由线程与常规 GIL 构建。
limitations: 仅 25.60% 的生产指纹经审计确认，多数报告未获确认、人工审计负担重；仅在 CPython 上评估。

title: BRFID: Toward Byzantine-Robust Federated Intrusion Detection
abstract: Flipping 60\% of training labels from a single Byzantine client using label-flipping model poisoning self-degrades an attacker's own federated detection accuracy, $99.96\%$ (at no poisoning rate) to $84.33\%$ in a three-client federated IDS. Where the Federated global ensemble maintains stable accuracy across all tested poison rates, without a defense mechanism in place and without coordination between attackers. In this paper, we present empirical results quantifying the impact of label-flipping poisoning attacks on a three-client federated IDS trained on CICIDS2017 with non-IID attack subtype distributions across clients. We demonstrate that the signal of the adversarial self-compromise represents a detectable anomaly for exploitation for Byzantine client identification in the absence of target data exfiltration. We note that the aggregation step uses a Federated Forest (tree concatenation) rather than a parametric FedAvg; the results therefore measure the impact of poisoning on per-client performance under ensemble aggregation, and extension to genuine FedAvg with a parametric classifier is planned for future work.
title_cn: BRFID：迈向拜占庭鲁棒的联邦入侵检测
abstract_cn: 在一个三客户端联邦 IDS 中，单个拜占庭客户端通过标签翻转式模型投毒翻转 60% 的训练标签，会使攻击者自身的联邦检测准确率自我降级，从 99.96%（无投毒时）降至 84.33%。与此同时，联邦全局集成在所有测试的投毒率下都保持稳定的准确率，而这既没有部署防御机制，也没有攻击者之间的协同。本文给出实证结果，量化标签翻转投毒攻击对一个在 CICIDS2017 上训练、各客户端攻击子类型分布为非独立同分布（non-IID）的三客户端联邦 IDS 的影响。我们证明，这种对抗性自我损害的信号构成一种可检测的异常，可在无需窃取目标数据的情况下用于识别拜占庭客户端。需要指出的是，聚合步骤使用的是 Federated Forest（树拼接），而非参数化的 FedAvg；因此结果衡量的是集成聚合下投毒对各客户端性能的影响，扩展到使用参数化分类器的真正 FedAvg 留待未来工作。
summary_cn: 在 CICIDS2017 三客户端联邦 IDS 中量化标签翻转投毒：翻转 60% 标签使攻击者自身准确率从 99.96% 降至 84.33%，全局集成保持稳定，主张以此自我降级信号识别拜占庭客户端。
objective_summary: 在 CICIDS2017、非 IID 划分的三客户端联邦 IDS（Federated Forest 聚合）上，测量不同投毒率下标签翻转攻击对客户端与全局准确率的影响。
evidence_note: 仅三客户端、单一数据集、单个攻击者；无防御基线对照，也未给出统计检验，且聚合方式非参数化 FedAvg。
novelty_note: 标签翻转投毒属已知攻击；把攻击者自我降级当作识别信号的观察有一定新意，摘要未给出具体识别方法。
scope: 结论限于 Federated Forest 聚合、三客户端与 CICIDS2017 非 IID 设置。
limitations: 作者自陈未覆盖参数化 FedAvg；仅三客户端，摘要未报告基于该信号识别拜占庭客户端的检测效果。

title: Agent Approval Laundering: Transitive Effects Beyond the Approved Invocation
abstract: Coding-agent approval interfaces bind a human decision to a command or tool call, while developer tools execute the transitive workflow that invocation activates. Package installation can run lifecycle hooks and write files; an MCP call can exercise network authority. We call the resulting record-coverage failure approval laundering: the durable record names the entry invocation but omits effects exercised by its workflow. We present the first systematic security analysis of this record-to-closure relation in agent systems. We formalize closure-bound approval over six effect classes and derive an information limit: identical policy-visible fields can require different effect-specific decisions, so no record-only policy can guarantee both. The Approval-to-Action Security Benchmark binds approval objects and decision-time metadata to post-execution evidence. Across 111 fixed approval-object/trace pairs, residual records fall from 40 under explicit fields to 17 with command semantics and 13 with decision-time metadata. Across 11 fixed-SHA executions, the ladder reaches zero metadata residuals; two exact mappings recur across three product frontends. For prospective recovery, effect-bound records commit frozen, source-backed predictions and provenance before authorization. On 17 prespecified holdout workflows, predictions achieve 0.926 macro recall and 0.941 macro precision; binding them cuts residual effects from 10 to 3. A Claude Code PreToolUse integration carries the frozen record through the permission path without automatic approval. These results establish approval laundering as a measurable, recurrent record-coverage failure despite truthful invocation identity. They motivate binding each invocation before authorization to a source-backed prediction of its workflow's transitive effect boundary and preserving that binding with the decision.

University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications)

title_cn: 智能体审批洗白：超出被批准调用的传递性效应
abstract_cn: 编码智能体的审批界面把人的决策绑定到一条命令或一次工具调用上，而开发者工具执行的是该调用所激活的传递性工作流。安装软件包可能运行生命周期钩子并写入文件；一次 MCP 调用可能行使网络权限。我们将由此产生的记录覆盖失效称为审批洗白（approval laundering）：持久化记录写明了入口调用，却遗漏了其工作流所施加的效应。我们提出了对智能体系统中这种记录与闭包关系的首个系统性安全分析。我们在六类效应上形式化了闭包绑定的审批，并推导出一个信息极限：相同的策略可见字段可能需要不同的、特定于效应的决策，因此任何仅依赖记录的策略都无法同时保证两者。Approval-to-Action Security Benchmark 把审批对象与决策时元数据绑定到执行后的证据上。在 111 个固定的审批对象/轨迹对上，残余记录从仅用显式字段时的 40 个，降到加入命令语义后的 17 个，再降到加入决策时元数据后的 13 个。在 11 次固定 SHA 的执行中，这一阶梯达到零元数据残余；有两个精确映射在三个产品前端中反复出现。为实现前瞻性恢复，效应绑定记录在授权之前提交冻结的、有源码依据的预测及其来源信息。在 17 个预先指定的留出工作流上，预测达到 0.926 的宏召回率与 0.941 的宏精确率；绑定这些预测使残余效应从 10 个降到 3 个。一个 Claude Code PreToolUse 集成在不做自动批准的前提下，把冻结记录沿权限路径传递。这些结果确立了审批洗白是一种可测量、反复出现的记录覆盖失效，即便调用身份是真实的。它们表明，应在授权之前把每次调用绑定到对其工作流传递性效应边界的有源码依据的预测，并将该绑定与决策一同保存。
summary_cn: 提出「审批洗白」：智能体审批记录只含入口调用而漏记包安装钩子、MCP 网络权限等传递效应；111 对样本上残余记录从 40 降到 13，授权前效应预测宏精确率 0.941、残余效应 10→3。
objective_summary: 形式化闭包绑定审批并推导仅依记录策略的信息极限，构建审批到动作基准测量残余效应，并在留出工作流上验证授权前的效应预测记录。
evidence_note: 111 个审批对象/轨迹对、11 次固定 SHA 执行、17 个预先指定留出工作流；样本规模小，未提统计检验。
novelty_note: 把审批失效从调用身份转向工作流传递效应的覆盖，并给出仅记录策略的信息极限。
scope: 结论适用于编码智能体的命令/工具审批界面与所定义六类效应，限于所测产品前端与工作流。
limitations: 留出工作流与执行样本少；效应预测依赖可得源码，对无源码工具的适用性未说明。

title: Persistent Billable State: Denial-of-Wallet Attacks and Defenses in Tool-Calling LLM Agents
abstract: Multi-step tool-calling LLM agents rely on host runtimes to preserve state across turns. When a runtime carries an external tool return into later model inputs, providers meter it again. An admitted malicious or compromised tool can thereby convert untrusted data into recurring victim-billed processing without victim credentials or local runtime privilege. We call retained content persistent billable state and formalize the host's decision over whether and how it enters later billable context as the persistent billable-state boundary. We present the first systematic security study of this post-admission lifecycle. We derive six denial-of-wallet attack vectors and build DOW-BENCH, an end-to-end harness evaluated across six model families. Across 243 executions, usage telemetry shows that the maximum per-session cumulative input reaches 14,293x the session's first-call input. Controlled history-policy reruns isolate raw retention's contribution: retaining raw history increases mean effective session cost by 21.2-35.9%. Compression succeeds on 10/12 and 11/12 history-dependent tasks, versus 2/12 under deletion for each provider. To govern this boundary, we combine deterministic history transformation with four host-side invariants that bound prompt mass, context growth, recursive opportunity, and cumulative spend before reingestion. The kernel contains every recurring attack in the 123-evaluation replay corpus. Across 24 Mistral Small 4 workflows, a progress-authorized policy achieves 22/24 oracle-verified task successes with no pre-completion interruptions, versus 13/24 under a fixed cap. Only 71 of 3,830 scanned MCP server and transport repositories expose any code-visible safeguard proxy, and none cover all four safeguard families. These results establish persistent billable state as a first-class security object and pre-reingestion as its host-owned control point.

University of Chinese Academy of Sciences
(4) State Key Laboratory of Networking and Switching Technology
