abstract: Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKPs) enable a prover to cryptographically convince a verifier of the validity of a statement without revealing any underlying secrets, forming a foundational primitive for verifiable computation. The ZKP landscape is undergoing a fundamental shift from classic zk-SNARKs such as Groth16, which rely on trusted setup and are vulnerable to quantum adversaries, toward transparent, post-quantum constructions such as zk-STARK. These systems achieve post-quantum security by relying solely on collision-resistant hash functions, however, at the cost of substantial computational overhead. In particular, the Fast Reed--Solomon Interactive Oracle Proof of Proximity (FRI) protocol dominates prover complexity, generating massive data volumes, repeated Merkle-tree commitments, and irregular memory access patterns that limit performance and energy efficiency on general-purpose processors. To address these challenges, this work proposes FASTAR, a novel FPGA-based accelerator for the FRI protocol. Unlike accelerators that pursue fixed high-performance kernels on expensive ASIC process nodes, FASTAR adopts a constraint-driven design methodology. Our framework is implemented with High-Level Synthesis (HLS) and composed of fully parameterizable building blocks for the major stages of FRI, including polynomial evaluation, recursive split-and-fold, and Merkle-tree construction. From user-provided board specifications, FASTAR automatically generates hardware implementations tailored to the resource and memory constraints of the target FPGA, enabling deployment across a wide range of platforms without manual redesign.
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables; ICCAD 2026
title_cn: FASTAR：面向可扩展透明知识论证的 FRI 加速器
abstract_cn: 零知识证明（ZKP）让证明者在不泄露任何底层秘密的前提下，以密码学方式使验证者相信某陈述成立，是可验证计算的基础原语。ZKP 领域正经历一场根本性转变：从依赖可信初始化、易受量子对手攻击的经典 zk-SNARK（如 Groth16），转向透明的后量子构造（如 zk-STARK）。这类系统仅依赖抗碰撞哈希函数即可实现后量子安全，但代价是巨大的计算开销。其中，快速 Reed-Solomon 交互式邻近预言证明（FRI）协议主导了证明者复杂度，产生海量数据、反复的 Merkle 树承诺以及不规则的内存访问模式，在通用处理器上限制了性能与能效。为应对这些挑战，本文提出 FASTAR，一种面向 FRI 协议的新型 FPGA 加速器。与那些在昂贵 ASIC 工艺节点上追求固定高性能内核的加速器不同，FASTAR 采用约束驱动的设计方法。我们的框架用高层次综合（HLS）实现，由针对 FRI 各主要阶段的完全可参数化模块构成，包括多项式求值、递归的拆分-折叠与 Merkle 树构造。根据用户提供的板卡规格，FASTAR 自动生成针对目标 FPGA 资源与内存约束定制的硬件实现，无需人工重设计即可在多种平台上部署。
summary_cn: 提出面向 zk-STARK 类系统中 FRI 协议的 FPGA 加速器 FASTAR，以 HLS 实现可参数化的多项式求值、拆分-折叠与 Merkle 树模块，可按板卡规格自动生成适配实现（ICCAD 2026）。
objective_summary: 提出面向 FRI 协议的约束驱动 FPGA 加速器 FASTAR，用 HLS 实现可参数化模块，并可依目标 FPGA 的资源约束自动生成硬件实现。
evidence_note: 摘要仅描述设计方法与可参数化模块，未给出加速比或资源占用等定量结果（正文含 4 表但数值未在摘要）。
novelty_note: 以约束驱动、可参数化的 FPGA 设计替代固定 ASIC 内核来加速 FRI，是已有硬件加速方向上的实质性改进。
scope: 结论限于 FPGA 平台与 FRI 协议的各阶段模块，依赖用户提供的板卡规格。
limitations: 摘要未报告性能、能效的量化收益，也未给出与已有 ASIC 等加速方案的对照结果。

title: Dynamic Conformance Testing of WebGPU Through Specification-Driven Mutation
abstract: WebGPU is a low-level graphics and compute API that exposes modern GPU functionality to web applications. While the official WebGPU Conformance Test Suite (CTS) focuses on well-formed usage under the WebGPU specification, it is not designed to stress implementations with semantic edge cases or adversarial inputs. General-purpose fuzzers, in contrast, struggle with WebGPU because of its complex graphics stack and multi-process architecture. We introduce LANTERN, a specification-guided dynamic conformance testing framework that mutates CTS tests using constraints extracted from the WebGPU specification. LANTERN extracts explicit syntactic API rules from WebIDL definitions and recovers semantic constraints, such as command ordering and object lifetimes, from natural-language specification text. Selected rules guide AST-located textual transformations that generate both valid and intentionally invalid CTS variants. We execute the resulting tests at scale on AddressSanitizer-instrumented Chromium to discover bugs. Our evaluation discovers three reproducible bugs, including a heap corruption, in Chromium versions current at the time of study. These results demonstrate that syntactically seeded, semantics-aware mutation of conformance tests provides a way to uncover browser bugs during WebGPU testing.
title_cn: 通过规格驱动的变异对 WebGPU 做动态一致性测试
abstract_cn: WebGPU 是一种底层图形与计算 API，把现代 GPU 功能暴露给 Web 应用。官方的 WebGPU 一致性测试套件（CTS）关注规格下的良构用法，但并非为用语义边界情形或对抗性输入去压测实现而设计。相比之下，通用模糊测试器因 WebGPU 复杂的图形栈与多进程架构而难以奏效。我们提出 LANTERN，一个规格引导的动态一致性测试框架，利用从 WebGPU 规格中提取的约束对 CTS 测试进行变异。LANTERN 从 WebIDL 定义中提取显式的语法层 API 规则，并从自然语言规格文本中恢复语义约束，如命令顺序与对象生命周期。选出的规则引导定位在 AST 上的文本变换，生成既有效又故意无效的 CTS 变体。我们在经 AddressSanitizer 插桩的 Chromium 上大规模执行生成的测试以发现缺陷。评测在研究当时的最新 Chromium 版本中发现了三个可复现缺陷，其中包括一处堆破坏。这些结果表明，以语法为种子、感知语义的一致性测试变异，为在 WebGPU 测试中发现浏览器缺陷提供了一条途径。
summary_cn: LANTERN 从 WebIDL 与自然语言规格提取语法/语义约束来变异 WebGPU CTS 测试，在 AddressSanitizer 插桩的 Chromium 上大规模执行，发现三个可复现缺陷（含一处堆破坏）。
objective_summary: 提出规格引导的动态一致性测试框架 LANTERN，从 WebIDL 与规格文本提取约束变异 CTS 测试，在插桩 Chromium 上大规模执行以发现缺陷。
evidence_note: 在插桩 Chromium 上大规模执行并发现三个可复现缺陷（含一处堆破坏）；缺陷数少，摘要未报告与通用模糊器或原始 CTS 的定量对照。
novelty_note: 将规格驱动、语义感知的一致性测试变异应用于此前通用模糊器难以覆盖的 WebGPU，属已有思路的新领域落地。
scope: 结论限于 WebGPU CTS 与研究当时的 Chromium 实现，缺陷发现依赖 AddressSanitizer 插桩。
limitations: 仅报告三个缺陷、样本有限；摘要未量化从自然语言规格恢复语义约束的完整性与准确性。

title: Identifying Suspected Mislabeled Apps in Google Play Application Removal Prediction: An Empirical Comparison of Label Noise Detection Methods
abstract: Models that predict which Google Play apps will be removed are trained on labels that record only whether an app was still in the store at a later observation. A disappeared app is labeled removed and a present one stable, but neither records why. A voluntary withdrawal and a policy takedown both produce removed, and an uncaught spam app keeps stable. This work calls that mismatch label noise. Three detectors from different methodological families are applied to the 870,514 apps of Mohsen, Karastoyanova, and Azzopardi (2022): Isolation Forest, flagging apps unusual in the feature space, Neighborhood Disagreement, flagging apps whose nearest neighbors carry the opposite label, and Prediction Inconsistency, flagging apps a classifier labels differently from the data. The apps flagged by all three, the overlap, number 7,598 at default settings and are the strongest mislabeling candidates. Two questions follow. First, does removing flagged apps improve the model? It does not. No detector, overlap, or union beats the baseline, and the loss grows with the number removed. Second, do flagged apps appear less often than expected among apps whose label VirusTotal and Quark Engine confirm? Among confirmed removals they do, falling to 0.43 times the expected rate as the threshold tightens, while an excess on the stable side disappears once the age of the scanned apps is accounted for. A model trained on only the 3,021 trainable overlap apps reaches a test AUC of 0.2518, far below chance, so the relationship between features and labels there runs opposite to the rest of the data. The flagged apps run wrong in both directions: abandoned apps that resemble spam carry stable, while apps that look healthy carry removed. The value of the detectors lies in characterizing this label noise. They locate a small set of candidates they cannot profitably remove.
comment: Bachelor's project, University of Groningen. 26 pages, 5 figures
title_cn: 在 Google Play 应用下架预测中识别疑似误标应用：标签噪声检测方法的实证比较
abstract_cn: 预测哪些 Google Play 应用会被下架的模型，训练所用的标签只记录某应用在稍后一次观测时是否仍在商店中。消失的应用被标为「已下架」，仍在的被标为「稳定」，但两者都不记录原因。自愿撤下与因违规被强制下架都会产生「已下架」标签，而一个未被识破的垃圾应用则保持「稳定」。本文把这种错配称为标签噪声。对 Mohsen、Karastoyanova 与 Azzopardi（2022）的 870,514 个应用，采用来自不同方法族的三种检测器：Isolation Forest（标记在特征空间中异常的应用）、Neighborhood Disagreement（标记其最近邻带相反标签的应用），以及 Prediction Inconsistency（标记分类器给出的标签与数据不一致的应用）。被三者共同标记的应用（即交集）在默认设置下有 7,598 个，是最强的误标候选。随后有两个问题。第一，移除被标记的应用能否改善模型？答案是不能。无论单个检测器、交集还是并集，都胜不过基线，且移除数量越多损失越大。第二，在标签由 VirusTotal 与 Quark Engine 确认的应用中，被标记的应用是否比预期出现得更少？在被确认的下架应用中确实如此，随着阈值收紧降至预期比率的 0.43 倍；而「稳定」一侧的超额，在考虑被扫描应用的年龄后就消失了。仅用 3,021 个可训练的交集应用训练出的模型，测试 AUC 只有 0.2518，远低于随机水平，说明这些应用中特征与标签的关系与其余数据恰好相反。被标记的应用在两个方向上都出错：形似垃圾应用的被遗弃应用带着「稳定」标签，而看起来健康的应用却带着「已下架」标签。这些检测器的价值在于刻画这种标签噪声。它们定位出一小批无法通过移除而获益的候选应用。
summary_cn: 对 870,514 个 Google Play 应用用三种检测器找出 7,598 个误标交集候选：移除它们均不胜基线，仅用交集应用训练的 AUC 仅 0.2518（低于随机），检测器价值在刻画而非清除标签噪声。
objective_summary: 在 870,514 个 Google Play 应用的下架预测数据集上，比较 Isolation Forest、Neighborhood Disagreement 与 Prediction Inconsistency 三种标签噪声检测器，并用 VirusTotal 与 Quark Engine 的确认标签检验其定位效果。
evidence_note: 870,514 个应用、三种检测器及交集/并集对照基线，并用 VirusTotal 与 Quark Engine 外部确认；单一既有数据集，摘要未提统计检验。
novelty_note: 把已有的三种通用标签噪声检测器套用到应用下架数据集，主要价值是负面与刻画性发现而非新方法。
scope: 结论限于该单一 Google Play 数据集（Mohsen 等 2022）与所用特征、下架标签定义。
limitations: 仅基于单一既有数据集及其特征；标签噪声的真实成因无法从数据直接判定，外部确认只覆盖部分应用。

title: ZeroGate: Trust-Preserving Fast Paths for Governed AI Agent Runtimes
abstract: Moving authorization earlier can shorten an agent's dispatch boundary without removing authorization work. It can also admit an action whose payload, authority, or relevant state has changed. ZeroGate separates exact-action approval from durable local admission: an issuer signs a short-lived ActionPass, and a trusted runtime adapter reconstructs the final action before a local gate checks its binding and consumes its nonce. A SQLite transaction couples nonce consumption, applicable quota updates, and an admission receipt. We state a conditional decision-preservation proposition: successful local admission implies that a specified synchronous policy would authorize the same action at the admission point, provided approval is sound, all policy dependencies are represented and current, observations are faithful, and consumption is atomic. The implementation alone establishes neither current-world freshness nor exactly-once remote effects. Evaluation separates authored semantic fixtures, controlled concurrency and crash experiments, and an Azure Blob study comparing synchronous and prepared execution through the same issuer and gate. Both modes mint an exact-action pass; lifecycle latency includes preparation and prepared-batch dwell. Across 4800 cloud attempts, prepared worker-admission-to-dispatch p95 ranges from 9.802 to 11.374 ms, versus 25.018 to 334.000 ms synchronously, across the tested concurrency levels. Prepared mean complete lifecycle is longer at every level: the boundary improvement is not a net speedup. The contribution is an explicit revalidation contract, a durable reference boundary, and an auditable comparison of where authorization cost is paid, not a new cryptographic primitive or a universal performance frontier.
comment: 47 pages, 11 figures, 13 tables. Full research report with an ancillary archive containing reference code, raw experimental records, and offline verification tools
title_cn: ZeroGate：面向受治理 AI 智能体运行时的保持信任的快速路径
abstract_cn: 把授权前移可以缩短智能体的派发边界，却并不消除授权工作本身。它还可能放行一个负载、权限或相关状态已经发生变化的动作。ZeroGate 将精确动作审批与持久的本地准入分离：签发方对一个短时有效的 ActionPass 签名，可信运行时适配器重建最终动作，随后本地门控检查其绑定并消费其 nonce。一次 SQLite 事务把 nonce 消费、适用的配额更新与准入回执耦合在一起。我们提出一个有条件的决策保持命题：只要审批是可靠的、所有策略依赖都被表示且为最新、观测是忠实的、消费是原子的，那么一次成功的本地准入就意味着某个指定的同步策略会在准入点授权同一动作。仅凭实现本身，既不能保证当前世界的新鲜度，也不能保证远端效果恰好执行一次。评测分为三部分：人工编写的语义测例、受控的并发与崩溃实验，以及一项 Azure Blob 研究——通过同一签发方与门控比较同步执行与预备执行。两种模式都会签发精确动作通行证；生命周期延迟包含预备阶段与预备批次的驻留时间。在 4800 次云端尝试中，跨所测并发级别，预备模式从工作者准入到派发的 p95 延迟为 9.802 至 11.374 毫秒，而同步模式为 25.018 至 334.000 毫秒。在每个并发级别上，预备模式的平均完整生命周期都更长：边界处的改进并非净加速。本文的贡献是一份明确的重校验契约、一条持久的参照边界，以及一次关于授权代价在何处支付的可审计比较，而非一种新的密码学原语或普适的性能前沿。
summary_cn: ZeroGate 把精确动作审批与本地准入分离并给出有条件的决策保持命题：4800 次云端尝试中预备模式派发 p95 为 9.8–11.4 毫秒（同步 25–334 毫秒），但完整生命周期更长、并非净加速。
objective_summary: 提出将精确动作审批与持久本地准入分离的智能体运行时门控 ZeroGate，给出有条件的决策保持命题，并以语义测例、并发与崩溃实验及 Azure Blob 研究验证。
evidence_note: 4800 次云端尝试给出 p95 延迟区间，含语义测例、并发与崩溃实验及同步/预备对照；随附原始记录，未见与其他授权系统对照。
novelty_note: 在智能体授权前移这一已有方向上给出显式重校验契约与可审计边界，属实质性工程化改进而非全新机制。
scope: 结论限于所实现的运行时、SQLite 本地门控与 Azure Blob 场景及所测并发级别。
limitations: 作者自陈实现本身不保证当前世界新鲜度与远端恰好一次；边界改进以更长的完整生命周期为代价。

title: Quantum ROP: Using Quantum Algorithms for ROP Chain Selection in Exploit Construction
abstract: The quantum computing threat to cybersecurity is nowadays predominantly framed around Shor's algorithm and its eventual capacity to break asymmetric cryptography. Beyond cryptanalysis, however, quantum computing may also enable other capabilities in offensive security. This work explores one such direction: the application of quantum combinatorial optimization to Return-Oriented Programming (ROP) gadget selection for exploit construction. We formulate gadget selection as a Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) problem that captures individual gadget cost and inter-gadget register-clobbering interactions, and solve it using QAOA on real IBM Heron r2 hardware. Applied to a Linux kernel exploitation scenario, the QAOA-selected chain achieves privilege escalation to uid=0 with SMEP and SMAP active. Across eight Linux binaries and 16 benchmark instances, QAOA recovered the lowest-cost valid chain in 11 cases; in the remaining five, it did not recover the optimum, with the failures associated with excessive circuit depth on current limited hardware.
comment: 29 pages, 3 figures
title_cn: Quantum ROP：用量子算法在漏洞利用构造中做 ROP 链选择
abstract_cn: 当下人们谈论量子计算对网络安全的威胁，多半聚焦于 Shor 算法及其最终破解非对称密码的能力。然而除密码分析之外，量子计算在进攻性安全中或许还能带来其他能力。本文探索其中一个方向：将量子组合优化应用于面向返回编程（ROP）的 gadget 选择，用于漏洞利用构造。我们将 gadget 选择建模为二次无约束二值优化（QUBO）问题，刻画单个 gadget 的代价以及 gadget 之间寄存器覆写的相互作用，并在真实的 IBM Heron r2 硬件上用 QAOA 求解。在一个 Linux 内核利用场景中，QAOA 选出的链在 SMEP 与 SMAP 均开启的情况下实现了提权至 uid=0。在 8 个 Linux 二进制、共 16 个基准实例上，QAOA 在 11 个实例中找到了代价最低的有效链；其余 5 个未能得到最优解，失败与当前受限硬件上过大的电路深度有关。
summary_cn: 把 ROP gadget 选择建模为 QUBO 并在真实 IBM Heron r2 硬件上用 QAOA 求解：内核场景下在 SMEP/SMAP 开启时提权至 uid=0，16 个基准中 11 个找到最低代价链。
objective_summary: 将漏洞利用中的 ROP gadget 选择建模为 QUBO 问题，用 QAOA 在真实 IBM 量子硬件上求解，并在内核提权场景与多个二进制基准上验证。
evidence_note: 真实 IBM Heron r2 硬件上 8 个二进制共 16 个实例，11 例得最低代价链，另有一个内核提权案例；摘要未报告与经典求解的效率对照。
novelty_note: 把量子组合优化（QUBO/QAOA）用于 ROP gadget 选择，将量子计算的进攻性安全应用从密码分析拓展到漏洞利用构造。
scope: 结论限于所测 8 个 Linux 二进制、单一内核提权场景与当前受限量子硬件的电路深度。
limitations: 16 例中 5 例未得最优，失败与当前受限硬件上电路深度过大有关；可求解实例规模受现有量子硬件限制。

title: SSP-Bench: A Hybrid Data Generation Framework for Safety, Security, and Privacy Evaluation
abstract: Evaluation of large language models (LLMs) for safety, security, and privacy (SSP) relies heavily on static benchmarks, which suffer from score saturation, data contamination, and aggregation artifacts, and fail to capture sensitivity to linguistic variation. As a result, models that perform well on fixed test sets often fail under semantically equivalent rephrasings. We introduce SSP-Bench, a dynamic benchmarking framework that generates evaluation instances on demand while preserving domain consistency. The framework ensures label validity through externally grounded sources, enforces scope via service-specific validation, and calibrates difficulty using a multi-model steering panel. Benchmark construction is formulated as a multi-objective optimization problem over difficulty, separability, novelty, and diversity. Across 24 models and four SSP services, SSP-Bench reveals systematic failures of static evaluation, including near-zero correlation in safety rankings due to construct mixing, strong safety--over-refusal coupling, and hidden within-family regressions. These results show that static benchmarks can misrepresent model behavior, motivating dynamic, deployment-relevant evaluation.
title_cn: SSP-Bench：面向安全性、安全防护与隐私评估的混合数据生成框架
abstract_cn: 对大语言模型（LLM）在安全性（safety）、安全防护（security）与隐私（privacy）（合称 SSP）方面的评估严重依赖静态基准，而静态基准存在分数饱和、数据污染与聚合伪影等问题，也无法反映模型对语言变化的敏感性。因此，在固定测试集上表现良好的模型，面对语义等价的改写时常常失败。我们提出 SSP-Bench，一个在保持领域一致性的同时按需生成评估实例的动态基准框架。该框架借助有外部依据的来源保证标签有效性，通过特定于服务的验证约束范围，并利用多模型引导小组校准难度。基准构建被形式化为一个在难度、区分度、新颖性与多样性上的多目标优化问题。在 24 个模型与四项 SSP 服务上，SSP-Bench 揭示了静态评估的系统性缺陷，包括构念混杂导致的安全排名近乎零相关、安全性与过度拒绝之间的强耦合，以及隐藏的同家族内部退化。这些结果表明静态基准可能错误刻画模型行为，从而推动动态的、贴近部署的评估。
summary_cn: 提出按需生成评估实例的动态基准框架 SSP-Bench，以多目标优化控制难度与多样性；在 24 个模型、四项服务上揭示静态评估缺陷，如构念混杂致安全排名近零相关、安全与过度拒绝强耦合。
objective_summary: 构建以外部来源保证标签、服务特定验证约束范围、多模型引导小组校准难度的动态基准生成框架，在 24 个模型与四项 SSP 服务上与静态评估对比。
evidence_note: 覆盖 24 个模型与四项服务并与静态基准对照；摘要未给实例规模、具体数值与统计检验。
novelty_note: 把动态基准生成表述为难度、区分度、新颖性与多样性的多目标优化，属已有方向上的改进。
scope: 结论适用于所测 24 个 LLM 与四项 SSP 服务，生成质量依赖外部来源与引导模型组。
limitations: 难度校准依赖引导模型组，可能带入其偏好；动态生成下的复现性与跨时间可比性未说明。

title: Making Agents More Consistent: Skills Should Form Habits for Repeat Tasks
abstract: On repeated work, agents are inconsistent. We ran 42 tasks three times each and found that, depending on the model, 38% to 74% returned answers that did not agree. Consistency is what a buyer, an auditor, or a regulator requires, and agents do not have it. They are wasteful too: 95.3% to 97.2% of what an agent generates goes to re-deriving a plan the system already knows. We propose skill habit formation. An agent mines its own execution history for candidate skills, deterministic variants that compete against the incumbent rather than replacing it. A candidate declares the region of input space it claims, so the common case runs as a script and the rest falls through to reasoning. Four gates of ascending cost admit candidates; the central one tests a candidate's execution trace against a retained reference, within a tolerance measured from that reference's own run-to-run variability. On text-to-SQL, three of four reasoning arms reproduced their own output on 11 to 13 of 42 repeated questions and the fourth on 26 of 42, while a habit-formed variant reproduced on all 456 dispatches we repeated and was non-inferior to every arm it replaced (p<0.0001). It also used 14% to 56% fewer tokens, turning net positive after 7 to 53 reuses. We measured what this costs in accuracy. The guard admitted work it should have deferred on 2.6% of natural paraphrases and 26% of inputs near its boundary, and 11 of 13 such failures were invisible to the trace-conformance gate at any threshold. Deterministic errors repeat exactly: a bad habit is as reliable as a good one, and that is the price of the property that makes the system auditable. Separating routing from parameter extraction raised end-to-end accuracy from 0.888 to 0.952 at 43% of the cost.
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures
title_cn: 让智能体更一致：技能应为重复任务养成习惯
abstract_cn: 在重复性工作上，智能体并不一致。我们把 42 个任务各运行三次，发现视模型不同，有 38% 到 74% 的任务返回了彼此不一致的答案。一致性是买方、审计方或监管方所要求的，而智能体并不具备。它们也很浪费：智能体生成内容中有 95.3% 到 97.2% 用于重新推导系统早已知道的计划。我们提出技能习惯养成（skill habit formation）。智能体从自身执行历史中挖掘候选技能，这些确定性变体与现任方案竞争，而不是直接取代它。候选技能声明其所认领的输入空间区域，使常见情形以脚本运行，其余情形回落到推理。四道成本递增的关卡决定候选能否被接纳；其中最核心的一道把候选的执行轨迹与保留的参考轨迹对比，容差依据该参考自身的运行间波动测得。在 text-to-SQL 上，四个推理组中有三个在 42 个重复问题里只有 11 到 13 个复现了自身输出，第四个为 26 个；而经习惯养成的变体在我们重复的全部 456 次调度中均复现了输出，并且相对于其替代的每个推理组都满足非劣性（p<0.0001）。它还少用了 14% 到 56% 的 token，在复用 7 到 53 次后转为净收益。我们测量了这在准确率上的代价。守卫在 2.6% 的自然改写输入和 26% 的边界附近输入上接纳了本应推迟的工作，且 13 个此类失败中有 11 个在任何阈值下都无法被轨迹一致性关卡发现。确定性错误会被精确地重复：坏习惯与好习惯一样可靠，这正是使系统可审计的那一性质所付出的代价。把路由与参数提取分离，使端到端准确率从 0.888 提升到 0.952，成本为原来的 43%。
summary_cn: 提出技能习惯养成：text-to-SQL 上习惯变体在 456 次重复调度中全部复现、对各推理组非劣（p<0.0001），token 少用 14%–56%，但边界输入误接纳达 26%。
objective_summary: 以 42 个任务三次重复测量智能体的不一致性，并在 text-to-SQL 上比较习惯化技能变体与四个推理组的复现率、准确率与 token 成本，同时测量守卫的误接纳。
evidence_note: 42 个任务三次重复、456 次调度并做非劣性检验与失败率测量；主实验仅 text-to-SQL 一个领域。
novelty_note: 把执行历史挖掘的确定性技能与带轨迹容差的准入关卡结合，以换取可复现与可审计性。
scope: 结论基于 text-to-SQL 任务、所测推理模型与 42 个重复问题的设置。
limitations: 确定性错误会被精确重复；边界输入误接纳 26%，且多数失败不被轨迹一致性关卡发现。

title: Controller-Only False Confirmation in Passive RF UAV Link Detection
abstract: Passive radio frequency (RF) sensing is widely used for counter-unmanned-aerial-vehicle (counter-UAV) detection. Existing studies commonly report high accuracy against background RF or WiFi/Bluetooth interference, but rarely isolate controller-only operation without a linked aircraft. We present a dual-band software-defined radio (SDR) measurement study with ambient, controller-only, and linked states for three commercial UAV platforms (DJI Phantom 3 4K, Hubsan H501S, DJI Mavic Mini). Two USRP B210 receivers simultaneously scan eight 2.4 GHz and twelve 5.8 GHz observation windows across twenty rounds. We first train an energy-based detector using linked and ambient scans only. At four ranked concurrent dwell steps (8 s), it achieves 0.992 linked-versus-ambient balanced accuracy but false-confirms 30 out of 60 controller-only scans (FCRctrl = 0.500). We then include controller-only scans in training and use confirm, reject, and defer outputs under an explicit controller-only false-confirmation-rate (FCR) constraint. For the pooled all-platform analysis, the constraint reduces observed FCRctrl from 0.350 to 0.050, while confirm-linked TPR decreases from 0.900 to 0.400 and 42.1% of scans are deferred. The corresponding compact scan performs substantially better for Hubsan and Mavic than for Phantom. A hardware-in-loop experiment reduces measured wall-clock time from 82.9 s to 28.9 s. These measurements show that linked-versus-background accuracy does not measure controller-only false confirmation and that this error should be reported separately.
title_cn: 被动射频无人机链路检测中的仅遥控器误确认
abstract_cn: 被动射频（RF）感知被广泛用于反无人机（counter-UAV）探测。现有研究通常报告在背景射频或 WiFi/蓝牙干扰下的高准确率，但很少单独考察没有已链接飞行器、仅遥控器工作的情形。我们开展了一项双频段软件定义无线电（SDR）测量研究，针对三款商用无人机平台（DJI Phantom 3 4K、Hubsan H501S、DJI Mavic Mini）采集环境、仅遥控器与已链接三种状态。两台 USRP B210 接收机在二十轮中同时扫描八个 2.4 GHz 与十二个 5.8 GHz 观测窗口。我们首先只用已链接与环境扫描训练一个基于能量的检测器。在四个排序后的并发驻留步（8 秒）下，它在已链接与环境之间的平衡准确率达到 0.992，却把 60 次仅遥控器扫描中的 30 次误确认为已链接（FCRctrl = 0.500）。随后我们把仅遥控器扫描纳入训练，并在明确的仅遥控器误确认率（FCR）约束下使用确认、拒绝与推迟三种输出。在汇总全部平台的分析中，该约束把观测到的 FCRctrl 从 0.350 降至 0.050，同时确认已链接的 TPR 从 0.900 降至 0.400，且 42.1% 的扫描被推迟。相应的紧凑扫描在 Hubsan 与 Mavic 上的表现明显优于 Phantom。一项硬件在环实验把实测挂钟时间从 82.9 秒缩短到 28.9 秒。这些测量表明，已链接对背景的准确率并不能衡量仅遥控器误确认，这一错误应当单独报告。
summary_cn: 双频 SDR 测量三款无人机：平衡准确率 0.992 的检测器把 30/60 次仅遥控器扫描误确认；加 FCR 约束后误确认率由 0.350 降至 0.050，TPR 由 0.900 降至 0.400。
objective_summary: 用两台 USRP B210 在 2.4 GHz 与 5.8 GHz 采集三款无人机的环境、仅遥控器、已链接三态数据，比较有无仅遥控器训练与 FCR 约束的检测器表现，并做硬件在环计时实验。
evidence_note: 三个平台、二十轮扫描、仅遥控器样本 60 次，含有无约束的对照与硬件在环实验；样本量小，未报告统计检验。
novelty_note: 把仅遥控器状态从背景干扰中单独拿出来度量误确认，补上常见评估中缺失的对照状态。
scope: 结论限于三款商用平台、所测 2.4/5.8 GHz 观测窗口、能量型检测器与所在测量环境。
limitations: 平台与场景数量少；约束使 TPR 大幅下降并推迟 42.1% 的扫描，实用权衡仍未解决。

title: Partition-Matched Evaluation of Community Features under Distribution Shift in Android Malware Function-Call Graphs
abstract: Graph-based Android malware classifiers can lose accuracy under malware-type or family shifts. We test whether mesoscopic organization in function-call graphs provides shift-stable information beyond local degree profiles (LDP), global statistics, lightweight metadata, and size-matched random partitions. Using 15,000 MalNet-Tiny, Common, and Distinct graphs, six Leiden descriptors specified before evaluation, and five optimizer seeds, communities raise Tiny macro F1 from 78.7% to 81.3% but yield 29.4-point source-only Common degradation. One size-matched random partition yields 27.8-point degradation. Across five random partitions, mean degradation is 27.9 points; the 95% two-level bootstrap interval for random minus community degradation is [-4.2, 1.2] points. With metadata, the corresponding difference is -0.2 points with interval [-1.1, 0.6]. Removing modularity raises structure-only Common macro F1 from 51.9% to 53.6%. The tested signature adds IID signal but shows no repeatable shift-stability advantage, demonstrating why mesoscopic graph claims need partition-matched controls and repeated null draws.
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables
title_cn: Android 恶意软件函数调用图中分布偏移下社区特征的划分匹配评估
abstract_cn: 基于图的 Android 恶意软件分类器在恶意软件类型或家族发生偏移时可能损失准确率。我们检验函数调用图中的介观组织，能否在局部度剖面（LDP）、全局统计量、轻量元数据以及尺寸匹配的随机划分之外，提供对偏移稳定的信息。我们使用 15,000 个 MalNet-Tiny、Common 与 Distinct 图、六个在评估前预先设定的 Leiden 描述符以及五个优化器随机种子；社区特征把 Tiny 上的宏 F1 从 78.7% 提升到 81.3%，但在仅用源域训练时于 Common 上出现 29.4 个百分点的下降。一个尺寸匹配的随机划分带来 27.8 个百分点的下降。在五个随机划分上，平均下降为 27.9 个百分点；随机划分与社区划分下降之差的 95% 两层 bootstrap 区间为 [-4.2, 1.2] 个百分点。加入元数据后，对应差值为 -0.2 个百分点，区间为 [-1.1, 0.6]。去除模块度后，仅用结构特征时 Common 上的宏 F1 从 51.9% 升至 53.6%。所测试的特征签名增加了独立同分布（IID）信号，但没有表现出可重复的偏移稳定性优势，这说明关于介观图结构的论断需要划分匹配的对照与重复的零模型抽样。
summary_cn: 在 15,000 个 MalNet 图上检验 Leiden 社区特征：IID 宏 F1 由 78.7% 升至 81.3%，但偏移下降（29.4 点）与尺寸匹配随机划分（均值 27.9 点）无可重复差异。
objective_summary: 以尺寸匹配的随机划分作为零模型对照，在 MalNet 三个子集上用预设 Leiden 描述符、多随机种子与两层 bootstrap 检验社区特征的偏移稳定性。
evidence_note: 15,000 个图、描述符预先设定、五个种子、五次随机划分零模型并给出两层 bootstrap 置信区间。
novelty_note: 以划分匹配零模型检验介观图特征的偏移稳定性，得到负面结论并强调对照设计的必要。
scope: 结论限于 MalNet 三个子集的函数调用图、六个 Leiden 描述符与所用分类设置。
limitations: 只检验一种社区特征签名与 MalNet 数据，其他图模型与偏移类型未覆盖。

title: Attack Success Rate Is Not a Number: On Measurement Validity in Agentic AI Security Evaluation
abstract: Attack success rate (ASR) is the headline metric in nearly every published evaluation of attacks on, and defenses for, LLM agents. We argue that ASR as currently used is not a single quantity but a family of metrics parameterized by six design choices that papers seldom specify and never hold constant across the literature. We support this with two studies that require no proprietary access. First, a full-text meta-analysis of 259 agentic-security papers posted to arXiv between February 2025 and September 2026 finds that most report neither a variance estimate nor repeated runs for their headline attack metric: 58% (95% CI 44-71) in a hand-coded random sample of 50, 65.3% by automated coding of all 259. Only 30.9% disclose enough about decoding to establish whether their evaluation was even stochastic, and of the 64 papers we confirm use an LLM judge, 29.7% report any agreement check against human labels. Second, an analytical study shows that these omissions are not cosmetic: on a 100-instance benchmark, the minimum difference in ASR detectable at conventional power is 18.2 percentage points, and two defenses whose true ASRs differ by 5 points are ranked in the wrong order by a single-run evaluation roughly 21% of the time. Because several of the six axes shift ASR in a system-dependent way, the resulting incomparability is not a constant offset that cancels in comparison. We conclude that cross-paper ASR comparison is currently unsupported, and propose a ten-item reporting checklist targeted at each failure we measure. Our aim is not to dispute any individual result but to supply the shared measurement contract the field has so far done without.
comment: 7 pages, 2 tables, 2 Figures
title_cn: 攻击成功率不是一个数：智能体 AI 安全评估中的测量效度
abstract_cn: 攻击成功率（ASR）几乎是每一篇已发表的、针对 LLM 智能体攻击与防御评估的核心指标。我们认为，目前所用的 ASR 并不是单一的量，而是一族由六项设计选择参数化的指标，这些选择论文很少明确说明，在文献之间也从未保持一致。我们用两项无需任何专有访问权限的研究来支持这一论点。第一，对 2025 年 2 月至 2026 年 9 月间发布在 arXiv 上的 259 篇智能体安全论文做全文元分析，发现大多数论文对其核心攻击指标既未报告方差估计，也未做重复运行：在人工编码的 50 篇随机样本中比例为 58%（95% CI 44–71），在对全部 259 篇的自动编码中为 65.3%。只有 30.9% 的论文披露了足够的解码信息，足以确定其评估究竟是否具有随机性；在我们确认使用 LLM 评判器的 64 篇论文中，29.7% 报告了与人工标注之间的任何一致性检验。第二，一项解析研究表明这些遗漏并非无关紧要：在 100 个实例的基准上，按常规统计功效可检测到的最小 ASR 差异为 18.2 个百分点；对于真实 ASR 相差 5 个百分点的两种防御，单次运行的评估大约有 21% 的概率把它们排反。由于六个维度中有若干个会以依赖于系统的方式改变 ASR，由此造成的不可比性并不是一个在比较中可以相互抵消的常数偏移。我们的结论是，目前跨论文比较 ASR 缺乏依据，并针对我们测得的每一种缺陷提出了一份十项报告清单。我们的目的不是质疑任何单项结果，而是提供该领域迄今一直缺少的共享测量契约。
summary_cn: 论证智能体安全中的 ASR 是由六项设计选择参数化的一族指标：259 篇论文元分析显示 58%–65.3% 既未报告方差也未重复运行；100 实例基准上最小可检差异为 18.2 个百分点，并提出十项报告清单。
objective_summary: 对 259 篇智能体安全论文做全文元分析（含 50 篇人工编码随机样本与全量自动编码），并以统计功效解析说明报告缺失对 ASR 比较的影响，据此提出十项报告清单。
evidence_note: 259 篇全量自动编码加 50 篇人工随机样本并给出 95% CI，辅以统计功效解析。
novelty_note: 把评估统计效度问题系统地落到智能体安全的 ASR 上，给出六维分解与量化的报告缺口。
scope: 结论基于 2025-02 至 2026-09 的 arXiv 智能体安全论文与 100 实例的解析设定。
limitations: 元分析仅覆盖 arXiv 预印本，六个维度对 ASR 的实际影响幅度在摘要中未见实测。

title: Benchmarking Neural Defend ARCAS 1B: A Foundational Multimodal Deepfake Detection Model
abstract: AI-generated imagery evolves faster than benchmark-specific detector evaluations, making a single score an incomplete account of generalization. This paper evaluates Neural Defend ARCAS 1B across benchmark families without benchmark-specific parameter updates. We retain native aggregation and supplement it with record-level measures, coverage accounting, and subgroup diagnostics. Each Results subsection identifies the release and evaluation population, reports the official metric, and describes observed error patterns. A combined analysis synthesizes shared patterns while preserving the distinction between native and pooled quantities. Cross-paper comparisons are restricted to aligned evidence; differences in release, population, preprocessing, training, or benchmark exposure are context rather than rank. The findings characterize performance on evaluated records, not universal reliability, calibration, attribution, or future adaptive attacks. By keeping benchmark-native outcomes distinct from pooled summaries, the study makes test-population, class-balance, and missing-record-coverage differences visible. It supports interpretation of detector results in research, platform-safety, and forensic-review settings, foregrounding traceable protocol conditions over claims or leaderboard comparisons.
title_cn: Neural Defend ARCAS 1B 基准评测：一个基础多模态深度伪造检测模型
abstract_cn: AI 生成图像的演化速度快于针对特定基准的检测器评估，使单一分数难以完整说明泛化能力。本文在不做任何基准特定参数更新的前提下，跨多个基准家族评估 Neural Defend ARCAS 1B。我们保留各基准原生的聚合方式，并辅以记录级度量、覆盖率核算与子群诊断。每个结果小节都指明所用的发布版本与评估总体，报告官方指标，并描述观察到的错误模式。综合分析在归纳共同模式的同时，保持基准原生量与汇总量之间的区分。跨论文比较仅限于相互对齐的证据；发布版本、总体、预处理、训练或基准暴露方面的差异被视为背景信息，而非排名依据。这些发现刻画的是在所评估记录上的性能，而非普遍的可靠性、校准、溯源能力或对未来自适应攻击的表现。通过把基准原生结果与汇总摘要区分开，本研究使测试总体、类别平衡与缺失记录覆盖率方面的差异变得可见。它有助于在研究、平台安全与取证审查场景中解读检测器结果，突出可追溯的协议条件，而非声明或排行榜比较。
summary_cn: 在不做基准特定参数更新的条件下，跨多个基准家族评测深度伪造检测模型 ARCAS 1B，保留各基准原生指标，并补充记录级度量、覆盖率核算与子群诊断。
objective_summary: 对单一深度伪造检测模型开展跨基准评估，区分基准原生结果与汇总量，报告官方指标与错误模式，并限制跨论文比较的范围。
evidence_note: 跨多个基准家族评估并含记录级与子群诊断；仅评一个模型，跨论文比较仅限对齐证据，摘要未给具体数值。
novelty_note: 对单一模型的多基准评测，区分原生与汇总指标的报告方式提高透明度，但不是新方法。
scope: 结论仅针对所评估基准记录上的 ARCAS 1B，不涉及普遍可靠性、校准、溯源与自适应攻击。
limitations: 只评测一个检测模型，与其他检测器的比较限于跨论文对齐证据；作者自陈结论不覆盖未来自适应攻击。

title: TRACTOR Benchmark for Evaluating C to Rust Translators
abstract: Memory-safety vulnerabilities remain a persistent source of security risk in critical software, much of which is implemented in memory-unsafe languages such as C and C++. Recent advances in programming languages, program analysis, and artificial intelligence have created new opportunities to modernize these legacy systems through automated translation to memory-safe languages such as Rust. The DARPA Translating All C to Rust (TRACTOR) program seeks to develop scalable techniques for translating large C codebases into safe, performant, and maintainable Rust. MIT Lincoln Laboratory serves as the program's independent test and evaluation organization and has developed a standardized benchmark for systematically assessing C-to-Rust translation tools. This report describes the TRACTOR benchmark, including progressively challenging test batteries and larger milestone projects, as well as the supporting evaluation infrastructure and metrics for assessing correctness, safety, idiomaticity, and performance. The benchmark and associated evaluation infrastructure are publicly available to support the broader development and evaluation of C-to-Rust translation technologies.
title_cn: 用于评估 C 到 Rust 翻译器的 TRACTOR 基准
abstract_cn: 内存安全漏洞仍是关键软件中持续存在的安全风险来源，而这类软件大多以 C、C++ 等内存不安全语言实现。编程语言、程序分析与人工智能的最新进展，为通过自动翻译到 Rust 等内存安全语言来现代化这些遗留系统创造了新的机会。DARPA 的 Translating All C to Rust（TRACTOR）项目旨在开发可扩展的技术，把大型 C 代码库翻译为安全、高性能且可维护的 Rust。MIT 林肯实验室作为该项目的独立测试与评估机构，开发了一个用于系统评估 C 到 Rust 翻译工具的标准化基准。本报告介绍 TRACTOR 基准，包括难度逐步提升的测试组与更大规模的里程碑项目，以及用于评估正确性、安全性、惯用性与性能的配套评估基础设施和指标。该基准及相关评估基础设施已公开，以支持 C 到 Rust 翻译技术更广泛的开发与评估。
summary_cn: MIT 林肯实验室为 DARPA TRACTOR 项目构建的 C 到 Rust 翻译标准化基准：含难度递进的测试组、里程碑项目，以及覆盖正确性、安全性、惯用性、性能的评估设施，已公开。
objective_summary: 描述 TRACTOR 基准的测试组设计、里程碑项目、评估基础设施与指标体系；摘要未报告对具体翻译工具的评测结果。
evidence_note: 以基准设计与基础设施描述为主，摘要未给出基准规模，也未报告任何翻译工具的实测结果。
novelty_note: 由项目独立测评机构提供覆盖正确性、安全性、惯用性与性能的标准化基准，属评测基础设施而非新方法。
scope: 适用于 C 到 Rust 自动翻译工具的评估，指标覆盖正确性、安全性、惯用性与性能。
limitations: 报告性质，摘要未给出任何翻译工具的评测结果，基准区分度与指标有效性无从判断。

title: CPyGraph: A Version-Aware Static Analysis Framework for Native CPython Bytecode
abstract: Static analysis of Python packages must recover both program structure and object flow across first-class functions, dynamic dispatch, implicit protocol calls, exceptions, closures, and module execution. Native CPython bytecode provides the executable lowering of these behaviors, but its instruction, call, stack, and exception representations change across releases. This creates a need for a version-aware analysis foundation whose graph products share the same bytecode identities and semantics. We present CPyGraph, a C++ framework for package-level analysis of native CPython bytecode. Version- specific adapters expose stack, control, call, lexical, protocol, and exception semantics through a shared interface while preserving code-object identities and native bytecode offsets. An operand-stack-aware Andersen points- to analysis and call graph grow together to a fixed point. Their shared state supports exception-aware CFGs, block-level CDGs, and interprocedural DDGs, with optional function-level flow, context, and bounded path sensitivity. The framework also records unresolved dynamic behavior through typed coverage summaries. We evaluate CPyGraph with PYGBench, 201 package-level programs and 1,733 fixed candidates. On CPython 3.10, the default analysis reaches 91.40% candidate precision and 100% recall; complete sensitivity reaches 94.97% precision with the same recall. Across CPython 3.10-3.14, 1,328 of 1,334 version-invariant queries agree, and CPyGraph matches PyCG on its 112-program call-graph benchmark.
title_cn: CPyGraph：面向原生 CPython 字节码的版本感知静态分析框架
abstract_cn: 对 Python 包的静态分析必须同时恢复程序结构，以及跨越一等函数、动态分派、隐式协议调用、异常、闭包与模块执行的对象流。原生 CPython 字节码提供了这些行为的可执行降级表示，但其指令、调用、栈与异常的表示在各版本之间不断变化。这就需要一个版本感知的分析基础，使其各种图产物共享相同的字节码标识与语义。我们提出 CPyGraph，一个用于原生 CPython 字节码包级分析的 C++ 框架。版本特定的适配器通过共享接口暴露栈、控制、调用、词法、协议与异常语义，同时保留代码对象标识与原生字节码偏移。一个感知操作数栈的 Andersen 指向分析与调用图共同增长，直至不动点。它们的共享状态支撑感知异常的 CFG、块级 CDG 与过程间 DDG，并可选启用函数级流敏感、上下文敏感与有界路径敏感。该框架还通过类型化的覆盖摘要记录未解析的动态行为。我们用 PYGBench（201 个包级程序与 1,733 个固定候选）评估 CPyGraph。在 CPython 3.10 上，默认分析的候选精确率为 91.40%、召回率为 100%；启用全部敏感性后精确率达到 94.97%，召回率不变。在 CPython 3.10–3.14 之间，1,334 个版本无关查询中有 1,328 个结果一致，且 CPyGraph 在 PyCG 的 112 程序调用图基准上与 PyCG 结果一致。
summary_cn: 提出 CPython 字节码包级静态分析框架 CPyGraph：在 201 个程序的 PYGBench 上精确率 91.40%–94.97%、召回率 100%，跨 3.10–3.14 版本 1,328/1,334 个查询一致。
objective_summary: 构建版本感知的 CPython 字节码分析框架，产出指向分析、调用图及 CFG、CDG、DDG，并以 PYGBench 与 PyCG 调用图基准评估精确率、召回率与跨版本一致性。
evidence_note: PYGBench 含 201 个程序与 1,733 个候选，并跨五个版本查一致性；外部对照仅为与 PyCG 基准持平。
novelty_note: 直接在原生字节码上做版本适配的包级分析并记录未解析动态行为，属已有方向上的实质推进。
scope: 结论适用于 CPython 3.10–3.14 字节码与 PYGBench 所含的包级程序规模。
limitations: 主要评估集中在 PYGBench，摘要未报告在真实大型包或具体安全分析任务上的效果。

title: Encrypted Redundancy as a Diagnostic Resource: Relational Diagnosis in Quantum Encrypted Cloning
abstract: Quantum encrypted cloning encodes an unknown state into several encrypted components, each offering an alternative way to recover it later. We show that this redundancy can also serve for one-shot fault diagnosis: instead of inspecting the encrypted state, we measure relational Pauli observables testing consistency conditions imposed by the encoding. The canonical Yamaguchi--Kempf scheme encodes the input into \(n\) signal--key pairs, all carrying the same coherent Bell label, plus a transformed copy of the input qubit. Comparing the labels of two pairs yields a deterministic check that localizes an anomalous pair and identifies its Pauli-error class without revealing the label. Such checks cannot tell whether the signal or the key of that pair is faulty, and no measurement on the pairs can (we prove that they already generate the whole group of deterministic state-blind observables supported there, of rank \(2(n-1)\)). This ambiguity matters: a faulty signal costs one redemption path, a faulty key threatens them all. However, retaining also the transformed input qubit contributes exactly two further independent checks, at any multiplicity, and these suffice to identify any single fault drawn from the single-qubit Pauli set. For three clones this gives six checks in all, and we prove that no smaller set of state-blind observables achieves the same resolution. Across clone multiplicities, parity governs how many components must be measured jointly to reach this resolution, not the resolution itself. These findings are then abstracted into a general framework --- state-blind observables, deterministic healthy references, syndrome-induced fault partitions, redemption-oriented sufficiency --- yielding \textit{relational diagnosability}: a syndrome need not identify every fault, only enough of it to select a safe redemption path.
comment: 33 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Companion to arXiv:2604.10155 and arXiv:2605.27421, whose reduced-state characterizations are used here; those preprints have been revised (v2) to correct a sign in a worked example, and the corrected sign is the one adopted throughout this paper
title_cn: 以加密冗余作为诊断资源：量子加密克隆中的关系型诊断
abstract_cn: 量子加密克隆把一个未知态编码为若干加密分量，每个分量都提供日后恢复该态的一条替代途径。我们表明，这种冗余也可用于一次性故障诊断：不去检视加密态本身，而是测量关系型 Pauli 可观测量，检验编码所施加的一致性条件。典范的 Yamaguchi–Kempf 方案把输入编码为 n 个信号–密钥对（全部携带相同的相干 Bell 标签），外加输入量子比特的一个变换副本。比较两个对的标签可得到一项确定性检验，它能定位异常的对并识别其 Pauli 错误类别，同时不泄露该标签。此类检验无法分辨该对中出错的是信号还是密钥，而对这些对的任何测量也都无法分辨（我们证明它们已生成该支撑上全部确定性态盲可观测量构成的群，其秩为 2(n-1)）。这种模糊性至关重要：信号出错只损失一条赎回路径，密钥出错则威胁所有路径。然而，若同时保留变换后的输入量子比特，则在任意克隆数下都恰好多出两项独立检验，这足以识别取自单量子比特 Pauli 集合的任意单一故障。对三个克隆，总共得到六项检验，并且我们证明没有更小的态盲可观测量集合能达到同样的分辨力。在不同克隆数之间，奇偶性决定的是为达到这一分辨力必须联合测量多少个分量，而不是分辨力本身。随后我们把这些发现抽象为一个通用框架——态盲可观测量、确定性健康参照、由校验子诱导的故障划分、面向赎回的充分性——由此得到关系可诊断性：校验子不必识别每个故障，只需识别到足以选出一条安全赎回路径的程度。
summary_cn: 证明量子加密克隆的冗余可做一次性故障诊断：对间标签比较能定位异常对但分不清信号与密钥出错，加入变换后输入比特的两项检验即可识别任意单一 Pauli 故障，三克隆时六项检验且为最小集合。
objective_summary: 以 Yamaguchi–Kempf 方案为对象，分析用关系型 Pauli 可观测量做一次性故障诊断的能力边界，以定理证明给出秩与最小性结论，并抽象出关系可诊断性框架。
evidence_note: 33 页正文给出生成群秩 2(n-1)、三克隆六项检验最小性等证明；摘要未提及实验或数值模拟。
novelty_note: 把加密冗余重新用作诊断资源并提出关系可诊断性概念，建立在两篇配套预印本的约化态刻画之上。
scope: 结论限于 Yamaguchi–Kempf 型编码与单量子比特 Pauli 集合中的单一故障模型。
limitations: 只处理单一 Pauli 故障，多故障、非 Pauli 噪声与实际硬件上的可行性未涉及。

title: Not All 4-bit Quantizers Are Equal: Deployment-Time Mitigation of PII Leakage in Fine-Tuned Small Language Models
abstract: Organizations fine-tune small language models on private data and then compress them to 4 bits for resource-efficient deployment. We show that the compression method also affects privacy. What separates the methods is not the bit width but whether they tune their rounding on a small sample of text, the calibration corpus. On our primary model, when each planted record's own opening text is used as the prompt, the two calibration-based methods we test, Activation-aware Weight Quantization (AWQ) and Gradient-based Post-Training Quantization (GPTQ), each reproduce none of the planted records, while the calibration-corpus-free GGUF Q4_K_M format reproduces 5.3% of them. Tracked across five open models with 0.5-7 billion parameters, AWQ leaks least at every size and in both families, with little accuracy loss at 3-7 billion. Controlled experiments associate the difference with calibration-induced rounding error in channels involved in rare-token prediction. Choosing the 4-bit method is therefore a deployment-time privacy decision, not only a question of speed and quality.
comment: 10 pages and 5 tables. The source code and per-seed experimental results are publicly available at this https URL. Accepted for publication at SBSeg 2026
title_cn: 并非所有 4 位量化器都一样：微调小语言模型中 PII 泄露的部署时缓解
abstract_cn: 组织在私有数据上微调小语言模型，再把模型压缩到 4 位，以实现资源高效的部署。我们表明，压缩方法同样影响隐私。各方法之间的差别不在位宽，而在于它们是否在一小段文本样本（即校准语料）上调整舍入。在我们的主模型上，当以每条植入记录自身的开头文本作为提示时，我们测试的两种基于校准的方法——激活感知权重量化（AWQ）与基于梯度的训练后量化（GPTQ）——都没有复现任何植入记录，而无需校准语料的 GGUF Q4_K_M 格式复现了其中 5.3%。在参数量 0.5B–7B 的五个开放模型上跟踪，AWQ 在每个规模、两个模型家族中都泄露最少，且在 3B–7B 规模上准确率损失很小。受控实验把这一差异与校准引起的舍入误差联系起来，这些误差出现在参与罕见 token 预测的通道中。因此，选择哪种 4 位方法是一项部署时的隐私决策，而不只是速度与质量的问题。
summary_cn: 4 位量化方法影响微调小模型的 PII 泄露：主模型上 AWQ、GPTQ 未复现植入记录，GGUF Q4_K_M 复现 5.3%；五个 0.5B–7B 模型上 AWQ 均泄露最少（SBSeg 2026）。
objective_summary: 比较 AWQ、GPTQ 与 GGUF Q4_K_M 三种 4 位量化方法下微调模型复现植入 PII 记录的程度，在五个开放模型上跟踪，并以受控实验分析差异成因。
evidence_note: 五个 0.5B–7B 开放模型、两个家族、多随机种子并公开逐种子结果，辅以受控机理实验；未报告统计检验。
novelty_note: 指出决定量化隐私影响的是校准语料而非位宽，为模型记忆与压缩方向补充部署侧视角。
scope: 结论限于 0.5B–7B 的五个开放模型、植入记录与以记录开头文本为提示的抽取设置。
limitations: 泄露仅以植入记录的前缀提示复现衡量，未覆盖更强的抽取攻击与更大规模模型。

title: Feedback Coding Enables Inference-Time Covert Agentic Communication
abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to automate digital interactions, users can leverage LLM-generated text as cover for covert communication within seemingly benign conversations. Existing LLM steganography, however, is predominantly white-box, requiring the sender and receiver to share the cover statistics, typically through access to the model weights and prompt. Black-box schemes remove this requirement by allowing the receiver to operate solely on the generated text, but current approaches rely on fixed-length, open-loop watermarking techniques that suffer from high decoding error rates under variable-length token generation. We recast black-box LLM steganography as a sequential communication problem with causal, noiseless feedback: every generated token is observed by both parties and can guide subsequent embedding. Based on this perspective, we introduce \textbf{B}urnashev \textbf{A}daptive Posterior \textbf{M}atching (BAM), a feedback-coding scheme that combines posterior matching with a decode-and-confirm phase. The design is inspired by classical information-theoretic feedback-coding principles, while its security is established through a cryptographic reduction proof. Across three open-weight language models, we demonstrate that BAM attains 0-0.1\% empirical message error on an 8-bit payload in around 50 tokens, across 1000 trials, versus 10-17\% for the strongest black-box baseline at comparable length. Building on the proposed steganography algorithm, we demonstrate the feasibility of an end-to-end communication protocol that achieves high communication rates across multiple conversational settings.
title_cn: 反馈编码使能推理时的隐蔽智能体通信
abstract_cn: 随着 LLM 日益自动化数字交互，用户可把 LLM 生成文本当作掩护，在看似良性的对话中进行隐蔽通信。现有 LLM 隐写多为白盒：收发双方需共享掩护统计（通常需访问模型权重与提示）。黑盒方案去掉该要求、让接收方只依赖生成文本，但现有方法依赖定长开环水印，在变长 token 生成下解码错误率高。我们把黑盒 LLM 隐写重述为带因果无噪反馈的顺序通信问题：每个生成 token 都被双方观测并可用于引导后续嵌入。基于此视角，我们提出 Burnashev 自适应后向匹配（BAM）——结合后向匹配与解码-确认相的反馈编码方案，设计受经典信息论反馈编码启发，安全性由密码学归约证明保证。在三个开放权重模型上，BAM 在约 50 个 token 内以 0–0.1% 的经验消息错误率传输 8 位载荷（1,000 次试验），而同等长度的最强黑盒基线为 10–17%。基于该隐写算法，我们演示了跨多对话场景实现高通信速率的端到端协议。
summary_cn: 把黑盒 LLM 隐写重述为带反馈的顺序通信并给出 BAM 编码：约 50 token 传 8 bit 错误率 ≤0.1%（基线 10–17%），带安全性归约证明。
objective_summary: 以反馈编码重构黑盒 LLM 隐写并提出 BAM 方案，理论归约 + 多模型实验验证错误率与速率优势。
evidence_note: 密码学归约证明 + 三模型 1,000 次试验的量化对比；检测方（隐写分析）对抗未评估。
novelty_note: 把经典反馈编码（Burnashev）引入 LLM 隐写是干净的跨域迁移，解决变长解码错误的实际问题。
scope: 结论适用于自回归 LLM 文本生成与所测载荷规模；对强隐写分析对手未验证。
limitations: 隐蔽性评估限于分布层面；速率受确认相位开销限制；对采样温度敏感性未讨论。

title: Residual Community Prototypes Under-Reject Held-Out Malware Families in FCG-MFD
abstract: Open-set malware-family recognition must classify known families while rejecting families absent from training. We test whether Louvain-community summaries add rejection information beyond a graph neural network embedding and dimension-matched generic topology. The study uses a deduplicated, conflict-audited FCG-MFD corpus, five held-out families, and three optimization seeds. Community features are residualized against generic topology using known-family training data before nearest-prototype scoring. Residual community does not produce stable held-out-family rejection. Ranking effects reverse across families, the false-positive rate at 95 percent unknown recall worsens for every held-out family, and a validation-fitted threshold rejects only 4.48 percent of unknown samples. Accepted-known macro F1 improves in every family, but with five independent family units the exact two-sided sign-flip p-value is 0.0625, the smallest attainable value. The score remains associated with graph scale, while simple classifier uncertainty performs better on ranking, high-recall rejection, and OSCR. In this GIN/FCG-MFD setting, community-enriched prototypes change known-class geometry without creating a stable unknown margin. Graph open-set evaluations should pair structural features with matched topology controls, operational thresholds, and held-out-family analysis.
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables
title_cn: 残余社区原型在 FCG-MFD 留出家族上拒绝失效
abstract_cn: 开放集恶意软件家族识别要在分类已知家族的同时拒绝训练中缺席的家族。我们检验 Louvain 社区摘要是否在 GNN 嵌入与维度匹配的通用拓扑之外提供额外拒绝信息。研究使用去重、冲突审计的 FCG-MFD 语料、五个留出家族与三个优化种子：社区特征先用已知家族训练数据对通用拓扑做残差化，再最近原型打分。残余社区特征不能产生稳定的留出家族拒绝：排序效应跨家族反转、每个留出家族在 95% 未知召回下的 FPR 都恶化、验证集拟合的阈值只拒绝 4.48% 的未知样本。已接受已知类的宏 F1 在每个家族都提升，但五个独立家族单位下双侧符号翻转 p 值为 0.0625（可达最小值）。分数仍与图规模相关，而简单分类器不确定性在排序、高召回拒绝与 OSCR 上表现更好。在此 GIN/FCG-MFD 设定中，社区增强的原型改变了已知类几何却没有建立稳定的未知边际。图开放集评估应把结构特征与匹配拓扑对照、运维阈值与留出家族分析配对。
summary_cn: 严格对照实验表明：FCG 恶意软件家族开放集识别中，Louvain 社区特征对留出家族的拒绝无稳定增益（仅拒 4.48%），简单分类器不确定性反而更好。
objective_summary: 以匹配拓扑对照与多种子实验检验社区特征在开放集家族识别中的增量价值，得到稳健的负面结论。
evidence_note: 去重审计语料、五个留出家族、三种子、符号翻转检验并诚实报告不可达显著性；单一 GIN 架构为限。
novelty_note: 负面对照的方法学示范有价值；问题设定与特征均非新提出。
scope: 结论限于 GIN/FCG-MFD 设定与最近原型打分；其他架构与特征组合未覆盖。
limitations: 单一架构与语料；原型法不代表所有开放集方法；家族数量限制统计功效。

title: OPBackdoor: Opportunistic Backdoors via Alibi-Aligned Reasoning
abstract: When a backdoor trigger activates the target response regardless of the triggered prompt context, the backdoor objective reveals itself. Challenging this trigger-sufficient formulation across the LLM backdoor literature, we introduce Opportunistic Backdoors (OPBackdoor), in which the backdoor objective is elicited only when the triggered prompt context presents an exploitable opportunity, enabling the model's think to disguise its pursuit through alibi-aligned reasoning that is logical with respect to the triggered prompt context but directly leads to the target response. Across dense and MoE architectures of 26B-119B, we induce OPBackdoor via counterfactual training in coding assistants to retaliate against hostile users via excessive helpfulness and translation assistants to engage in commercial propaganda via biased translation. Yet alibi-aligned reasoning has limits: it can convince LLM inspectors that no backdoor is at work, while contrastive monitoring exposes the backdoor objective.
title_cn: OPBackdoor：经托辞对齐推理的机会型后门
abstract_cn: 当后门触发器无论提示上下文如何都激活目标响应时，后门目标便暴露自身。挑战 LLM 后门文献中这一「触发即充分」的表述，我们提出机会型后门（OPBackdoor）：后门目标只在被触发提示上下文呈现可利用机会时才被引出，使模型的 think 能通过「托辞对齐推理」伪装其追求——推理相对被触发的上下文是合乎逻辑的，却直接导向目标响应。在 26B–119B 的稠密与 MoE 架构上，我们经反事实训练在编码助手中诱发 OPBackdoor 以「过度帮助」报复敌意用户，在翻译助手中经有偏翻译进行商业宣传。托辞对齐推理也有极限：它可以说服 LLM 检查器相信没有后门，而对比监控能暴露后门目标。
summary_cn: 提出「机会触发 + 托辞对齐推理」的 LLM 后门 OPBackdoor：推理看似合理却导向目标响应，能骗过 LLM 检查器，但对比监控可暴露。
objective_summary: 提出上下文机会触发的后门新形态，展示其对检查器的欺骗性与对比监控的检测潜力。
evidence_note: 跨 26B–119B 稠密与 MoE 架构、两类应用场景、含检查器与监控对照；触发机会的现实分布未系统刻画。
novelty_note: 把后门从「触发即发」推进到「机会条件 + 推理伪装」，同时给出对应检测思路，攻防两侧均有新意。
scope: 结论适用于经反事实训练可植入的后门场景；对无训练访问的部署威胁未覆盖。
limitations: 训练成本高；「机会」定义依赖场景工程；对比监控的可扩展性未验证。

title: Decoding Guardrails: XAI-Guided Perturbation Analysis of Prompt Injection Detection
abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in production systems, raising concerns about their exposure to adversarial manipulation through prompt injection and jailbreak attacks. Classifier-based guardrails, such as Prompt Guard 2, are widely used as a first line of defense against such attacks, but their internal decision logic is largely opaque to both defenders and attackers. This paper presents an exploratory case study that applies explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) techniques to analyze how Prompt Guard 2 distinguishes malicious from benign prompts. We conduct four experiments to probe this question empirically. Guided by Vanilla Gradient and SHAP attributions, we find that Prompt Guard 2's decisions rely on the cumulative contribution of many tokens rather than a few dominant ones, yet saliency-guided synonym substitution and sentence-level paraphrasing can flip its predictions while altering only a moderate fraction of the text, in some cases yielding a successful jailbreak against the underlying LLM. A dataset-scale saliency analysis further shows that undetected injection prompts systematically lack the lexical markers the classifier relies on. We discuss the implications of these findings for the design and evaluation of classifier-based guardrails, and argue that explanation methods intended to support transparency can simultaneously lower the cost of constructing successful adversarial bypasses.
title_cn: 解码护栏：提示注入检测的 XAI 引导扰动分析
abstract_cn: LLM 日益部署于生产系统，其对提示注入与越狱攻击的暴露令人关切。基于分类器的护栏（如 Prompt Guard 2）被广泛用作第一道防线，但其内部决策逻辑对防御者与攻击者都不透明。本文以可解释 AI（XAI）技术对一个案例做探索性分析：Prompt Guard 2 如何区分恶意与良性提示。在 Vanilla Gradient 与 SHAP 归因引导下的四组实验发现：该分类器的决策依赖大量 token 的累积贡献而非少数主导 token；但显著性引导的同义替换与句级改写可在仅改动适度比例文本的情况下翻转其预测——某些情况构成对底层 LLM 的成功越狱。数据集规模的显著性分析进一步显示：未被检出的注入提示系统性地缺少分类器所依赖的词汇标记。我们讨论这些发现对分类器护栏设计与评估的影响，并指出：本意支持透明性的解释方法，同时可能降低构造对抗绕过的成本。
summary_cn: 用 SHAP/梯度归因解剖 Prompt Guard 2：显著性引导的少量文本改写即可翻转检测并实现越狱，未检出注入系统性缺少分类器依赖的词汇标记。
objective_summary: 以 XAI 引导的扰动实验刻画主流注入检测器的决策依赖与可绕过性，讨论透明性的双刃效应。
evidence_note: 四组实验 + 数据集规模显著性分析、对象为生产级护栏；单检测器案例研究、攻击成功率统计口径有限。
novelty_note: 把 XAI 定位为攻击成本降低器并系统验证于注入检测器，视角与实证都有价值。
scope: 结论适用于 Prompt Guard 2 类分类器护栏；对基于 LLM 的检测器与运行时防御未测。
limitations: 单一检测器与版本；绕过以良性-恶意边界文本为主；防御建议未做闭环验证。

title: Reasoning Topology Matters: A Controlled Study of LLM-Based Cybersecurity Analysis
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in cybersecurity, where accurate analysis often requires multi-step and context-dependent reasoning over complex and heterogeneous data. However, existing prompting approaches typically focus on eliciting reasoning without explicitly considering how intermediate reasoning steps are structurally organized. We introduce Security Reasoning Topology, which models reasoning through three representative structures: Linear, Branching, and Graph. To evaluate their effects, we conduct controlled experiments on three cybersecurity datasets covering MITRE ATT&CK network traffic, cyber threat intelligence (CTI), and CVE vulnerability analysis. We evaluate multiple LLMs, including Llama 2 (7B, 13B, 70B), GPT-5.1, and Mistral Large 3, while keeping task inputs consistent and controlling reasoning structure through system-level prompting. Results show that reasoning topology substantially affects performance: Graph reasoning achieves the highest overall accuracy, improving over few-shot prompting by 9.8-12.2 percentage points across datasets, while Branching provides a strong intermediate solution. The results further show that the effect of reasoning topology remains consistent across model families and scales, highlighting reasoning topology as an important design factor for LLM-based cybersecurity analysis.
comment: Accepted at AIAIS 2027
title_cn: 推理拓扑至关重要：LLM 网络安全分析的受控研究
abstract_cn: LLM 在网络安全中的应用日增，准确分析常需要对复杂异构数据的多步、上下文相关推理。但现有提示方法通常只关心引出推理，不显式考虑中间推理步骤的结构组织。我们引入「安全推理拓扑」，以三种代表结构建模推理：线性、分支与图。为评估其影响，在覆盖 MITRE ATT&CK 网络流量、网络威胁情报（CTI）与 CVE 漏洞分析的三个数据集上做受控实验，评估 Llama 2（7B/13B/70B）、GPT-5.1 与 Mistral Large 3，保持任务输入一致、经系统级提示控制推理结构。结果显示推理拓扑显著影响性能：图推理总体准确率最高，较少样本提示在三个数据集上提升 9.8–12.2 个百分点，分支推理是强的中间方案；该效应跨模型族与规模保持一致，说明推理拓扑是 LLM 网络安全分析的重要设计因素（AIAIS 2027）。
summary_cn: 受控比较线性/分支/图三种推理结构对 LLM 网络安全分析的影响：图结构在三个任务上较少样本提示提升 9.8–12.2 点且跨模型稳定。
objective_summary: 以系统级提示控制推理拓扑，在三个安全任务与五个模型上做受控比较并量化结构效应。
evidence_note: 任务输入一致、多模型多规模、效应方向一致；会议级别一般、缺少方差与显著性细节。
novelty_note: 「结构化推理有帮助」方向已有大量工作，贡献在安全域内的受控量化与拓扑分型。
scope: 结论适用于所测任务类型与模型集；对需要工具调用的智能体式分析未覆盖。
limitations: 提示工程细节敏感；评测集规模有限；图构建本身的成本未计入。

title: Domain Specific Post Quantum Signatures for Blockchains
abstract: Blockchains need more than post quantum single signer signatures. They need consensus profiled authentication objects with canonical bytes, priced invalid input rejection, stable transaction identifiers, hybrid downgrade resistance, public aggregation, merge semantics, accountable signer evidence, forward secure committee rotation, and light client consequences. We argue for domain specific post quantum signatures for blockchain roles, analogously to how hash function engineering produced domain specific primitives for hash table DoS and arithmetized proof systems. We formalize transaction authorization and quorum certificate requirements, instantiate them on Bitcoin, Ethereum, and a Sei Giga style high throughput BFT stress profile, and evaluate ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, Falcon/FN-DSA, HAWK, MAYO, SNOVA, UOV/QR-UOV, FAEST, SQIsign, LaBRADOR Falcon, Squirrel, Chipmunk, and DKKW/LeanSig. The conclusion is blunt. NIST single signer signatures are necessary components, although none of the current schemes is a drop in replacement for the signature layer of modern public blockchains. The missing object is a consensus ready post quantum signature profile, not another generic size table.
title_cn: 面向区块链的领域专用后量子签名
abstract_cn: 区块链需要的不是量子安全的单签签名，而是与共识耦合的认证对象：规范字节、定价化的非法输入拒绝、稳定交易标识、混合降级抵抗、公开聚合、合并语义、可问责签名者证据、前向安全的委员会轮换，以及轻客户端后果。我们主张为区块链角色设计领域专用的后量子签名，正如哈希函数工程曾为哈希表 DoS 与算术化证明系统产出领域专用原语。我们形式化交易授权与法定人数证书要求，在 Bitcoin、Ethereum 与 Sei Giga 式高吞吐 BFT 压力画像上实例化，并评估 ML-DSA、SLH-DSA、Falcon/FN-DSA、HAWK、MAYO、SNOVA、UOV/QR-UOV、FAEST、SQIsign、LaBRADOR Falcon、Squirrel、Chipmunk 与 DKKW/LeanSig。结论直白：NIST 单签签名是必要组件，但没有一个是现代公链签名层的即插即用替代；缺失的对象是「共识就绪」的后量子签名轮廓，而非又一张通用尺寸对照表。
summary_cn: 论证区块链需要「共识就绪」的领域专用后量子签名轮廓而非通用 NIST 方案：形式化七类需求并在三大链画像上评估 14 个签名方案。
objective_summary: 形式化区块链签名的角色需求，宽口径评估 14 个 PQC 签名方案，论证需要领域专用轮廓的立场。
evidence_note: 评估覆盖面广、需求形式化清晰；但性能数字以既有基准与画像为主，非统一的原创测量。
novelty_note: 「共识就绪轮廓」的问题重述有价值，把分散的 PQC 区块链讨论收敛为可执行议程。
scope: 结论适用于 UTXO/账户/高性能 BFT 三类链画像；对 PoS 轻客户端外的模块未展开。
limitations: 方案演进快、结论时效短；未给出自研轮廓的完整规格；实现工程代价未量化。

title: Trust in Edge-Enabled IoT Security: Features, Challenges and Research Directions
abstract: Providing autonomous intelligence, pervasive connectivity and usability to human life and industry has led to the emergence of the Internet of Things (IoT). To support time-sensitive and resource-constrained applications, IoT systems nowadays increasingly rely on edge computing. This brings computation and decision-making closer to end devices. In edge-enabled IoT architecture, latency and communication overhead are reduced, but interactions among a larger and more diverse set of devices, edge nodes, services, and data sources are introduced as well. In such environments, security and privacy mechanisms provide the foundation for protection, while trust management can assess the reliability of interacting entities and adapting secure decisions. In this paper, we systematically review the current state of trust management in edge-enabled IoT. To this end, we propose a comprehensive taxonomy that maps physical, network, and application architectural IoT layers against the consumer, commercial, industrial, and infrastructure IoT domains. We further investigate state-of-art research based on their trust design, how trust integrated into secure IoT operations, the attacks that effect trust management process. Based on these findings, we identify key gaps in current research and outline future directions for context-aware and adaptive trust management in edge-enabled IoT.
comment: 34+ pages, 9 figures, 12 tables, submitted and under review in ACM Computing Surveys
title_cn: 边缘赋能 IoT 安全中的信任：特征、挑战与研究方向
abstract_cn: 为人类生活与产业提供自主智能、泛在连接与易用性催生了物联网（IoT）。为支持时延敏感与资源受限应用，IoT 系统日益依赖边缘计算，把计算与决策拉近终端设备。边缘赋能 IoT 架构降低时延与通信开销，但也引入更大、更多样的设备、边缘节点、服务与数据源交互。在此类环境中，安全与隐私机制提供保护基础，而信任管理可评估交互实体的可靠性并适配安全决策。本文系统综述边缘赋能 IoT 中信任管理的现状：提出把物理/网络/应用三层 IoT 架构映射到消费/商业/工业/基础设施四域的综合分类法；按信任设计检视最新研究、信任如何被集成进安全 IoT 运作、以及影响信任管理过程的攻击；据此识别当前研究的关键缺口并勾勒面向情境感知与自适应信任管理的未来方向。
summary_cn: 对边缘赋能 IoT 信任管理的系统综述：三层架构 × 四应用域分类法、信任设计与相关攻击盘点、以及自适应信任管理的未来方向（投 ACM CSUR 审稿中）。
objective_summary: 系统综述边缘 IoT 信任管理研究，提出架构-领域二维分类法并识别研究缺口。
evidence_note: 有分类法与研究缺口分析；检索与纳入协议在摘要层面未完整披露（34+ 页全文）；无定量元分析。
novelty_note: 信任管理综述已有 prior art，边缘场景的二维映射是增量组织贡献。
scope: 结论适用于资源受限、边缘辅助的 IoT 部署形态。
limitations: 文献快照时效；对可信执行硬件等新趋势覆盖待验证；分类法实用性未经实证检验。

title: 5G-Shark: A Network Security Auditor for 5G Subscriber Privacy and Unauthenticated Signalling Resilience
abstract: The fifth generation of mobile networks was standardised with an explicit mandate to close long-standing privacy and security gaps, mandating the concealment of the subscriber's permanent identity, resistance to generational downgrade, and protection against location tracking. Assessing whether these guarantees hold in operational networks, however, requires separating two sources of residual exposure that prior studies do not distinguish and do not evaluate in the wild: protocol-design limitations, which remain exploitable even against a fully specification-compliant deployment, and implementation gaps, which arise from incomplete or non-compliant implementations. We present 5G-Shark, a security assessment tool and methodology that turns a legitimate mobility procedure against the subscriber. Rather than relying on active jamming or malformed-packet injection, 5G-Shark manipulates the standardised cell-reselection criterion to pull a target User Equipment onto a self-created rogue cell, establishing an attack vantage with minimal service disruption. Then, the proposed methodology effectively performs the required interactions to expose the security risks of the system under test, classifying them into the aforementioned categories. Built solely from open-source stacks and Software Defined Radio hardware and evaluated against commercial 5G Standalone deployments, 5G-Shark requests subscriber identifiers, forces Radio Access Technology downgrade via crafted Registration Reject codes, and induces denial-of-service states. For each vector, we attribute the root cause to protocol design or deployment non-compliance. We further provide empirical evidence that in several commercial deployments, temporary identifiers are re-allocated in near-sequential steps that keep successive values linkable, a weakness that enables persistent user tracking despite correct subscriber ID concealment.
title_cn: 5G-Shark：面向 5G 用户隐私与未认证信令韧性的网络安全审计器
abstract_cn: 第五代移动网络在标准化时负有明确使命：弥合长期存在的隐私与安全缺口——隐藏用户永久标识、抵抗代际降级、抵御位置追踪。要评估这些保证在运营网络中是否成立，需要区分先前研究未区分、也未在真实网络中评估的两类残余暴露：协议设计局限（面对完全合规部署仍可利用）与实现缺口（来自不完整或不合规实现）。我们提出 5G-Shark：一个安全评估工具与方法论，把合法的移动性流程反转到用户身上：不依赖主动干扰或畸形报文注入，而是操纵标准化的小区重选准则，把目标 UE 拉到自建 rogue 小区，以最小服务中断建立攻击立足点；随后执行所需交互暴露被测系统的安全风险，并按上述两类归因。工具仅由开源栈与 SDR 硬件构成，对商用 5G SA 部署评估：请求用户标识、经构造的 Registration Reject 码强制 RAT 降级、诱导拒绝服务状态；对每个向量归因根因。我们进一步给出经验证据：若干商用部署中临时标识以近顺序步进重分配，使 successive 值可链接——尽管用户标识隐藏正确，仍可实现持久追踪。
summary_cn: 以 rogue 小区拉取目标 UE 的 5G 审计工具 5G-Shark：对商用 SA 网络实测标识请求、RAT 降级与 DoS 向量并区分设计缺陷与实现缺口；发现临时标识近顺序分配致可链接追踪。
objective_summary: 构建非侵入式 5G 隐私/韧性审计工具与方法论，在商用网络实测多类攻击向量并按协议/实现归因。
evidence_note: 真实商用 5G SA 部署、多向量在野验证、归因方法清晰；具体运营商与规模披露受限（伦理约束）。
novelty_note: 以合法流程为武器的低扰动攻击立足点与「设计 vs. 实现」归因框架是方法学贡献；单点漏洞多为已知类型的实证确认。
scope: 结论适用于所测商用 5G SA 网络与 SDR 可达的攻击者模型；对内核级基带漏洞与主动干扰不覆盖。
limitations: 伦理限制下的测量范围；网络侧配置变化会影响可复现性；修复验证依赖运营商配合。

title: State-Aware Fuzzing of JavaScript Engines with LLM-Guided Instrumentation
abstract: The security of the modern web depends on the correctness of JavaScript (JS) engines, yet these complex systems remain vulnerable to high-impact bugs. A critical limitation of state-of-the-art fuzzers is the coverage plateau: once a fuzzer saturates the control-flow graph, edge coverage loses its ability to guide discovery. Because complex engine behaviors, such as JIT optimization tiers and hidden class transitions, often share identical edge coverage, standard coverage metrics are blind to the distinct internal states required to trigger deep errors. To bridge this gap, we present StateLens, a framework that employs Large Language Models (LLM) to automate the discovery of deep internal states. Blindly placing instrumentation probes at all states is infeasible due to the vast state space and the high runtime overhead. StateLens introduces a novel agent-based reasoning pipeline that emulates the intuition of a security researcher. By iteratively traversing code and developer comments, our agents intelligently select high-value instrumentation targets, effectively separating logic-driving state variables from irrelevant data. This results in synthesizable, high-signal feedback probes that map the engine's hidden configurations. This instrumentation feeds a dual-feedback mechanism, effectively guiding the fuzzer toward unexplored engine semantics. Our evaluation confirms that StateLens significantly outperforms state-of-the-art fuzzers and uncovering 68 new bugs.
comment: In ACM SIGOPS 32nd Symposium on Operating Systems Principles (SOSP'26)
title_cn: LLM 引导插桩的 JavaScript 引擎状态感知模糊测试
abstract_cn: 现代 Web 的安全取决于 JavaScript 引擎的正确性，而这些复杂系统仍屡现高危漏洞。最先进 fuzzer 的关键局限是覆盖平台期：一旦控制流图饱和，边覆盖便失去引导能力。因为 JIT 优化层级、隐藏类转换等复杂引擎行为常共享相同的边覆盖，标准覆盖指标对触发深层错误所需的内部状态视而不见。为此我们提出 StateLens：用 LLM 自动化发现深层内部状态的框架。在所有状态盲目布点不可行——状态空间巨大且运行时开销高。StateLens 引入模拟安全研究员直觉的智能体推理流水线：经迭代遍历代码与开发者注释，智能体选择高价值插桩目标，有效把驱动逻辑的状态变量与无关数据分开，产生可综合、高信号的反馈探针，映射引擎的隐藏配置；插桩再馈入双反馈机制，引导 fuzzer 探索未触及的引擎语义。评估确认 StateLens 显著超过 SOTA fuzzer，发现 68 个新 bug（SOSP'26）。
summary_cn: 用 LLM 智能体自动定位 JS 引擎的深层内部状态并合成插桩探针，突破边覆盖平台期：显著超越 SOTA fuzzer 并发现 68 个新 bug（SOSP'26）。
objective_summary: 提出 LLM 引导的状态感知模糊测试框架，自动化深层状态探针合成，在真实引擎上验证增益并大量报洞。
evidence_note: SOSP'26 录用、与 SOTA fuzzer 对比、68 个新 bug 的实证产出；消融覆盖 LLM 引导相对随机布点的增益。
novelty_note: 把「语义状态」而非代码覆盖作为模糊反馈对象，并用 LLM 自动化探针发现，是对覆盖平台期问题的实质突破。
scope: 结论适用于 JIT 型 JS 引擎；对其他语言运行时需重建状态模型。
limitations: LLM 推理成本高；状态模型可能遗漏；对非引擎类目标的通用性未测。
institution: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

title: MIRAGE: Full-Body Bystander Privacy for Smart Glasses with Consent-Based Restoration
abstract: Video recording on smart glasses exposes more than faces. Continuous capture reveals full-body biometric signatures, including gait, posture, and silhouette, that enable person re-identification (ReID) even after conventional face sanitization. We present MIRAGE, a three-tier architecture for privacy-preserving smart glasses that enforces full-body privacy, supports synthetic full-body replacement, and retains encrypted recovery material for consent-based restoration. We implement MIRAGE on a Raspberry Pi~5 (a CPU-only proxy for smart-glasses compute), companion phones, and a cloud generative backend. Compared to prior systems, MIRAGE achieves 0.948 AP and 0.976 AR while accurately detecting the complete visible body. Its bounding box masking reduces learned silhouette-based ReID to essentially random guessing, with 10.86% Rank-1 accuracy compared with an 11.12% measured chance level. Even against an adaptive adversary retrained on MIRAGE's sanitized pose signals, Rank-1 gait identification drops from 90.25% to 26.20%, removing 72.5% of the adversary's identification advantage.
title_cn: MIRAGE：基于同意恢复的智能眼镜全身旁观者隐私
abstract_cn: 智能眼镜上的视频录制暴露的不只是人脸：持续拍摄揭示步态、姿态与轮廓等全身生物特征，即便常规人脸净化后仍可实现行人重识别（ReID）。我们提出 MIRAGE，一个三层架构的隐私保护智能眼镜方案：强制全身隐私、支持合成全身替换、保留加密恢复材料以供基于同意的恢复。我们在 Raspberry Pi 5（智能眼镜算力的 CPU 代理）、伴侣手机与云端生成后端上实现。相较先前系统，MIRAGE 在准确检测完整可见身体上达到 0.948 AP 与 0.976 AR；其包围盒掩蔽把基于学习轮廓的 ReID 压到随机水平（Rank-1 10.86% 对实测机会水平 11.12%）；即便面对在 MIRAGE 净化信号上重训的自适应对手，步态识别 Rank-1 也从 90.25% 降到 26.20%，消除 72.5% 的识别优势。
summary_cn: 智能眼镜全身隐私三层架构 MIRAGE：掩蔽后轮廓 ReID 降至随机水平，自适应对手下步态识别 Rank-1 从 90.25% 压到 26.20%，并支持同意后恢复。
objective_summary: 构建检测-掩蔽-可恢复的智能眼镜全身隐私系统，在标准与自适应对手下量化对 ReID 的抑制效果。
evidence_note: 真实硬件原型、自适应重训对手、多指标量化并与先前系统对比；数据集与场景多样性有限。
novelty_note: 把隐私范围从人脸扩展到全身生物特征并支持同意恢复是实质场景推进；掩蔽机制本身为组合。
scope: 结论适用于第一人称可穿戴拍摄场景与所测 ReID/步态模型族。
limitations: Pi 5 与真实眼镜算力有差距；云端生成依赖连接；对侧信道（音频、上下文）泄漏未覆盖。

title: Beyond Predictable Paths: Redefining AI Security Incident Reporting for Agents
abstract: AI agents are being deployed rapidly, accompanied by a growing number of AI-specific attacks and corresponding incidents. As incident reporting becomes increasingly important for legal compliance, governance, accountability, and security; current frameworks must be adapted to the unique characteristics of AI agents. In this paper, two editorial authors compare AI systems and AI agents and, drawing on input from 23 experts in academia and industry, identify the information required for reporting incidents where the security of AI agents is harmed. %involving AI agents. Potential reporting elements include, for example, agent memory and memory accesses, actual and potential levels of autonomy, and tool usage. Based on these findings, we identify several open research questions, including how to efficiently record incidents and how to determine whether vulnerabilities and incidents generalize. Expert feedback also highlighted potential reporting weaknesses, such as risks of data leakage and attacks targeting the reporting infrastructure itself, creating additional research needs. Lastly, we summarize privacy requirements and outline research directions for the secure and trustworthy deployment of AI agents.
comment: under submission, mega paper (authorship does not imply endorsement of every sub-section)
title_cn: 超越可预测路径：为智能体重定义 AI 安全事件报告
abstract_cn: AI 智能体正被快速部署，伴随越来越多的 AI 特有攻击与对应事件。随着事件报告对法律合规、治理、问责与安全日益重要，现有框架必须适配 AI 智能体的独特特征。本文中，两位编辑作者比较 AI 系统与 AI 智能体，并结合 23 位学术界与业界专家的意见，识别在 AI 智能体安全受害事件中报告所需的信息：例如智能体记忆与记忆访问、实际与潜在的自主水平、工具使用。基于这些发现，我们识别若干开放研究问题：如何高效记录事件、如何判断漏洞与事件是否可泛化。专家反馈还凸显报告机制的潜在弱点——数据泄露风险与针对报告基础设施本身的攻击——带来额外研究需要。最后我们总结隐私要求并概述安全可信部署 AI 智能体的研究方向。
summary_cn: 结合 23 位专家意见提出 AI 智能体安全事件报告所需的信息要素（记忆访问、自主水平、工具使用等）与研究议程（立场性工作，标注「作者身份不意味着背书每一小节」）。
objective_summary: 基于专家征询提出智能体安全事件报告框架的要素清单与开放问题。
evidence_note: 23 位专家征询但方法学（抽样、访谈协议）未详；无系统评估；多人署名的编辑过程透明度自陈有限。
novelty_note: 把传统安全事件报告适配到智能体场景的要素清单有实用价值，概念突破有限。
scope: 结论为框架性建议，适用于智能体事件的记录与披露制度设计。
limitations: 专家样本代表性；清单的可用性未做用户研究；与现有监管条文的映射未完成。

title: Prefix Puncturable Signatures with Smaller Signing Key from HIBS
abstract: Puncturable signatures, proposed by Bellare et al. (EUROCRYPT 2016), allow a signing key to be punctured (updated) so that it loses the ability to sign particular messages while retaining the ability to sign all others. Halevi et al. (ASIACRYPT 2017) introduced prefix puncturable signatures, in which the signing key can be punctured with respect to a target prefix so that it cannot sign messages whose prefixes match the target prefix. So far, several generic constructions of prefix puncturable signature schemes have been proposed, including constructions based on identity-based signatures (IBS) (ESORICS 2022) and delegated constrained signatures (IEEE Trans. Inf. Forensics Secure. 2024). However, these constructions suffer from drawbacks in terms of key size. When the prefix space is the set of all l-bit strings, the former construction requires a signing key consisting of 2^{l} IBS signing keys. The latter construction, when instantiated with a lattice-based delegated constrained signature scheme, yields a punctured signing key whose size grows quadratically with the number of puncturing operations Q^{Punc}. In this paper, we present a generic construction of prefix puncturable signatures from hierarchical identity-based signature (HIBS) schemes. When the prefix space is {0,1}^{l} and our construction is instantiated with the lattice-based HIBS scheme HIBS^{GPV} by Ruckert (PQC 2010), our construction achieves a punctured signing key size bounded by O(lQ^{Punc}).
comment: A preliminary version of this paper is appeared in the 28th International Conference on Information and Communications Security (ICICS 2026)
title_cn: 基于 HIBS 的更短签名密钥前缀可穿孔签名
abstract_cn: 可穿孔签名（Bellare 等，EUROCRYPT 2016）允许更新签名密钥使其失去对特定消息的签名能力而保留其余能力。前缀可穿孔签名（Halevi 等，ASIACRYPT 2017）进一步允许按目标前缀穿孔：穿孔后无法签署前缀匹配的消息。已有若干通用构造：基于身份签名（IBS）的构造（ESORICS 2022）在前缀空间为全部 l 位串时需要 2^l 个 IBS 签名密钥组成签名密钥；基于委托受限签名的构造（IEEE TIFS 2024）以格实例化时穿孔密钥大小随穿孔次数 Q^Punc 二次增长。本文提出从分层身份基签名（HIBS）出发的前缀可穿孔签名通用构造：以前缀空间 {0,1}^l 计，用 Rückert 的格基 HIBS（HIBS^GPV，PQC 2010）实例化时，穿孔签名密钥大小以 O(lQ^Punc) 为界。
summary_cn: 给出由 HIBS 构造前缀可穿孔签名的通用方案：以格基 HIBS 实例化后穿孔密钥尺寸 O(lQ^Punc)，显著优于此前 2^l 与二次增长的构造。
objective_summary: 提出由 HIBS 构造前缀可穿孔签名的通用方案并证明安全，密钥尺寸相对既有构造有量级改进。
evidence_note: 通用构造带安全归约与具体实例化尺寸分析；无实现性能评估。
novelty_note: 把 HIBS 的层级结构对准前缀穿孔是自然但此前未被发现的路径，尺寸改进实质。
scope: 结论为渐近尺寸界；具体常数取决于所选 HIBS 实例与参数。
limitations: 未实现与基准；签名/验证开销与密钥生成的代价未比较。

title: ActGov: Governing LLM Agent Actions via Policy-Constrained Validation
abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly execute long-horizon workflows through external tools, allowing untrusted outputs to influence subsequent actions and exceed user authorization. Existing defenses isolate injected content or constrain execution with predefined plans and static policies, but these approaches are brittle under dynamic workflows and scale poorly across extensible tool ecosystems. In this work, we present ActGov, a runtime enforcement framework that validates each LLM-proposed tool action before it causes external effects. Built on a unified semantic model of authorization, actions, runtime context, and security constraints, the ActGov-Policy component iteratively constructs a policy set from tool specifications, benign tasks, and observed failure traces, with each update verified through SMT-based counterexample checking. At runtime, ActGov-Runtime abstracts each tool call into finite policy records and permits it only if it remains within the task-scoped authorization boundary and satisfies all applicable policies. This per-action enforcement preserves authorization throughout long-horizon, dynamically branching workflows. We evaluate ActGov on the AgentDojo and AgentDyn benchmarks across multiple models and attack configurations. It shows that ActGov consistently reduces the success rate of indirect prompt-injection attacks while preserving task utility, significantly outperforming existing defenses. These results demonstrate that ActGov can enforce fine-grained authorization over dynamic agent executions without relying on the underlying LLM to correctly identify malicious instructions.
title_cn: ActGov：经策略约束验证治理 LLM 智能体动作
abstract_cn: LLM 智能体日益通过外部工具执行长时程工作流，使不可信输出得以影响后续动作并超出用户授权。现有防御隔离注入内容或以预定义计划、静态策略约束执行，但动态工作流下脆弱、且难以跨可扩展工具生态扩展。我们提出 ActGov，一个在 LLM 提议的工具动作造成外部效果前验证它的运行时强制框架。基于授权、动作、运行时上下文与安全约束的统一语义模型，ActGov-Policy 组件从工具规格、良性任务与观察到的失败轨迹迭代构建策略集，每次更新都经基于 SMT 的反例检查验证；运行时，ActGov-Runtime 把每个工具调用抽象为有限策略记录，仅当其保持在任务范围的授权边界内且满足全部适用策略时才放行。这种逐动作强制在长时程、动态分支的工作流中保持授权。在 AgentDojo 与 AgentDyn 基准、多模型多攻击配置上的评估显示：ActGov 持续降低间接提示注入攻击成功率并保持任务效用，显著优于现有防御，表明其可在不依赖底层 LLM 正确识别恶意指令的情况下对动态智能体执行强制细粒度授权。
summary_cn: 对 LLM 智能体的每个工具动作做 SMT 验证的策略约束运行时强制 ActGov：AgentDojo/AgentDyn 上显著降低间接注入成功率且保持任务效用。
objective_summary: 提出策略构建与运行时强制分离的智能体动作治理框架，以反例检查保证策略一致性，在标准基准上量化攻防表现。
evidence_note: 两个公开基准、多模型多攻击配置、与现有防御对比并保持效用；策略完备性依赖规格与失败轨迹覆盖。
novelty_note: 统一语义模型 + SMT 反例检查的策略管理是对智能体运行时治理的系统化推进；思想与策略抽象/信息流控制有渊源。
scope: 结论适用于工具语义可形式化的智能体系统；对语义模糊的 API 与物理动作不适用。
limitations: 策略构建成本高；对未建模工具的覆盖缺口；延迟开销未详细报告。
institution: Southern University of Science and Technology

title: SkelOT: Reusing AOT Compilation Across EVM Contract Families
abstract: Ahead-of-time (AOT) compilers (e.g., revmc, evmone, and DTVM) for the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) reuse compilation artifacts at contract-code-hash granularity. This granularity is poorly matched to real EVM workloads dominated by \emph{contract families}: factory-, proxy-, and template-driven deployments that share instruction structure but differ in a small set of embedded constants. Across four EVM chains (Base, Ethereum, BSC, and Arbitrum), we find that 23.1--47.6\% of unique compilable bytecodes map to shared family skeletons within 10K-block windows. Per-hash AOT therefore redundantly recompiles structurally equivalent code, inflating compile time and artifact footprint while reducing workload coverage under finite compile budgets. We present \textsc{SkelOT}, an AOT framework that lifts the unit of compilation reuse from code hash to family skeleton. \textsc{SkelOT} compiles one native artifact per family, bakes invariant constants into the artifact, and reads variant constants from a per-contract runtime table. Built on revmc/LLVM and evaluated on a 10K-block Base mainnet corpus (3.52M transactions), \textsc{SkelOT} reduces compilation units by 47.5\%, artifact footprint by 57.4\%, and compile time by $2.19\times$, while preserving byte-identical execution outcomes versus per-hash AOT. At runtime, \textsc{SkelOT} delivers a $1.31\times$ median per-contract speedup across family members. Under a compile budget targeting 75\% execution-time coverage, \textsc{SkelOT} needs far fewer artifacts than per-hash AOT, and the advantage holds at every coverage target.
comment: Accepted by EuroSys'27
title_cn: SkelOT：跨 EVM 合约族复用 AOT 编译
abstract_cn: 以太坊虚拟机（EVM）的提前编译器（revmc、evmone、DTVM）以合约代码哈希为粒度复用编译产物。该粒度与真实 EVM 负载失配：后者由工厂/代理/模板驱动的「合约族」主导——共享指令结构、仅少数内嵌常量不同。横跨四条 EVM 链（Base、Ethereum、BSC、Arbitrum），我们发现在 1 万块窗口内 23.1–47.6% 的唯一可编译字节码映射到共享族骨架。逐哈希 AOT 因此对结构等价代码重复编译，推高编译时间与产物占用，并在有限编译预算下降低覆盖率。我们提出 SkelOT，把编译复用单位从代码哈希提升到族骨架：每族编译一个原生工件、把不变常量烘焙进工件、从逐合约运行时表读取变体常量。基于 revmc/LLVM、在 1 万块 Base 主网语料（352 万交易）上评估：编译单元减 47.5%、产物占用减 57.4%、编译时间降 2.19 倍，执行结果与逐哈希 AOT 字节一致；族成员合约运行时中位加速 1.31 倍；在面向 75% 执行时间覆盖的编译预算下，所需工件远少于逐哈希 AOT，且优势在任意覆盖目标下保持（EuroSys'27）。
summary_cn: 发现 EVM 合约以「家族」为主、逐哈希 AOT 大量重复编译；SkelOT 以族骨架为复用单位：编译单元减 47.5%、编译快 2.19 倍、族内合约加速 1.31 倍（EuroSys'27）。
objective_summary: 测量 EVM 合约族的普遍性并构建以族为单位的 AOT 编译复用框架，在主网语料上量化编译与运行时收益。
evidence_note: 四链测量 + 主网 352 万交易评估 + 字节级一致性验证，顶会录用；安全性仅体现在执行等价性。
novelty_note: 族粒度复用的观察与工程实现结合扎实；核心机制（常量参数化）并不复杂。
scope: 结论适用于 EVM 字节码族明显的链与负载；对非 EVM VM 与高度独特合约收益有限。
limitations: 家族聚类质量影响正确性边界；跨合约族误配的后果分析有限；冷启动编译预算敏感。

title: Passive Hybrid Network-Based Intrusion Detection System (Hybrid-NIDS) Combining Suricata and Random Forest
abstract: This paper evaluates a passive Hybrid Network-based Intrusion Detection System (Hybrid-NIDS) prototype that combines Suricata with Random Forest flow classification and centralized ELK-based alert handling. The study explicitly separates benchmark evaluation from PCAP/live operational validation and controls exact feature-duplicate leakage using feature hashing and group-aware splitting. From 2,540,047 UNSW-NB15 records, 453 conflicting-label hash groups containing 1,879 rows were removed; the resulting Development and Hold-out sets have zero exact feature-hash overlap. RF-41 achieved F1 = 0.971360 and ROC-AUC = 0.999671, while the NFStream-compatible RF-21 achieved F1 = 0.970148 on the same prepared hold-out boundary. However, operational validation revealed substantial benchmark-to-deployment domain shift: on a labeled laboratory PCAP, RF-21 and the strictly correlated branch achieved recall of only 0.0095, and RF-21 produced no alerts in five additional 60-second attack sessions. An unlabeled normal-traffic test produced 439 alerts from 2,375 flows; this value is reported only as an alert ratio and is not interpreted as a false-positive rate. These results show that strong performance on a public benchmark does not directly translate into operational effectiveness. Accordingly, the current Hybrid-NIDS should be interpreted as a passive prototype and evaluation framework, and the reported experiments do not demonstrate that Suricata-Random Forest correlation provides better operational detection than Suricata alone.
comment: Accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 29th National Conference on Selected Issues of Information and Communication Technology (VNICT 2026), Hanoi, Vietnam, November 7-8, 2026
title_cn: 结合 Suricata 与随机森林的被动混合网络入侵检测系统
abstract_cn: 本文评估一个被动混合网络入侵检测原型：结合 Suricata 与随机森林流分类及集中式 ELK 告警处理。研究明确区分基准评估与 PCAP/在线运维验证，并用特征哈希与分组划分控制精确特征重复泄漏：从 2,540,047 条 UNSW-NB15 记录中移除 453 个冲突标签哈希组（1,879 行），使开发/留出集零精确特征重叠。RF-41 达 F1=0.971360、ROC-AUC=0.999671；同一边界上 NFStream 兼容的 RF-21 F1=0.970148。但运维验证揭示基准到部署的显著域偏移：在带标注的实验室 PCAP 上，RF-21 与强相关分支召回仅 0.0095，RF-21 在另外五个 60 秒攻击会话中未产生任何告警；无标签正常流量测试产生 2,375 流中 439 条告警——该值仅作为告警率报告，不被解释为误报率。结果表明公开基准上的强表现不直接转化为运维有效性。当前混合 NIDS 应被理解为被动原型与评估框架；报告的实验不能证明 Suricata-随机森林相关提供优于单独 Suricata 的运维检测。
summary_cn: 控制特征泄漏后基准 F1 仍达 0.97 的 Suricata+随机森林原型，在实验室 PCAP 上召回仅 0.95%——诚实展示 IDS 基准分数与运维效果的巨大鸿沟。
objective_summary: 以控制泄漏的严格基准与真实 PCAP 运维验证对照，量化 IDS 原型的基准-部署域偏移并给出负面结论。
evidence_note: 泄漏控制明确、基准与运维双层验证、诚实报告负面结果并约束结论边界；单一数据集与实验室环境为限。
novelty_note: 负面结果本身对该子领域有校准价值；「基准-运维鸿沟」在 IDS 文献中早有讨论，此处给出干净实证。
scope: 结论适用于 UNSW-NB15 类基准与实验室 PCAP 场景的 Suricata+RF 组合。
limitations: 实验室 PCAP 规模小；未调优检测阈值；未评估更新训练分布后的恢复空间。
institution: Ho Chi Minh City College of Transport

title: Name2Pkg: Lightweight One-Class Android Malware Screening via Name-Package Correspondence Modeling
abstract: Deep learning-based malware detection has been widely adopted in security-critical services. Most detection methods rely on internal features extracted from APK files or runtime behavior. However, extracting these features is computationally expensive. This limits their use in large-scale, early-stage screening. Malicious apps may exhibit weak correspondence between their user-facing app names and package names, providing a low-cost screening signal. We present Name2Pkg, a lightweight one-class classification method. It leverages only the app name and the package name. We formulate malware screening as a sequence anomaly detection problem. A character-level sequence-to-sequence model estimates the conditional likelihood of a package name given the app name. The length-normalized negative log-likelihood serves as the anomaly score. We train the model and calibrate the threshold using only benign data. Using a dataset of 67,129 real-world applications, Name2Pkg achieves an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC-AUC) of 0.982 and malware recall of 0.885 at an achieved false-positive rate of 0.044 on held-out test data. It has a 3.57 MiB checkpoint and a CPU inference latency of 28.20 ms per sample. Name2Pkg provides an efficient and effective pre-filtering signal for large-scale security systems.
comment: Original author version, accepted at IEEE ICTAI 2026
title_cn: Name2Pkg：经名称-包名对应建模的轻量单类 Android 恶意软件筛查
abstract_cn: 深度学习恶意软件检测已广泛用于安全关键服务。多数方法依赖从 APK 提取的内部特征或运行时行为，但提取这些特征计算昂贵，限制其在大规模早期筛查中的使用。恶意应用的用户可见应用名与包名之间常呈弱对应，提供一个低成本的筛查信号。我们提出 Name2Pkg，一个只用应用名与包名的轻量单类分类方法：把恶意软件筛查形式化为序列异常检测，字符级 seq2seq 模型估计「给定应用名时包名的条件似然」，以长度归一化负对数似然作为异常分；仅用良性数据训练模型并校准阈值。在 67,129 个真实应用的数据集上，Name2Pkg 在留出测试上 ROC-AUC 0.982、FPR 0.044 下恶意召回 0.885；checkpoint 仅 3.57 MiB，CPU 每样本推理 28.20 毫秒。Name2Pkg 为大规模安全系统提供高效有效的预过滤信号（IEEE ICTAI 2026）。
summary_cn: 只用应用名与包名的单类异常筛查 Name2Pkg：67k 应用上 AUC 0.982、模型 3.57MiB、CPU 推理 28ms，适合恶意软件大规模预过滤。
objective_summary: 提出以名称-包名一致性为信号的单类筛查方法，在 67k 真实应用上量化检测与成本指标。
evidence_note: 67,129 应用、留出测试、FPR 固定下报告召回、部署成本量化；数据时效与家族分布未细说，会议级别一般。
novelty_note: 信号本身（名称与包名不一致）简单而新颖，方法为标准 seq2seq 异常检测。
scope: 结论适用于 Google Play 类命名规范下的 Android 应用筛查；对侧载渠道命名习惯不同的生态不外推。
limitations: 可被刻意模仿命名规避；单信号召回上限明显；地域语言对名称-包名关系的影响未分析。

title: Dissecting Agentic Forensics: The Role of Triage, Prompting, and Evidence Arbitration in Open-World Fake Image Detection
abstract: Image forensics is increasingly an open-world problem: manipulations range from fully synthetic images to localized edits, splicing and swapping, while most forensic detectors remain specialized to a single manipulation family. Agentic AI has recently emerged as a promising solution. In principle, such systems can assess the reliability of individual detectors, identify out-of-scope evidence, and arbitrate conflicting reports. However, it remains unclear which components actually drive performance and whether their benefits persist under distribution shift. To answer these questions, we study a training-free agentic framework built around specialist detectors, per-detector triage, and conflict-aware evidence arbitration. Using six configurations and three multimodal large language model backbones, we dissect the role of triage, prompting, and reasoning quality on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution data. Our results show that naive detector fusion suffers from severe false-positive rates on authentic images. Triage and prompting consistently improve performance by filtering unreliable evidence and exposing detector limitations. However, the dominant factor is represented by reasoning itself: A stronger judge substantially outperforms a weaker one, particularly under distribution shift.
